### Notice
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3703639e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

This manual does not necessarily include all items required for vehicle repair and maintenance. It is intended for use by personnel with professional skills and qualifications. Repair or maintenance performed by technicians without professional skills or qualifications will cause injury to themselves or the surrounding personnel and damage to customer's vehicle if they only refer to this manual or fail to use appropriate equipment or tools.

To avoid damage to customer's vehicle as a result of dangerous operations, please observe the following rules.

Thoroughly read this manual. In particular, you must fully understand all "Precautions" in the "Introduction" section.
The repair methods provided in this manual are quite effective for vehicle repair. When performing repairs following the steps prescribed in this manual, you must use the tools as designated or recommended in this manual. In the event of using non-designated or non-recommended tools and repair methods, you must ensure the safety of the repair technician before start and make sure no personal injuries or damages to customer's vehicle will be caused.
When it is necessary to replace certain parts, make sure the parts with the same part number or equivalent parts are used. Do not use low-quality parts.
If automatic configuration of the electronic control module is required for replacement, follow the steps for automatic configuration as follows:
1. Turn the ignition switch to the "OFF" position.
2. Connect the HQ-VDS scan tool to DLC2.
3. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
4. Turn on the HQ-VDS scan tool.
5. Select in the following sequence: System Scan/Module Programming/Automatic
Configuration Module/(select the module that needs automatic configuration)
6. Follow the prompts on the HQ-VDS scan tool for automatic configuration.
It must be noted that in order to effectively avoid possible personal injury during repair or maintenance, as well as vehicle damage caused by improper operations, or hidden hazards that may make the vehicle unsafe, you must earnestly observe the "Notice" and "Caution" in this manual. In addition, the contents of "Notice" and "Caution” in this manual are not exaggerated. Violation of these instructions may lead to dangerous consequences.

### 1. HV safety
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b269b369` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The HV system with level B voltage on electric vehicles may bring electric shock risk to drivers, passengers and operators during the trial production, production, use and maintenance of the vehicles.

### 2. HV safety basics
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_335634ae` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Electric shock protection tools insulating gloves.

(1) Precautions for use of insulating gloves:

Make sure the insulating gloves are the correct type.
Inflation inspection must be carried out before use. If any damage is found, it cannot be used.
After use, the interna and external dirt shall be wiped clean.
They should be kept dry and protected from acids, alkalis, oils and other
substances.
Regular inspection must be carried out after 6 months of use.
Caution:
Regular inspection must be caried out after 6 months of use.

3. Handling of electric shock accident

(a) Protect the site.

(1) Disconnect the power supply (high voltage power off/remove the MSD), check the power-off status and prevent reconnection!

(b) Deal with the injured in the accident.

(1) In case of "serious injury", call 120 emergency number immediately.
(2) In case of "minor injury" seek medical attention after emergency treatment.

(c) Accident analysis.

(1) Timely inspect the site together with relevant superior principals, safety officers, safety experts and parties (if possible).
(2) Before using the vehicle in question again, it must be tested by an electrical professional.
(3) Request the relevant departments to analyze the cause of the accident and prepare an accident report.

### 4. Electrical fire rescue
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_811fceaf` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Call the fire department.
(b) Confirm the type of fire.
(1) When thoroughly checking the fire, do not contact with any HV parts, and always check with insulating tools.
(2) Fire not caused by battery. In case of a small fire and the flame does not spread to the HV battery, carbon dioxide or ABC dry powder fire extinguisher can be used to extinguish the fire.
(3) Battery fire. If the high-voltage battery is bent or damaged in a fire, or if there is a problem with the battery, a large amount of water shall be used to extinguish the fire. It may take 24 hours to completely extinguish the battery fire. With the thermal imaging camera, you can confirm whether the high-voltage battery is completely cooled. If there is

no thermal imaging camera, you must monitor whether the battery will rekindle. Smoking means that the battery is still very hot. Even if it no longer smokes, you should monitor it for at least another hour. To avoid the potential for battery re-ignition, it is recommended that the battery be placed in an open and vacant area.

(c) Safety precautions for electric shock.

(1) Always assume that all high voltage components are energized!
(2) To avoid electric shock, do not directly touch any part of the vehicle, and always use insulated tools.
(3) Cutting, crushing or contacting high voltage components can cause serious electric shock or short circuit accidents.

(d) Other safety precautions.

(1) If the battery is on fire and releases toxic gas, irrelevant personnel must be evacuated.
(2) Have self-protection awareness, wear protective equipment, and do not inhale toxic smoke.
(3) The inflatable bottle, gas strut and other components storing gas can reach the extreme temperature of boiling liquid expansion steam explosion. Disassembly with appropriate fine protection shall be carried out before checking the "hot zone" of the accident.
(4) Do not use carbon dioxide fire extinguisher to put out fire for people on fire, which is in danger of suffocation.

1. Precautions for high-voltage related operations (inspection and maintenance of high-voltage system)

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_606a8619` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Electric vehicles have a high voltage that exceeds the safety voltage of the human body. Therefore, they must be inspected and repaired by
professionals who have received relevant training, and be operated in accordance with the correct methods.
When the vehicle has any fault, persons wearing electronic medical devices such as pacemakers and insulin pumps shall be prohibited from approaching and operating the vehicle.
When operating the vehicle, do not wear metal decorations such as watches, so as to avoid
short-circuit accidents.

(a) Preparations

![](images/9e9a6f75649e880b0df124506be8768a10ded1058f8b2874822ff72dd20247b4.webp)

![](images/0b2a4165104d0b337221dd84daab9dd53b483094ca7b9941f7cf64075df95f69.webp)

![](images/5768e1c4110747148d091b910124b9edac5730c978cf5bf80ec1eeddad08a1ce.webp)

(1) High-voltage danger warning sign (b) Identification of high-voltage components Caution:

Some high-voltage components may only have lightning marks in the triangle.

(1) The HV harness and the HV connector are both marked in orange.
(2) High-voltage components other than harness are affixed with high-voltage signs, and the sign style is generally as shown in the figure.

2. Safe operation steps for disconnecting high-voltage loop Attention:

If the operation of disconnecting the high-voltage loop is not performed correctly before disassembling the vehicle, it may cause serious electric shock accident or even death. Even after the high-voltage circuit is disconnected, the high-voltage battery still contains high-voltage electricity. It is forbidden to touch the high-voltage battery shell and its interior with bare hands. The high-voltage system may contain high-voltage electricity. It is forbidden to touch the high-voltage components with bare hands.

Caution:

Ifthe vehicle s con ected to a charginggun, the charginggun shal be unplug ed first.

The high-voltage capacitors n high-voltage components such as motor controlers and DC/DCstil retain some ofthe electrical energy afterthe high-voltage system spowered of. Theresidual electrical energywil bereduced to below 60 VDC within 2minutes, and wil befuly discharged within 5 minutes.
Afterthe MSD s unlocked, placing theignition switch intheSTART (READY) position maycause a fault.
(a) Set the ignition switch to "OFF".
(b) Disconnect the negative terminal of the low-voltage battery.
(c) Check the model of the insulating gloves, and confirm that the rated voltage exceeds 500 VAC/700 VDC; make sure that the insulating gloves are dry and free of dirt and air leakage. The sleeves shall be placed in the gloves when wearing them.
(d) Unlock the low-voltage MSD, and lock the MSD with a safety lock, so as to avoid the risk of electric shock caused by others' misoperation.
(e) Wait for 5 minutes until the capacitor discharge in the high-voltage circuit ends.
(f) Use insulating devices such as insulating tape to protect the exposed high-voltage live parts in all directions, so as to ensure that the high-voltage live parts cannot be directly touched.

### 3. Safe operation steps for recovering high-voltage loop
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d369de89` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check the model of the insulating gloves, and confirm that the rated voltage exceeds 500 VAC/700 VDC; make sure that the insulating gloves are dry and free of dirt and air leakage. The sleeves shall be placed in the gloves when wearing them.
(b) Remove insulating devices such as insulating tape.
(c) Connect the low-voltage MSD.
(d) Connect the battery negative terminal.
(e) Set the ignition switch to the START position, and the instrument will display Ready status.

### 4. Airbag and seat belt pretensioner
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_022af228` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Power off.

(1) After confirming the DLC, turn off the ignition switch and do not start the operation until the negative terminal of the battery is removed for 60s. Tip: Since the airbag and pretensioner system is equipped with a backup power supply, the airbag may deploy if the operation starts within 60s after the negative terminal of the battery is removed.

(b) General precautions

(1) Use a digital multimeter for electrical inspection.
(2) Follow the precautions on the labels around the system.
(3) Do not disassemble.
(4) Do not measure the resistance.

(c) Precautions for disposal of airbag and pretensioner (before deployment).

(1) Do not dispose the airbag in an undeployed state (be sure to use SST to deploy).
(2) Since the sound is loud when deploying, please inform the people around in advance.
(3) Be sure to choose a safe and flat outdoor place that is away from the residentia area for deployment.
(4) When deploying the airbag and pretensioner, please use SST and stay 5 m away from the airbag and pretensioner.
(d) Precautions for disposal of airbag and pretensioner (after deployment). (1) Since the temperature of some parts of the deployed airbag and pretensioner is as high as several hundred centigrade degrees, they shall be left for more than 30 min after deployment.
(e) Precautions for the driver airbag assembly, front passenger airbag assembly and pretensioner.
(1) During operation, the airbag be placed with the undeployed side up even if it is removed temporarily
(2) Do not overlap airbags or place other objects on them.

(f) Harness and connector.

(1) Most of the harnesses in the system are integrated with the instrument panel harness assembly, and all connectors are marked with standard yellow. If the harness is disconnected or the connector is damaged, repair or replace immediately.

(g) Handling after a vehicle collision.

(1) Remove the airbag and seat belt pretensioner before using an electric welder.
(2) Since the airbag sensor assembly may be impacted, remove the sensor assembly before operation.

5. The equipotential and insulation inspection of the high-voltage system must be performed after the high-voltage components of the vehicle are replaced.

### 6. Equipotential inspection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c005ca74` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) High-voltage components with equipotential bonding

![](images/50fc352b57bd79c8fa38ba2d635c25b4b7a60d173a4c6aaddbf35144b9872f88.webp)

### (b) Inspection tools
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_74212539` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/845ce65a671f75c8d56d764431d2fe7131e1c067b3d5e5bc0992954d2c9dcfc7.webp)

(c) Operation steps

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_f09b7302` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Check whether the micro-ohmmeter has been verified before inspection. Confirm whether the insulating gloves have been verified, and whether the insulating gloves are dry and have any air leakage. Confirm that the battery negative wire and the low-voltage MSD are disconnected. Disconnect the high-voltage harness of each powertrain before measurement.

(1) Use the torque detection device to check the tightening torque of high-voltage components.

(2) Adjust the micro-ohmmeter to the milliohm position, use Kelvin test pens, and wear insulating gloves to measure the resistance between the housing of the high-voltage component with equipotential connection and the electric platform. If the resistance value is greater than 40mΩ, it does not meet the requirements, and shall be returned to the maintenance area for handling by professionals.

(3) Perform equipotential inspection between the housing of high-voltage components assembled in the sub-assembly area and with equipotential bonding. If the resistance value between the front power motor, high-voltage distribution box, integrated two-way OBC DC/DC, electric air conditioning compressor and electric platform is greater than 40mΩ, it does not meet the requirements, and shall be returned to the maintenance area for handling by professionals.

(4) The resistance shall be measured between the housing of the power battery, rear power motor and water heater PTC and the electric platform on the chassis line. If the resistance value is greater than 40mΩ, it does not meet the requirements, and shall be returned to the maintenance area for handling by professionals.

7. Inspection of vehicle insulation resistance (a) After the vehicle is running, the insulation monitoring device can monitor the vehicle insulation outside the AC charging system (the failure of the power motor can be monitored). One can check whether the insulation resistance of the vehicle fails by checking whether the combination instrument has the insulation alarm indication.

(b) Operation steps

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5b7df8d7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The vehicle has been subject to insulation inspection during general assembly, which meet the requirements.

(1) The ignition switch is set to the ON position, and the high-voltage power-on of the vehicle is in the "ready" state.
(2) Depress the accelerator pedal to keep the vehicle in a driving state.
(3) After driving at a speed greater than 5km/h for 20s, observe whether the combined instrument has an insulation alarm information.
(4) If there is a high-voltage insulation fault alarm message, it shall be returned to the maintenance area for handling by professionals.

### 8. Inspection of DC system insulation resistance (except for power battery)
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_808017e7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Inspection tools

![](images/e217f6e72641ca9435d77c57d951a4ef3fb024cb07fa3fb2e60a2882239015b8.webp)

(b) Operation steps

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_94296f85` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Check whether the insulation meter has been verified; check whether the pen-shape meter and the test line of the insulation meter are in good conditions; check the actual test voltage output from the 500V test voltage grade of the insulation meter, which shall not be lower than DC 495V. Confirm whether the insulating gloves have been verified; whether the insulating gloves are dry and have any air leakage. Confirm that the battery negative wire and the low-voltage MSD are disconnected. The high-voltage harness of each high-voltage assembly shall be connected.

(1) Wear insulating gloves.
(2) Set the test voltage of the insulation meter to DC 500V, and measure the high-voltage interface of integrated two-way OBC DC/DC of the vehicle and the high-voltage interface of the air conditioning compressor respectively.
(3) Ensure that all other high-voltage harnesses except for the measuring point (high-voltage interface of A/C compressor) have been assembled, measure the high-voltage insulation at the connector (the positive and negative shall be grounded respectively), record and assemble the measuring point. Measure the resistance value of the integrated two-way OBC DC/DC according to the same method.
(4) If the resistance value is less than 1MΩ, it does not meet the requirements, and shall be returned to the maintenance area for handling by professionals.

(2) If the pre-coated parts are re-fastened, loosened or moved in any way, they must be re-applied with the specified thread sealant. Tip: The lower limit of the standard torque range shall be used for torque inspection.
(3) When reusing the pre-coated parts, remove the applied thread sealant and dry the parts with compressed air. Then apply an appropriate amount of new thread sealant on the parts.
(4) The applied thread sealant must be still within the specified time for installation.

(c) Gasket.

(e) Torque when the torque wrench is used in combination with the extension tool. (1) If the extension tool is used in combination with a torque wrench, and the torque wrench is used to tighten to the specified torque in this manual, the actual torque will be too large, causing damages to the parts.

(2) Formula: T'=L2/(L1+L2)×T (f) Replace the fuse.

### 18. Electrical system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d43f7af6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/c482818957d0fad5e1fa0a0dcd70958a2b9291e12e2dab90a1dbc7885c8950f3.webp)

(a) Removal and installation of battery terminal.

(1) When working on the electrical system, remove the battery terminals in advance to prevent burning caused by a short circuit.
(2) When removing the battery terminals, turn off the ignition switch and light switch, and completely loosen the terminal nut without prying.
(3) If the battery terminal is removed, confirm the relevant contents in advance owing that the stored information such as the clock, radio, and diagnosis will be cleared.

(b) Calibration for removal and installation of battery terminal.

![](images/7ce71f183c6180bc66b500f41b746ab14085a0710b01ec2a295b303db9dad25e.webp)

(c) Disposal of electronic parts.

![](images/dd61f9134411083e828b04fb0c46f777846ef1f307f217de80d0d90568ad13da.webp)

(1) Do not disassemble ECU. (The integrated circuit may be damaged due to static electricity from persona touch of the circuit terminal.)
(2) Do not subject electronic parts such as ECU, sensors and relays to impact. In case of accidental falling, replace with a new one.
(3) Avoid placing the electronic parts in the high temperature and high humidity environment.
(4) Do not allow water to directly get on the electronic parts, air filter and parts related to the exhaust system when cleaning the engine with steam.
(5) Do not touch the terminals of the connector to prevent defects caused by deformation and static electricity.
(6) Never use an impact wrench to remove and install the temperature sensor.

### 1. Precautions for vehicle state during lifting
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_dc0b3b68` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Follow the principle that the vehicle is close to empty, and do not jack up or lift the vehicle loaded with heavy objects.
(b) If heavy parts such as the powertrain are removed, the center of gravity of the vehicle will move. Therefore, it is necessary to balance the load and avoid tilting.
(a) Always use stoppers when working on flat ground.
(b) As shown in the figure, use brackets with rubber accessories.
(c) The jack and bracket must be correctly supported at the designated positions.
(d) When jacking up the front wheel, release the parking brake and place the stopper only behind the rear wheel. When jacking up the rear wheel, only place the stopper in front of the front wheel.
(e) When jacking up the front or rear wheel, place stoppers on the front and rear sides of the wheels on the ground. Tip: Do not work or park when only using jack to support the vehicle and be sure to use brackets to support.
(f) When lowering the jack under the condition that only the front wheels are jacked up, release the parking brake and place stoppers on the front and rear sides of the rear wheels. When lowering the jack under the condition that only the rear wheels are jacked up, place stoppers on the front and rear sides of the front wheels. Tip: Do not use wheel jacks on the oil pan.

![](images/55ac48506fcc3203526307cb1aa1c58551ab30dd59df3273c9b81360a06f2bf0.webp)
2. Precautions for use of jack and bracket

![](images/ad42287bf894bddd26f301728a94e7c75ecb50a96311711eb10fffaeb2c573c5.webp)

(a) Perform safe operation in accordance with the operation instructions of the lift. Tip: If the standard flatbed is not used or the lift is improperly supported and greatly deviates from the center of gravity of the vehicle, the stability of the vehicle will be significantly reduced which may damage the body.

![](images/f7fdf561e18a04fab4ef0ac26a596b3a2cba0ad822e46db1dc8231772142943e.webp)

(b) When using a flatbed lift to lift a vehicle, confirm that the center of gravity of the vehicle is within the allowable range of the lift.

### 4. Precautions for using rocker lift
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_659e7f1f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Rocker lift

![](images/e60ae727926642067abc20012778795081b47c6c0f9df1d7aa3b9be1063b1583.webp)

IN01140RM

(a) Perform safe operation in accordance with the operation instructions of the lift.
(b) As shown in the figure, use brackets with rubber accessories.
(c) The parking position of the vehicle shall enable the center of the lift to be close to the vehicle's center of gravity as possible.
(d) When the vehicle is in a horizonta state, adjust the height of the supporting part, so as not to collide with the sill molding, so that the groove of the supporting part coincide with the supporting position of the bracket.
(e) The rocker arm must be locked during operation.
(f) After lifting the tires, shake the vehicle slightly to confirm that the vehicle is stable.

5. Precautions for using 4-post lift and wheel lift

(a) Perform safe operation in accordance with the operation instructions of the lift.
(b) Prevent the tire and wheel from being damaged by the freewheel frame.
(c) Secure the vehicle with stoppers.

### 1. Basic inspection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_92447eb0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/73800168534aefeaac62f41c4911382b634a049a9fec9ed20c779790515424d5.webp)

(a) Resistance measurement conditions of the electronic parts.

(1) Unless otherwise specified, all resistance measurements shall be made at the ambient temperature of 20°C. Since the resistance will exceed the specified value when it is measured immediately after the vehicle running (high temperature), the measurement shall be performed after the powertrain has cooled down.

(b) Operation of the connector.

(1) When disconnecting a connector with a lock, push the engaged part of the connector to easily move the lock claw to release the lock.
(2) When disconnecting the connector, directly hold the connector instead of pulling the harness to disconnect.
(3) Before connecting the connector, check whether the connector terminal is deformed, damaged, or lost.
(4) When connecting a connector with a lock, insert firmly until a locking sound is heard.
(5) When checking the connector with a digital multimeter, use a miniature probe to check from the back (harness side). Danger: Since the waterproof connector cannot be inspected from the back, it shall be inspected by connecting auxiliary harness. Do not move the inserted probe randomly to prevent damage to the terminal.

![](images/704b1740b690cdd4a98feec7345ca44650e97e90941c35b5dec6c84fc3585bce.webp)

(c) Inspection method of the connector.

(1) When connecting a connector, hold the connector housing and check whether it is fully inserted and locked. (Engaged state)
(2) When disconnecting a connector, lightly pull the harness to check for the lost terminal, loose crimp and disconnected core wire. Visually inspect for rust, metal fragments, water, or foreign objects, and check for bent, corroded, or deformed terminals.
(3) Prepare a terminal that is the same as the plug terminal, insert it into the socket terminal to check the engagement and sliding tightness to confirm whether the terminal contact pressure is appropriate.

![](images/6762cffe5dc572e0b15966e7ece163010b0e6a03b865509d2bf98c91575de749.webp)

![](images/89c8cd6fe8912f5afdf082e7c6a39cf5323eff72ee92dc17187bc8824ef891c8.webp)

(d) Repair method of the connector terminal.

(1) If there is dirt at the contact point, use an air gun, rag, etc. to clean. In this condition, do not sand the contact point with sandpaper to prevent damage to the electroplated layer on its surface.
(2) When the contact pressure is abnormal, replace the socket terminal. If the plug terminal is gold-plated (gold), use gold-plated socket terminals; if it is tin-plated (silver), use tin-plated socket terminals.
(3) When the contact point is in good condition, clean the contact point with an air gun and apply grease to the connector (this method can prevent oxidation and wear of the contact point).

(e) Connector grease.

(1) Apply grease (white) on connectors of water-prone parts such as alternator and headlamp to prevent corrosion of the terminals.
(2) When the grease on the connector is insufficient or the terminal is repaired, apply the connector grease to the socket terminal manually. Tip: Avoid dust. Do not apply the grease by tools such as a screwdriver.

### 1. Basic inspection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_56ed0e83` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(3) If the grease is applied to rubber parts (except the O-ring and rubber plug of the waterproof connector), the affected parts will deteriorate and discolor. If this happens, the grease shall be wiped off immediately.

(f) Operation of harness.

![](images/8a9ac331c42c5d361db511e61bb488aeb31ad395815b072761ad081c177bd52a.webp)

(1) When removing the harness, check the wiring and clamp conditions before operation so as to restore it in the original condition.
(2) Do not twist or stretch the harness if not necessary.
(3) Do not rotate, slide or shake the harness, and keep it away from high temperature parts and parts with sharp corners (board ends, screw tips, etc.).
(4) Do not compress the harness when installing parts.
(5) Do not damage the harness sheathing. If it is damaged, replace it with a new one or wrap it with vinyl tape.

2. Open circuit inspection (a) As shown in the figure, when the harness is open-circuited, conduct a continuity check or a voltage check to determine the specific part with open circuit.

![](images/0616750c77e5c213a5ce76f8a2602fe2f19635ae2b3efd02ca41a1973f0b9096.webp)

![](images/95bf1a007bba638006aa6840767c4eb3a9198ed49c8f12b7eda4ae9a6e8702b8.webp)

(b) Check the continuity.

(1) Disconnect connectors A and C, and measure the resistance between them. Standard value: <1Ω Tip: Gently shake the harness up and down and left and right to measure the resistance.
(2) As shown in the figure, there is no continuity (open circuit) between terminal 1 of connector A and terminal 1 of connector C, and there is continuity between terminal 2 of connector A and terminal 2 of connector C. In this condition, the circuit between terminal 1 of connector A and terminal 1 of connector C is open.
(3) Disconnect the connector B and measure the resistance between the connectors.
(4) As shown in the figure, there is continuity between terminal 1 of connector A and terminal 1 of connector B1, and there is no continuity (open circuit) between terminal 1 of connector B2 and terminal 1 of connector C. In this condition, the circuit between terminal 1 of connector B2 and terminal 1 of connector C is open.

![](images/c9807012df003b4eebd5bffe061d72ba7540caf05e61c895037dd6f533d56326.webp)

![](images/760f0f1433a99174b18f4c9e26d8324a6922c53d2768ed1a1ecabb86b854d4ce.webp)

(c) Check the voltage.

(1) In the circuit with voltage applied to the ECU connector terminal, the open circuit can be determined by voltage inspection.
(2) As shown in the figure, keep the connectors connected. Use the ECU 5V output terminal to measure the voltage between the body ground and the terminal 1 of connector A, and then measure the voltage between terminal 1 of connector B and terminal 1 of connector C.
(3) When the following conditions are met, the harness circuit between terminal 1 of connector B and terminal 1 of connector C is open.

### Standard value:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_179e0593` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

5V between terminal 1 of connector A and body ground
5V between terminal 1 of connector B and body ground
0V between terminal 1 of connector C and body ground

3. Short circuit inspection (a) As shown in the figure, when the harness ground is short-circuited, check the continuity of the ground to determine the circuit shorted.

![](images/e60c996315a4781a8ac34e327141082cbc0751f0e3eeaf0323f5698310b84b28.webp)

![](images/7913446fe8eb6e7fee423fbab2473892c82ebb4a898a245dfd6ecad7001dd770.webp)

(b) Check the continuity of the ground.

(1) Disconnect the connectors A and C, and measure the resistance between terminals 1 and 2 of connector A and the body ground.

### Standard value: >10kΩ
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c2f4cb96` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
Gently shake the harness up and down and left and right to measure the
resistance.

(2) As shown in the figure, there is continuity (short circuit) between terminal 1 of connector A and the body ground, and there is no continuity between terminal 2 of connector A and the body ground. In this condition, the circuit between terminal 1 of connector A and terminal 1 of connector C is short.

![](images/7ab4d1b753800e9de4b75421fdbbdc5cfba121a159c337d466b1352ea39d9dbb.webp)

(3) Disconnect the connector B, and measure the resistance between terminal 1 of connector A and the body ground, and between terminal 1 of connector B2 and the body ground. If there is no continuity between terminal 1 of connector A and the body ground, and there is continuity (short circuit) between terminal 1 of connector B2 and the body ground, then the circuit between terminal 1 of connector B2 and terminal 1 of connector C is short.

4. Visual inspection and contact pressure inspection

![](images/9a5947b0a60e120d9ea9285e7abd06a228ffb93ab33a4844e120ad1d91909df9.webp)

(a) Disconnect the connectors at both ends
(b) Check whether there is rust or foreign matter on the connector terminal.
(c) Check whether the crimping part is loose or damaged, and whether the terminal is firmly fixed in the locked position.
(d) Prepare a plug terminal, insert it into the socket terminal and pull it out. Tip: If the test terminal can be easily pulled out in comparison with other terminals, the contact is poor.

5. Inspection and replacement of ECU

![](images/a859c9c1a45fe1e8ba61fed673918cfa816a12f4530a94075ede39e90978d423.webp)

### Tip:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0ad43ee1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Keep the connector and ECU connected, and check from the back of the harness connector. If the measurement conditions are not specified, check when the engine is stopped and the ignition switch is turned on. (a) First check the ECU ground circuit, and repair in case of faulty. If it is normal, the ECU may be faulty. Replace it with a functional ECU, and then check whether the fault symptom is eliminated. (1) Measure the resistance between the ground terminal of the ECU and the body ground. Standard value: <1Ω (2) Disconnect the ECU connector, confirm that the ground terminals of the ECU and harness are not bent, and check the contact pressure.

![](images/d1f793ff08c37e31b44e30f59ed874d5b9283928123aaf9b024c509bf9ab33a3.webp)

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

2. Power (ignition) switch notation:

![](images/91899195e3ff2174decaf8a6e17db4a0c6d6f419013fb2294f8844577150180a.webp)

### 3. Removal and installation of battery terminal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_478176bd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Before disassembling and repairing electrical components, disconnect the negative (-) terminal of the battery to prevent the system from short-circuiting.
(b) Before disconnecting or reconnecting battery cable terminals, first turn off the power (ignition) switch and lighting switch, and then completely loosen or tighten the battery cable terminal nuts.
(c) When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### 1. Data logger
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e5ae518a` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:

Use the scan tool to read the data logger, and the value or status of switches, sensors, actuators and other items can be read without removing any parts. Intermittent faults or signals can be found using this detection method. When troubleshooting, reading the information from data logger can save diagnostic time.

![](images/cbc910118080c297f96cbb93a880215a4fe1619011330402464fff2c80049867.webp)

![](images/5128378c694cfeaccbf5155ee15d0d70f3ad4378e5b8f1487a82895dc0a9526f.webp)

### 1. Active test
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_76634154` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:

Use the scan tool HQ-VDS to carry out active test. Relay, actuator and other items can be operated without removing any parts. Such inspection can shorten the diagnosis time to detect intermittent fault between parts and wiring as early as possible for troubleshooting.

(a) Connect the HQ-VDS scan tool.
(b) Turn the ignition switch to the "ON" position.
(c) Start the scan tool HQ-VDS.
(d) Refer to the table below for active testing.

![](images/f0301b793574bd4c1a2748a7361afeb9d03af5f92eb13916d7e9ebfd531f01b5.webp)

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6a1f68e6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/8d2047a42212e60903115d92c5eb95fc5cdd43d96cc6247121a0bcc193c1a34c.webp)

(b) Set the ignition switch to "ON”
(c) Record and clear the DTC.
(d) Re-run the driving test under the conditions described by the user.
(e) Check whether the DTC reappears.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c0574b3e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （CH-47）
2. Remove the lower right bottom guard plate （IP-1）
3. Remove the right front door sill guard plate assembly （ET-55）
4 Remove the VCU

![](images/e320d59cbebb9697a9f879f0ee49abd5f36176e1ab063a6397ca4d1732ee3ef5.webp)

(a) Lift the right front corner of the carpet assembly. Tip: Do not damage the carpet assembly when lifting.

![](images/e6428e1e7bf9ecd064d58099356897c9104f1117ef82149c013b9d6a3086d260.webp)

(b) Disconnect the harness connector of the VCU.

![](images/2c0107d700c17f179cf640523da3a849ce07fc9a65eb68ba9cd6d1198f69f016.webp)

(c) Remove 4 bolts to detach the VCU.

(d) Remove 3 nuts to detach the VCU bracket.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1000d05f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the VCU (a) Install the VCU bracket with 3 nuts. Torque: 8-12N·m

![](images/2a3c5b15337ef71aed14e8daff118391a16a3986dca7001723314a21ca3bc996.webp)

![](images/8ea307725bb39a34d029053ca056bde37d6bec57b0edbf333520c1ebbb761b82.webp)

(b) Install the VCU with 4 bolts. Torque: 8-12N·m

(c) Connect the VCU harness connector.

(d) Pave the right front corner of the carpet assembly. Tip: Pave the carpet assembly and ensure that the carpet assembly is free from wrinkles and damage.

2. Install the right front door sill guard plate assembly. （ET-56）
3. Install the lower right bottom guard plate （IP-6）
4 Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （CH-54）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8ed5b524` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （CH-52） 2. Remove the electronic accelerator pedal

![](images/40c14bcf958239d6e08daf73538aeb08866ce7d7bff80aa483275d1fbddc0e04.webp)

(a) Remove 2 stop plates of the electronic accelerator pedal.

![](images/a5fa5188b47b770fa843db2a5ced65e52930d52548342779479b367e13218267.webp)

(b) Remove 2 bolts to detach the electronic accelerator pedal.

![](images/88a790b7a92aa5252d7ecccd15bec03702bf8bf353c1705fd66833cf4aa0014b.webp)

(c) Disconnect the electronic accelerator pedal harness connector.

3. Remove the carpet assembly （IR-37）

![](images/948170c1297744477473478efb6b3c1077791263f3ec47be44c112b15a3d35b6.webp)

4. Remove the electronic accelerator pedal bracket (a) Remove 3 nuts to detach the electronic accelerator pedal bracket.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_892d92a8` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the electronic accelerator pedal bracket

![](images/dedcb719f22e2ea0b10caecb2508c63d7d85f37f613302f81e8352ec183e7719.webp)

(a) Install the electronic accelerator pedal bracket with 3 nuts. Torque: 6-8N·m

2. Install the carpet assembly （IR-39）

3. Install the electronic accelerator pedal

![](images/f0ad9d619dc838124cdf0fe249d3f25cb4f45b3a3df7a92a6013b6a98609ef7b.webp)

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

2. Power (ignition) switch notation:

![](images/343aee6549a7e11971d83a50d8efabc8fd392a62f9da13cae33b150b258a37b1.webp)

### 3. Removal and installation of battery terminal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_478176bd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Before disassembling and repairing electrical components, disconnect the negative (-) terminal of the battery to prevent the system from short-circuiting.
(b) Before disconnecting or reconnecting battery cable terminals, first turn off the power (ignition) switch and lighting switch, and then completely loosen or tighten the battery cable terminal nuts.
(c) When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

4. After the power drive system inverter is replaced, the initial angle of the electric drive system motor needs to be written in.

### 2. Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_09c656f6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The high-voltage DC power supply is transformed into three-phase alternating current with adjustable voltage amplitude and frequency by DC/AC (inverter), which drives the permanent magnet synchronous motor to operate; at the same time, the current rotor position signal is detected, and the phase current of the motor is sampled in real time and sent to the motor control unit. The motor control unit communicates with the vehicle controller through the CAN bus, obtains the current torque command, operating mode and rotation direction from the vehicle controller, controls the motor driver to generate the required three-phase alternating current according to the current and motor position signals obtained from feedback, and drive the motor to run.

### Replace the reducer oil of the 160KW electric drive system assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8519de11` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Drain the reducer oil of the 160KW electric drive system assembly

![](images/333bf44a972ded64f574a756a147294b5c64c8ce1f1da199b65cb81ab61dc478.webp)

(a) Park the vehicle on a level road or maintain all positioning frames of the lifting platform at the same height, and engage into P gear.
(b) Remove the reducer drain plug and drain the reducer oil into a container. Tip: A small amount of fluid may be left in the reducer.

(c) After draining the reducer oil, tighten the drain plug. Torque: 30-40N·m

2. Fill reducer oil

![](images/68f8502bd5606bd81edda66540aabceb11a3bc8b9a11d1c83407b25e73400bf1.webp)

(a) Remove the reducer oil filling plug.

(b) Quantitative filling amount through the filling hole: 0.64 ± 0.02 L (liter) Please use the specified lubricating oil CASTROL BOT350 M3. Tip: When filling, control the flow rate to avoid overflow.

(c) After filling oil in the reducer, re-tighten the filler plug.

Torque: 30-40N·m

Tip:
The fill plug is non-magnetic, while the drain plug is magnetic. You must be able to
distinguish them.

### Replace the reducer oil of the 245KW electric drive system assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5b7fe08a` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Drain the reducer oil of the 245KW electric drive system assembly

![](images/c67226217208f58ae73fc57a8a469b6a747bcc5b2b48cf7c684f5f80c272a63e.webp)

(a) Park the vehicle on a level road or maintain all positioning frames of the lifting platform at the same height, and engage into P gear.
(b) Remove the reducer drain plug and drain the reducer oil into a container. Tip: A small amount of fluid may be left in the reducer.

(c) After draining the reducer oil, tighten the drain plug. Torque: 48-56N·m

2. Fill reducer oil

![](images/4a79515cb58a2aed18ee73a0afa1a738e2bd7d4bd88f690e3cf6bb4d3573fa12.webp)

(a) Remove the reducer oil filling plug.

(b) Quantitative filling through the filler hole: 1.4 L±0.05 L; Please used designated CASTROL BOT350 M3 lubricating oil. Tip: When filling, control the flow rate to avoid overflow.
(c) After filling oil in the reducer, re-tighten the filler plug.

### Torque: 48-56N·m
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e2314549` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The fill plug is non-magnetic, while the drain plug is magnetic. You must be able to
distinguish them.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_db42a8af` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
2. Connect the scan tool HQ-VDS and enter the maintenance mode to exhaust the AirS system. (Reserve 3bar pressure holding gas).
3. Turn the ignition switch to the OFF (STOP) position when the vehicle is stationary.

4. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） Danger: Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery after waiting for 5s.

### 5. Disengage the MSD （ CH-44）
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_97a05f3b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Danger: Disengage the MSD and wait for the complete discharge of the high-voltage components. Wait for another 5 minutes before the subsequent operation. Wear insulating gloves.
6. Disassemble the engine compartment bottom guard plate II（ ET-44）
7. Disassemble the engine compartment bottom guard plate I（ ET-44）
8. Disassemble the front wheel assembly of the vehicle.（TW-5）
9. Empty the coolant （ CO-3）
10. Recover refrigerant in the refrigeration system （ AC-139）
11. Remove the battery assembly（ CH-52）
12. Remove high voltage distribution box assembly （ HG-1）
13. Remove the distribution box input HV harness assembly HG-5）
14. Remove water heater PTC high voltage harness assembly HG-18）
15. Remove the E-PARK locking control unit assembly EK-31）
16. Remove the integrated two-way OBC DC/DC converter assembly （ CH-56）
17. Remove the cooling line AC-295）
18. Remove the electric compressor assembly （AC-233）
19. Remove the body height sensor （ AS-145）
20. Remove the left front drive shaft with bracket assembly DS-1）
21. Remove the right front drive shaft assembly DS-1）
22. Remove front stabilizer bar & connecting rod assembly SP-31）
23. Remove the fixing bolts from the steering column and electronic steering gear assembly （ PS-38）
24. Remove the steering tie rod ball joint （PS-38）
25. Disconnect the harness connector of the parallel shaft electric steering gear & rod assembly. （ PS-38）
26. Remove the lower control arm 1# assembly （ SP-11）
27. Remove the lower control arm 2# assembly （ SP-16）
28. Remove the FWD electric drive system assembly (a) Disconnect the harness connector of FWD electric drive system assembly.

![](images/f0d8f069c7125599b30cf35c44a8852c1544dbc036fd5569541e6c1ebfdc3734.webp)

![](images/0d79e14cf2a3ae7390a79bf3b09dffd5adde528791ce376c6d79eb71f388e172.webp)

(b) Disconnect the reducer harness connector.

![](images/ad7531d9ba17cf660dc781966ec14383d017195c7eab49a897e6a6c7530a1a45.webp)

(c) Remove 2 bolts and disengage the grounding wire of FWD electric drive system assembly.

![](images/74042c103bae57029c2b4c0ec2b10f5b8f851950b8720114fbf8cba49685678a.webp)

(d) Disengage the harness fixing clip of FWD electric drive system assembly.

![](images/6bcfbb18fcde7e7f0f9da3f4c5e2546579dc92d2766f26c2c2e6a2a1da54ff79.webp)

(e) Remove 4 bolts to detach the DC bus high-voltage harness bracket III.

![](images/21e1a0ed0d8e9991a3ee91b94d7f33c00799c3b5ee797d681f1e713e5c082c81.webp)

(f) Disconnect the front DC bus high-voltage harness connector.

(g) Remove 6 bolts and detach the compressor bracket.

![](images/a1011dda01ba74f7640ee85f5321be78f3ba34da3a9ebe9d17a01db0ee822ac0.webp)

(h) Disengage 2 clips and disconnect the water inlet and outlet hoses of the FWD electric drive system assembly.

![](images/673868418fcde9ae19fabd5cd7a20753b0ee47bae85cc87cecf9ed77a31a83dc.webp)

(i) Use the pallet jack to support the front subframe assembly and the FWD electric drive system assembly. Remove 4 bolts and 2 nuts, and remove the front subframe assembly and FWD electric drive system assembly.

### 5. Disengage the MSD （ CH-44）
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_62164e4d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(k) Slowly lower the pallet jack and remove the front subframe assembly and FWD electric drive system assembly from the vehicle. Danger: Make sure that there are no wires or hoses on the front electric drive system. Do not touch the vehicle when removing the front electric drive system from the vehicle.
(l) Remove one bolt and disconnect the left mounting assembly of front powertrain from the subframe assembly.

![](images/1eb262ddd0bf7e70371c0dbad95b72a64a68e13ac99ae64ea010bbfc71e05902.webp)

![](images/27e7b36f1375b28a3b0897f0513415ba0460865bb9ed522e6746363984582ace.webp)

(m) Remove one bolt and disconnect the left mounting assembly of front powertrain from the subframe assembly.

![](images/3346059e3ff0570549f05c21432b88df6be59b28af43c95b228f99d6fb445d1e.webp)

(n) Remove one bolt and disconnect the right mounting assembly of front powertrain from the subframe assembly.

(o) Detach front subframe assembly. Tip: Put the FWD electric drive system assembly on a wooden block or the equivalent object, so as to ensure that it is level.
(p) Remove 4 bolts and detach the front powertrain front mounting assembly.

![](images/f3174dd0a822d4c29d9684e31e8548b6ab0c8c0289c2954299077c7a5a0aa8c4.webp)

(q) Remove 4 bolts and detach the front powertrain left mounting assembly.

![](images/9ae7de22192e2d60afc2319326e8e54b5ea115ac8bb869e45a92b478187900bf.webp)

(r) Remove 4 bolts and detach the front powertrain right mounting assembly.

29. Remove the left output shaft oil seal of FWD electric drive system assembly reducer

![](images/e96c8a6aa3c5134fae8d8269f4a8241bbe5bb4fc1f0e5bdf6ac74f11f0e370ae.webp)

(a) Carefully pick out the failed oil seal with a screwdriver. Attention: Please wrap adhesive tape around the head of the screwdriver to avoid collision with the machined surface of the reducer housing.

30. Remove the right output shaft oil seal of FWD electric drive system assembly reducer

![](images/3a99688c46b2c4b096e4bb2dc00a4f8513977ed08386e84056075d613a179c4b.webp)

(a) Carefully pick out the failed oil seal with a screwdriver.

Attention: Please wrap adhesive tape around the head of the screwdriver to avoid collision with the machined surface of the reducer housing.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9ecc5751` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the oil seal of the output shaft on the left side of the reducer of the FWD electric drive system assembly.

![](images/2402b6bcbde684917b9885ce838ed7e227982a6c3d0e8067dc5c988233d81f33.webp)

(a) Use SST (39HS815060A) to press the new oil seal into the oil seal seat of the housing.

Attention:
The press-fitting force shall be uniform, and no abnormalities such as flanging/peeling of the oil seal are allowed. Try to avoid uneven installation or partial impact of the oil seal.

2. Install the oil seal of the output shaft on the right side of the reducer of the FWD electric drive system assembly.

![](images/91bb3156c35f2e9f1e8b6fe841cb3ccc3a7ed91688da10521590ddd2330afe7b.webp)

(a) Use SST (39HS815060A) to press the new oil seal into the oil seal seat of the housing. Attention: The press-fitting force shall be uniform, and no abnormalities such as flanging/peeling of the oil seal are allowed. Try to avoid uneven installation or partial impact of the oil seal.

3. Install the FWD electric drive system assembly.

![](images/eda65c371e5ca2ae952c06bc5fe3c5d22a9e7e72407718f396b07282a8a22890.webp)

(a) Install the front powertrain right mounting assembly with 4 bolts. Torque: 65\~75N·m

(b) Install the front powertrain left mounting assembly with 4 bolts. Tip: Do not tighten the bolts directly, but keep them loose.

![](images/222b6df3547fc4abcab60b118fda68b5824dadadfa87dabcd3162cde370b0d19.webp)

(c) Install the front powertrain front mounting assembly with 4 bolts. Torque: 65\~75N·m

(d) Install the front sub-frame assembly. Tip: Put the FWD electric drive system assembly on a wooden block or the equivalent object, so as to ensure that it is level.
(e) Connect the right mounting assembly of front powertrain to the subframe assembly with one bolt.

![](images/09b29f40a0af117cb5e84e43a6269aac7b9d1c6166d64d0c728ace4fd82b69ac.webp)

Torque: 170-190N·m

![](images/3bdc26c9e36f71f1d73a2d48b48426d86d44c2ea9ad2a762bc13e19e9a36ac24.webp)

(f) Connect the left mounting assembly of front powertrain to the subframe assembly with one bolt.

Torque: 170-190N·m

![](images/b9e2cbf83ff88ec9ce68e1093797a05d4d2eb42b05bd95fc09460a7573b01862.webp)

(g) Connect the front mounting assembly of front powertrain to the subframe assembly with one bolt.

Torque: 170-190N·m

![](images/59689857dc8b58056f66f86f33dc3769584ad15362cd1c35a5672f9395feb463.webp)

(h) Fasten 4 fixing bolts of the left suspension assembly of front powertrain. Torque: 65\~75N·m

(i) Lower the pallet jack and install the front subframe and front electric drive system on the vehicle.

Danger:
Do not touch the vehicle when lifting the front subframe and front electric drive system to the vehicle.

![](images/2d5c61ce62e684502b07cba94847d5ba08831f5ea337b98d1fda54f1b8d2f2d6.webp)

( j) Install the front subframe assembly and the FWD electric drive system assembly with 4 bolts and 2 nuts. Tip: Bolts and nuts are disposable parts and cannot be reused.

Torque: 130-230N·m

![](images/239e487064cf1b0619341b6fb76bcfd45e708c914f701a5d5842c749864432a8.webp)

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c00faead` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(k) Install the water inlet and outlet hoses of the FWD electric drive system assembly with 2 clips.

![](images/e8f2522bf30e4ea985ce395f213332bdb0fa3d70f92cecbb719657e88e533ee2.webp)

(l) Install the compressor bracket with 6 bolts. Torque: 22-28N·m

![](images/a34f16eeda2f0dd1df0ea39839fe872a561bd0aacf745d7cebc2955ef504141e.webp)

(m) Connect the front DC bus high-voltage harness connector.

![](images/599ff73af6f8f4b4bbf3b51f0dc8bb009a96c45346c3d4865984e4a2da1cfd6f.webp)

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ca891121` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance.
(b) High-voltage protection shall be performed during maintenance.

### Danger:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_addcc108` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Before maintaining the high-voltage system or approaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefully read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

### 3. Precautions for troubleshooting.
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7b99b0ff` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Read BMS DTC in the IG On state. If it cannot be read, try to read the relevant information of other controllers such as HCU. If only BMS information cannot be read, troubleshoot the low-voltage harness of the power battery.

(b) Method for troubleshooting the low-voltage harness of the vehicle: connect the battery, place the ignition switch at IG On (non-ready), and measure the vehicle side harness of the battery low-voltage connector. The normal state is as follows: The voltage of pins 1 and 18 is equal to the battery voltage and greater than 9V; the voltage of pins 8 and 18 is equal to the battery voltage and greater than 9V; the resistance between pins 4 and 5 is 120Ω. If it is abnormal, perform further troubleshooting according to the guide for maintenance of the vehicle harness; if it is normal, check the internal harness of the power battery.

![](images/a5ad83b35cba16d14f9c28214be820130d1240148257587e8e7de03d137667d1.webp)

(c) If the harness is normal, replace the BCU, and update the program to retest. (If there is still no response, change back to the original BCU, and replace the internal low-voltage relay of the power battery.)
(d) After reading the DTC successfully, save all DTCs and corresponding fault snapshots.
(e) If there are faults of different severity levels (such as "alarm" and "fault"), they shall be screened according to the most serious level (fault).
(f) Method of clearing DTC: Perform the clear instructions and then ignition off (IG Off), and hold for over 10 minutes in the IG Off; Other precautions: (1) Only when it is displayed as a historical fault, the fault can be cleared immediately; (2) For thermal runaway fault (P1DBC00), insulation fault (P1D8D1A), collision fault (P1DA300, P1DA400), SOH too low alarm (P1DCE00) and other special latch faults, "current and historical faults" will still be displayed after troubleshooting. At the moment, it is only required to execute the normal clearing action. Although the read DTC still exists after clearing, turn off the engine, wait for 10 minutes, and the DTC can be cleared; (3) If the DTC is cleared without ignition off and waiting for 10 minutes, and the battery is disconnected during the period, the DTC will not be effectively cleared.

(g) The overall method for troubleshooting false connection of the low-voltage harness is as follows: Check the connector for looseness,

and check the terminal for corrosion and withdrawal; check the crimp terminal for looseness; shake the harness and the connector, and observe the sampling value reported by BMS for fluctuation; (h) When using the scan tool to read the DTC, if "current fault and historical fault" are displayed, it indicates that the fault is occurring. If "historical faults" is displayed, it indicates that the fault has occurred before and is not occurring at present;

4. The troubleshooting tool mainly includes scan tool, insulation meter and multimeter.

### 1. Function overview
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_efd876ca` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The distributed power battery management system is responsible for the monitoring and management of lithium-ion power battery, monitoring the status of power batteries, ensuring the performance and safety of battery system, meeting the communication requirements of vehicle control, and controlling the execution unit such as HV contactor.
(b) The HV distribution box contains 5 HV relays, 1 pre-charging resistor and 2 current sensors, which are responsible for outputting the total battery voltage and the sampled voltage at the external contacts of the HV relays to the BCU.

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2c454d05` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When the BCU detects a high temperature of the battery module, the BCU will record the DTC.

![](images/fbc913b7284aab03c2a2382c3c66f16493300670cd7a11b76d423880ed6ebb06.webp)

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_95483fbf` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Note: After reading the DTC successfully, save all DTCs and corresponding fault snapshots (freeze frames). Such DTCs are analyzed in two cases: the current faults are detected according to method I; the historical faults are detected according to method 2.

Method 1:

![](images/9cbc1bf9039b5aa8b0ca26e82f1297b4c307c42d59308c1910419d2cdee3c4e0.webp)

(a) Leave the vehicle fully stationary for more than 10 hours at room temperature.
(b) If the difference between the current maximum temperature and the minimum temperature is greater than 5°C, and the maximum temperature point has the position same as the temperature point in the fault snapshot, the faulty module will be located according to the temperature point.
(c) Locate the faulty module according to the temperature point.

Normal

(a) Check whether the harness and connector are damaged or broken.
(b) Check whether the harness and connector are short-circuited or open-circuited.

Repair or replace the harnesses and connector

Normal

![](images/575ab7a606a129478c7e6e59c2859d7aa9e7241daa056cafd76b02a3ec91560e.webp)

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_537b0c40` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_dcbee764` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Note: After reading the DTC successfully, save all DTCs and corresponding fault snapshots (freeze frames). If this fault occurs alone, it is mostly the DTC recorded during the charging phase due to the insulation failure of the charging pile.

![](images/a0d1ae524c7e2cd729a854b5cc4e7f3c8c249476c597691941ad421aa15f2862.webp)

(a) Disconnect the charging gun.
(b) Connect the HQ-VDS scan tool.
(c) Set the ignition switch to "ON”
(d) Read DTC.
(e) Clear the DTC
(f) Shut down the engine and wait for 10min before starting
(g) Check again for the following DTCs.

![](images/0b818cb74a5b7e918a2375a96997eb99dafeb75813339b04da6a5f6f72ad5898.webp)

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_bb9e8108` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Note: After reading the DTC successfully, save all DTCs and corresponding fault snapshots (freeze frames). 1. If the vehicle is in a severe condition when the problem occurs, no treatment will be performed. 2. Such DTCs are analyzed in two cases: the current faults are detected according to method 1; the historical faults are detected according to method 2.

Method 1:

![](images/67edb754ab59b6f37162bd943209c1a0e8f1705d9cdc801731c57ab0218fc979.webp)

(a) Leave the vehicle fully stationary for more than 10 hours at room temperature.
(b) Locate the faulty module according to the temperature point.

### 2 Check the harness and connector (screening module-sampling sub-board)
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c9c0533c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check whether the harness and connector are damaged or broken.
(b) Check whether the harness and connector are short-circuited or open-circuited.

Repair or replace the harnesses and connector

Normal

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_607ebce8` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Disconnect the connector of the battery module.
(b) Check the sub-board resistance of the battery module.

### Standard value
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7d72cb60` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/d1e30faaa846809b1b2eec039b6faef8c3c4fbce8d10b639d9d1190a6672264c.webp)

Method 2: Screen the sampling problems

Normal

![](images/025576973dea9569f5fe0b1211dd7a261809e544239b52cdb4d659d69678dd44.webp)

(a) Leave the vehicle fully stationary for more than 10 hours at room temperature.
(b) If the difference between the current maximum temperature and the minimum temperature is greater than 5°C, and the maximum temperature point has the position same as the temperature point in the fault snapshot, the faulty module will be located according to the temperature point.
(c) Locate the faulty module according to the temperature point.

Normal

Method 2: If there is no sampling problem, it shall not be reused before the problem is solved.

Normal

![](images/e77a77f020eddc4a39ae3382dfcb237dbc7a0a2d7cad1f29f62ae08266efdac3.webp)

(a) Replace the module according to the position with the maximum temperature. (b) Check the A/C system for normal working.

Repair according to the fault

![](images/7703dbde907ca0b2f1fda2e286710f9c180b4165b9ae639f66786ca6697d6679.webp)

(a) Check whether the coolant has deteriorated.
(b) Check whether the coolant level is normal.
(c) Check the coolant for leakage or blocking.
(d) Check whether the cooling water pump of the battery works normally.
(e) Check whether the high-pressure water heater PTC starts abnormally.
(f) Check whether the water pipe fixing strap is connected reliably.
(g) Check whether the water cooling plates are installed incorrectly.
(h) Check whether the module and the water cooling plate have indentations.

Repair according to the fault

Normal

Check the coating condition of the thermal conductive adhesive of the power 11 battery.

(a) Check whether the thermal conductive adhesive of the power battery is evenly applied.
(b) Check whether there are large-area voids in the thermal conductive adhesive.
(c) Check the thermal conductive adhesive for deterioration.
(d) Check whether the amount of the thermal conductive adhesive applied is sufficient.

Apply the adhesive again

### 1. Cautions for storage of scrapped power battery
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7e254f3d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) It is forbidden to put waste power batteries in the open field to prevent the waste batteries from being exposed to rain.
(b) For bulk storage of waste lithium-ion batteries, the containers used in storage facilities shall ensure that the storage requirements are met and ensure the integrity of the waste lithium-ion battery casing, adverse effects on the environment shall be eliminated, and a safety management and emergency response mechanism for dangers shall be established.
(c) The waste battery shall be stored in a clean and well-ventilated environment.
(d) Do not place in direct sunlight areas.
(e) Keep away from heat sources that can heat up the power battery by 60 degrees.
(f) The waste battery must be placed flat in the packing box.
(g) Do not drop the power battery to avoid surface impact.

2. Cautions for transportation of scrapped power battery

(a) The scrapped power battery shall be subject to sorted collection and transportation by using special containers that meet national standards according to its type.
(b) The container for storing and transporting the power battery shall be designed according to the power battery characteristics and be less liable to damage or deformation, and the materials used can effectively prevent leakage and diffusion.
(c) The container for storing the waste power battery must be affixed with the classification mark required by the national standard.
(d) Before and during the packaging and transportation of waste power battery, complete structure shall be ensured and the battery shall not be broken or crushed, so as to prevent leakage and pollution due to harmful components in the battery.

### 3. Cautions for prevention and control of waste power battery pollution
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_17700f36` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The collection, transportation, dismantling, regeneration and smelting of lithium battery require strict compliance with the above requirements.
(b) Lithium battery shall be recycled instead of any other disposal methods.
(c) Lithium battery shall be managed as hazardous waste.
(d) During the collection and transportation of lithium battery, the casing shall be kept intact to prevent environmenta pollution due to liquid leakage.

### 4. Recycling standard
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_01adaf2c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The power battery assembly as dangerous product shall be recycled by special recycling agency, and individual disposal of the power battery assembly privately shall be not be allowed.

5. Maintenance requirements (a) The battery samples shall be maintained every three months. The maintenance battery cell and module shall be carried out in accordance with the requirements for "discharge capacity at room temperature" in GB/T 31486, and the maintenance of battery assembly shall be carried out in accordance with the requirements for "standard cycle" in GB/T 31467.1 and GB/T 31467.2.

### 6. Transportation requirements
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c0ceacb2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Air transportation: the battery shall be subjected to the UN 38.3 test.
(b) Land transportation: the power battery system shall be deemed as general cargo in case of domestic land transportation. The logistics company only needs to hold a road transport permit.

Wear protective gloves.

### 1. Check the high-voltage power battery for the following:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8587145e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Whether there are cracks on the upper box or lower box of the high-voltage power battery.
(b) Whether there are deformations about the upper box or lower box of the high-voltage power battery.
(c) Whether there are color changes and the faded color of housing due to the temperature.
(d) Whether there are electrolyte overflows.
(e) Whether the high-voltage contacts are damaged.
(f) Whether the information and warning labels are provided, and whether they are legible (if provided).
(g) Whether there is any damage as a result of corrosion.

2. After visual inspection, conduct diagnosis of the high-voltage power battery.

### Operation steps
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_55c08353` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Note:

Conduct sealing test on the high-voltage power battery every time it is opened. Conduct tool sealing detection and cleaning before conducting sealing test on high-voltage power battery. 1. Sealing test on the high-voltage power battery

![](images/d8a9968a5a6c5712ab7696d0b5bb58a6864fef5955665afe5e99b537c1cbdf04.webp)

(a) Install the battery pack breather valve sealing tool 1 SST (9503780HA01) on the power battery explosion-proof valve.

(b) Install the battery low-voltage harness testing connector 1 SST (9503765HA01) on the power battery low-voltage connector interface.

(c) Install the battery high-voltage harness testing connector 4 SST (9503755HA01) on the power battery distribution box output connector interface.

(d) Install the battery high-voltage harness testing connector 2 SST (9503745HA01) on the front DC bus harness high-voltage connector interface.

![](images/ac96471f1bd74b64831fb4355e31356261e47055cb00cf648bf6e9b6aedbb24c.webp)

(e) Install the battery high-voltage harness testing connector 3 SST (9503750HA01) on the DC charging harness high-voltage connector interface.

(f) Install the battery high-voltage harness testing connector 1 SST (9503740HA01) on the rear DC bus harness high-voltage connector interface.

(g) Pressurize the high-voltage power battery Note:

Install the inspection toolsand pressurize
by around 4 kpa.
The detection time is around 200 S when
the air pressure becomes stable.
The flow loss of the display flow gauge shall
be less than 10 sccm. The flow loss exceeds
10 sccm (suspected leakage).
Note: If the pressure reduction exceeds specified value, it indicates a leak. If the leakage surely exists, conduct a leakage detection PB-162）

### 1. Conduct sealing detection of the high-voltage power battery cooling system

![](images/a5bc7a313015c22a276adc413e3c814dfd82eedc2653ca060f364ce2d4c03cb0.webp)

(a) Connect the SST (9503735HA01) battery pack liquid cooling system detection tools with the high-voltage power battery cooling system outlet pipe.

(b) Connect the SST (9503735HA01) testing kit with the high-voltage power battery cooling system inlet pipe. Note:

Pressurize the installation and inspection
tools by around 240 kpa.
The detection time is around 60 S when the
air pressure becomes stable.
The flow loss of the display flow gauge shall
be less than 4 sccm. The flow loss exceeds
4 sccm (suspected leakage).
Note: If the pressure reduction exceeds specified value, it indicates a leak. If the leakage surely exists, conduct a leakage detection PB-162）

### Operation steps
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2cf7f5d9` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Identify the leakage by adopting the leakage inspection method generally used in the market

Gas leak inspection agent is generally used in the market.
Maintain the inner pressureof the high-voltage power battery.
Slowly spray the gas leak inspection agent around the bonding clearance and the seals, and pay
attention to observing the bonding clearance and seals. There would be bubbles on the leakage points if leakage exists.

Identify the possible leaking parts.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ef37464e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Danger:
HV vehicle grid may be life-threatening.
Electric shock may cause death or serious physical injury. Wear arc-tested clothing.
Wear an insulated helmet with facial protection.
Wear insulating gloves.
Wear insulating shoes.
Cut off the voltage of HV vehicle grid by qualified personnel.

Note:

All operations performed on the dismantled
high-voltage power battery need the assistance of another qualified person. The second person should provide safety protection in case of accidents instead of performing active work on the high-voltage power battery!
Before dismantling the high-voltage power battery, a report must be made. It is forbidden to work on the high-voltage power battery without
authorization.

1. Remove the high-voltage power battery from the vehicle.

2. Test if the high-voltage power battery assembly insulation resistance is ≥2.5MΩ.

![](images/462ef2d2208518155717b7308a685f075be2f10a651841cc5c2250553f7e8859.webp)

3. Remove the high-voltage power battery upper box (only applicable to vehicles equipped with 245 KW RWD electric drive system)

(a) Remove 6 large fixing nuts on the high-voltage power battery upper box.

(b) Remove 6 fixing bolts and 6 seal rings at middle of the high-voltage power battery intermediate upper box.

(c) Remove 88 fixing bolts and 2 nuts A on the high-voltage power battery assembly upper box.

(d) Remove the high-voltage power battery assembly upper box.

4 Remove the high-voltage power battery fireproof plate (only applicable to vehicles equipped with 245 KW RWD electric drive system)

![](images/40634579104db436916d5e2cc1c2e99b6a1648b41745bb835844a3c4eb3c2720.webp)

(a) Remove the high-voltage power battery fireproof plates 1, 2 and 3.

5. Remove the high-voltage power battery upper box (only applicable to vehicles equipped with 160 KW RWD electric drive system)

(a) Remove 4 large fixing nuts on the high-voltage power battery upper box.

![](images/7e67633b26817a8aee2b6a8cbde74a2980a6cd4d9ad2e57dfd0f4162cd5a554d.webp)

(b) Remove 4 fixing bolts and 4 seal rings at middle of the high-voltage power battery intermediate upper box.

![](images/50ce621594d35c5445a203ee8d41bff5b5eaaf4f2df65a96741bee495c8bf80d.webp)

(c) Remove 80 fixing bolts and 2 nuts A on the high-voltage power battery assembly upper box.

(d) Remove the high-voltage power battery assembly upper box.

6. Remove the high-voltage power battery fireproof plate (only applicable to vehicles equipped with 160 KW RWD electric drive system)

![](images/e160ccccd000cae20a7e4d047a86dba93003477023c3810bfae76cb9ced7b5b0.webp)

(a) Remove the high-voltage power battery fireproof plates 1 and 2.

7. Test the high-voltage and insulation property（ PB-159）
8. HV power battery power-off PB-170）
9. Interrupt the circuit when conducting follow-upsteps on the high-voltage power battery.（PB-199）

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b8361a2f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
Apply paint after the fastener torque is calibrated.1. Connect the circuit（ PB-201）

2. HV power battery power-on （ PB-172）

3. Remove the high-voltage power battery fireproof plate (only applicable to vehicles equipped with 245 KW RWD electric drive system) Attention: Check if the fireproof plate locating position is right during installation. Pay attention to removing the double-sided adhesive stickers.

![](images/6b42f85a7df8494f694777bfbd9e766b1d0f6c794d9c1f50fc3d0d1a3c2b8143.webp)

(a) Install the fireproof plates 1 and 2, remove the double-sided adhesive stickers from the fireproof plate 3 and then paste them to the corresponding positions on fireproof plates 1 and 2.

4 Install the high-voltage power battery upper box (only applicable to vehicles equipped with 245 KW RWD electric drive system) Attention: Confirm whether the sealant in the upper box groove is complete without damage. Confirm that the seal rings are inserted in the upper box fixing ring. (a) Put the upper box assembly above the lower box assembly, adjust the position of upper box, and use the lower box locating pins to locate the upper box and lower box assembly.

![](images/57c34b559c6931c9ef61ae27d3b9369d4ce749cd495441833c0cfadd3d225e35.webp)

![](images/e736874d18e960f72577ffd464c43224c55a4875fa70f8437f66fe41211feaf7.webp)

(b) Install 2 nuts A and 88 fixing bolts on the high-voltage power battery assembly upper box.

Torque: 5.5-6.5N·m

(c) Install 6 seal rings and 6 fixing bolts at the middle of the high-voltage power battery upper box.

Torque: 5.5-6.5N·m

(d) Install 6 large fixing nuts on the high-voltage power battery upper box. Torque: 60-70N·m

5. Install high-voltage power battery fireproof plate (only applicable to vehicles equipped with 160 KW RWD electric drive system) Attention: Check if the fireproof plate locating position is right during installation. Pay attention to removing the double-sided adhesive stickers.

![](images/7a54ec097a96bdfd7daf9989588001f0fe23f457a3c88b67836cd68076633805.webp)

(a) Install the fireproof plate 1, remove double-sided adhesive sticker of the fireproof plate 2 and then paste it to the corresponding position on the fireproof plate.

6. Install the high-voltage power battery upper box (only applicable to vehicles equipped with 160 KW RWD electric drive system)

Attention:
Confirm whether the sealant in the upper box groove is complete without damage.
Confirm that the seal rings are inserted in the upper box fixing ring.

(a) Put the upper box assembly above the lower box assembly, adjust the position of upper box, and use the lower box locating pins to locate the upper box and lower box assembly.

![](images/449f534b346f963ad231f6fe1510e6d5e14b24ab5c6ae5179a8600efb199a2b8.webp)

(b) Install 2 nuts A and 80 fixing bolts on the high-voltage power battery assembly upper box.

Torque: 5.5-6.5N·m

![](images/347a153dd319e82455582ccbea7acf950cddb351e8a18b13ca06c3a6f5439b47.webp)

(c) Install 4 seal rings and 4 fixing bolts at the middle of the high-voltage power battery upper box.

(d) Install 4 large fixing nuts on the high-voltage power battery upper box. Torque: 60-70N·m

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ef37464e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Danger:
HV vehicle grid may be life-threatening.
