Wear insulating gloves.
Wear insulating shoes.

Cut off the voltage of HV vehicle grid by qualified personnel.

1. Remove the upper box of HV powerbattery （PB-163）

2. Remove the HV power battery fireproof board（PB-163）

3. Power off the high-voltage power battery (a) Remove 2 bolts and disconnect the inter-module connecting bar Ⅱ assembly.

![](images/70f6e70f025739ed01df0efd1ca0ec755838db157310ac5067411508aead3fa2.webp)

Attention:
After removal, use the insulated adhesive tape to wrap them up.

![](images/c2a6605a21bbfc80758f8ceec2273feef22dc00e78bc422177dcf316863249be.webp)

(b) Disengage the inter-module connecting bar Ⅱ assembly from the intermediate fixing bracket.

![](images/1689522882b0279e4f52695febffd4d3e8cad376acad24161a7dce2b933c1459.webp)

(c) Disengage 4 pasting clips to remove the inter-module connecting bar Ⅱ assembly.

Remove the positive input terminal block assembly fron the HV distribution box

![](images/b254c44afe459f457681d35f838664bbd26502e247da0c76168797f9e11e39c0.webp)

(a) Remove 1 bolt and 1 nut to detach the high-voltage distribution box input positive connecting bar assembly.

![](images/70c37863bd31836edc9f0b6c1956247c57721945dc6d9d032a8b8c67d0ce0c4d.webp)

![](images/5688a0861b194e5d07865d5f7184865835d36d227dbf11707132407dd24a92ea.webp)

(c) Remove 12 bolts to detach 6 inter-module connecting bar Ⅰ assemblies. Tip: For vehicles equipped with 160 KW RWD electric drive system, install 4 inter-module connecting bar Ⅰ assemblies.

5. When conducting other operations, cover the positions without high-voltage power battery handling.

![](images/98fb3b0e9934f6abff93021e38861c2993a5c33a0c9e92861e5013f192efc7c3.webp)

### Power on
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_06b523d0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the positive input terminal block assembly fron the HV distribution box (a) Use 12 bolts to install 6 inter-module connecting bar Ⅰ assemblies.

Torque: 8-10N·m

Tip: For vehicles equipped with 160 KW RWD electric drive system, install 4 inter-module connecting bar Ⅰ assemblies.

![](images/91c4bea57608649eba103c5da36ab68001889f5ad18b702501e19514753dea87.webp)

![](images/5f23dbe41d631bc83a642f4172760a83b439fad8633394323e1034c3f3880b08.webp)

(c) Use 1 bolt and 1 nut to install the high-voltage distribution box input negative connecting bar assembly. Torque: 8-10N·m

2. Power on the high-voltage power battery (a) Use 4 pasting clips to install the inter-module connecting bar Ⅱ assembly. Tip: Make sure to remove the stickers on the pasting clips.

![](images/a31a5b70f74bfdcbc07c596ca833e10ad3575a997bb0aef2382a65dbb98d89f7.webp)

![](images/6951dfede02e7b6bc700ed5c84660f732e5ff9bf2193389c31fe14f2f712937a.webp)

![](images/ed57b725362abdf19bc331262077363c1ef9b2a5b118ede1b3d013003f7158f6.webp)

(c) Use 2 bolts to install the inter-module connecting bar Ⅱ assembly.

Torque: 7-9N·m

Attention:

Remove the insulated adhesive tape during installation.

3. Perform a diagnostic test on the HV powerbattery （ PB-163）
1 Install the HV power battery fireproofboard （ PB-166）
5. Install the upper box of HV powerbattery （PB-166） 1

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ef37464e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Danger:
HV vehicle grid may be life-threatening.

Wear an insulated helmet with facial protection.
Wear insulating gloves.
Wear insulating shoes.
Cut off the voltage of HV vehicle grid by qualified personnel.

Note:

All operations performed on the dismantled
high-voltage power battery need the assistance of another qualified person. The second person should provide safety protection in case of accidents instead of performing active work on the high-voltage power battery!
Before dismantling the high-voltage power battery, a report must be made. It is forbidden to work on the high-voltage power battery without
authorization.
1. Remove the upper box of HV power battery PB-163）

6. Remove the high-voltage power battery module assembly. Tip: For vehicles equipped with 245 KW RWD electric drive system, install 14 high-voltage power battery module assemblies. For vehicles equipped with 160 KW RWD electric drive system, install 12 high-voltage power battery module assemblies. The removal orders of all high-voltage power battery module assemblies are the same. (a) Disconnect the harness connectors of the high-voltage power battery module assembly.

![](images/d7e4af2705b0eb23de5be3b5d45cc85413513cc3f6e4d7a8a348f8895399651b.webp)

(b) Remove the protective covers at both ends of the high-voltage copper wires. Tip: The removal orders of all protective covers at both ends of the high-voltage copper wires are the same.

![](images/c85d8b6e9eb20ed67ac2766d3fbe0719f75988e9e6c9a7fea855186c6ccddb94.webp)

(c) Remove 2 bolts to detach the high-voltage copper wires. Tip: The removal orders of all high-voltage copper wires are the same.

![](images/8910d4be869437fd058e3c3eac4f0bc16a16b3b5c90f5e339352185c8f96dca2.webp)

(d) Remove the protective covers at both ends of the high-voltage copper wires. Tip: The removal orders of all protective covers at both ends of the high-voltage copper wires are the same.

![](images/09a7130b6081bd83c6f4ef0ff174e250c5ec12dc848554fdb8aa20e205687f2f.webp)

(e) Remove 2 bolts to detach the high-voltage copper wires. Tip: The removal orders of all high-voltage copper wires are the same.

![](images/230bff3fdcdfd2156a15992843d475ecaa03862594f8f43e6406ec5f61a1cda4.webp)

Please read the precautions for HV related operations (inspection and maintenance of HV systems) carefully before carrying out the following work, and follow the precautions strictly!

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5ca68f7d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

If the operation of disconnecting the high-voltage loop is not performed correctly before disassembling the vehicle, it may cause serious electric shock accident or even death. Even after the high-voltage circuit is disconnected, the high-voltage battery still contains high-voltage electricity. It is forbidden to touch the high-voltage battery shell and its interior with bare hands.

### Caution:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a5dabc96` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Ifthe vehicle iscon ected to a charginggun, the charging gun shal be unplug ed first. The high-voltagecapacitors n high-voltage components such asmotor controlers and DC/DC stil retain some ofthe electrical energy after the high-voltage system s powered of. The residual electrical energywil be reduced to below 60 VDC within 2 minutes, and wil be fulydischarged within 5 minutes. Afterthe MSD is unlocked, placingtheignitionswitch in the START (READY) position maycause a fault.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_09a477ac` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Please read the precautions for HV related operations (inspection and maintenance of HV systems) carefully before carrying out the following work, and follow the precautions strictly!

1. Check the battery condition Attention: If the battery is low, recharge the battery and check it again before returning the vehicle to the customer.

(a) Check the battery for damage and deformation, and replace it if serious damage, deformation or leakage is found.

(b) Check the battery voltage.

(1) Place the ignition switch in the OFF position and turn on the headlights for 20 to 30 seconds, which will remove the surface charge from the battery.

![](images/01f94c66179139cefa1eff149396996f1cb9e52771d594e3182720312e1e8a05.webp)

Tip: If the result does not comply with the regulations, recharge the battery or replace it.

(c) Check the leakage current

(1) Confirm that the ignition is in the OFF position (key removed from the vehicle) and that all doors are closed.
(2) Disconnect the negative terminal (-) of the battery.
(3) Connect a multimeter between the positive battery terminal and the negative battery (-) terminal and measure the leakage current after the vehicle has been stationary for 15 minutes or after the vehicle has been locked for 1 minute. If it is not within the specified range, remove the fuse box and the fuses in the fuse box one by one, while measuring the leakage current. Tip: If the battery has not been stationary for 15 minutes, the multimeter will show a higher value (approx. 300 mA). If the key or any electrical accessory is operated within approximately 15 minutes after the multimeter has been connected, the battery must stand still for approximately 15 minutes from this moment. Caution: Poweroperation while measuring leakagecurentwil damage the multimeter.

Batery leakage curent: ≤20mA. (to be confirmed)

(4) Check and repair the fuse harnesses and connectors that show reduced current.

(d) Re-charge the battery (1) After the battery is charged, make sure the voltage is within the specified range and remains at the same value for 1 hour or more after charging is completed. Standard voltage: 11-14 V Tip: If the voltage is lower than 11 V, replace the battery.

(e) Determination of battery performance (recommended to use Midtronics tester) (1 Connect the battery. 1 Wipe the positive/negative terminals of the battery clean. 2. Connect the red wire clip to the positive terminal of the battery. 3. Connect the black wire clip to the negative terminal of the battery. 4. The display will automatically light up to show the battery voltage, then press the Enter key.

(2) Select the parameter.

![](images/d503138733cee722237024b5ba032a0b4a77387f84da9041925a4dbb9d3795f3.webp)

(3) Results display

1. Press the Enter key, and the Midtronics tester tests the battery.
2. When the test is completed, the screen will display: battery voltage

and CCA battery are judged to be good. 3. Finally, the test results are printed out.

2. Check the battery terminals, battery status sensor assembly and fuses

### 3. Removal and installation of battery terminal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_478176bd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Before disassembling and repairing electrical components, disconnect the negative (-) terminal of the battery to prevent the system from short-circuiting.
(b) Before disconnecting or reconnecting battery cable terminals, first turn off the power (ignition) switch and lighting switch, and then completely loosen or tighten the battery cable terminal nuts.
(c) When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### Precautions for troubleshooting
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5714d164` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Read EVCC DTC in the IG On state; if it cannot be read, try to read the relevant information of other controllers such as HCU. If only EVCC information cannot be read, only screen the low-voltage harness of EVCC. Method for troubleshooting the low-voltage harness of the vehicle: connect the battery, place the ignition switch at IG On (non-ready), and measure the low-voltage power supply of

EVCC. The normal state is as follows: IG supply voltage is equal to battery voltage and greater than 8.5V, and B+ supply voltage is equal to battery voltage and greater than 9V; the terminal resistance of the charging CAN is 120Ω; the non-terminal resistance of EV CAN is 60Ω; in case of any exception, further troubleshoot the vehicle harness;
(b) After reading the DTC successfully, save all DTCs and corresponding fault snapshots;
(c) If there are faults of different severity levels (such as "alarm" and "fault"), they shall be screened according to the most serious level (fault);
(d) Method of clearing the DTC: Perform the clear instructions and then ignition off (IG Off), and hold for over 10 minutes in the IG Off state; (1) Only when it is displayed as a historical fault, the fault can be cleared immediately; (2) If the DTC is cleared without ignition off and waiting for 10 minutes, and the battery is disconnected during the period, the DTC will not be effectively cleared.
(e) The overall method for troubleshooting false connection of the low-voltage harness is as follows: Check the connector for looseness, and check the terminal for corrosion and withdrawal; check the crimp terminal for looseness; shake the harness and the connector, and observe the sampling value reported by EVCC for fluctuation;
(f) When using the scan tool to read the DTC, if "current fault and historical fault" are displayed, it indicates that the fault is occurring. If "historical faults" is displayed, it indicates that the fault has occurred before and is not occurring at present.

### Description

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6167a8db` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When working near the electric cooling fan or the radiator grille, make sure that the ignition switch is set to the OFF position. When the ignition switch is set to the ON (IG) position, if the coolant temperature of the electric drive system assembly becomes high or the A/C is turned on, the electric cooling fan may automatically start to work.

### 1. Check the coolant for leakage
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0b9b2fcc` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:

To avoid burns, do not remove the expansion tank pressure cover while the electric drive assembly and the radiator assembly are still hot. Thermal expansion may cause hot coolant and steam of the electric drive system assembly to overflow out of the expansion tank. (a) Fill the expansion tank with coolant, and then connect the cooling system test pressure gauge SST (39GV210540B).

![](images/5dc97e1fcaf085dabc28e2883e9dfe6c97aa0618f2199d767336f273cefbf6be.webp)

(b) Set the pump pressure to 180kPa, then check that the pressure has not dropped. If the pressure drops, check the hose, radiator assembly, water pump assembly and electric drive system assembly for leakage.

### 2. Check the coolant level of reservoir
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0099f650` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/1661c267d1e2f6140bb2ff59e3e679eb2d1b592a56d0393e5dc969cb97c61e0e.webp)

(a) When the electric drive system assembly is in cold state, the coolant level shall be between the MAX and MIN lines. Tip: If the coolant level of electric drive system assembly is below the MIN scale line, check for leakage and add the vehicle-specific coolant to the MAX line.

3. Check the quality of the coolant

(a) Remove the expansion tank pressure cover. Tip: To avoid burns, do not remove the expansion tank pressure cover while the electric drive system assembly and the radiator assembly are still hot. Thermal expansion may cause hot coolant and steam of the electric drive system assembly to overflow out of the expansion tank.
(b) Check whether there is excessive rust or scale around the expansion tank pressure cover and the expansion tank water filling port. Tip: If it is too dirty, replace the coolant in the electric drive system assembly.
(c) Use a coolant detector to check the freezing point of the coolant, and replace the coolant if it is not within the specified range.

### 1. Empty the coolant
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_821a9ad4` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/2418224397bee980c56be3e9a474f533f49bd757e7ae2dfa0ea88726bcdf3613.webp)

![](images/a25188853f5549938d3ad8da13b67843f85c74fe4c5d14a6307166b0457ea4ff.webp)

(a) Connect the scan tool HQ-VDS/select the vehicle model/select the three-way water valve assembly/conduct active test, and open the three-way water valve assembly I.
(b) Detach the motor radiator lower water pipe to drain the coolant. Tip: Collect the coolant in a container and dispose according to the location regulations in your area.

(c) Detach the radiator lower water pipe to drain the coolant. Tip: Collect the coolant in a container and dispose according to the location regulations in your area.

(d) Remove the expansion tank pressure cover. Tip:

Do not remove the expansion tank pressure cover when the electric drive system assembly and radiator have not cooled down. Pressurized hot coolant and steam may be escaped and cause severe burns.

2. Fill in the coolant

![](images/96d795e1d4b58c43ee2d1b2d41ca6104fe23e093a0b1fdf9700cdb7c8c06d965.webp)

(a) Connect the motor radiator lower water pipe.

(b) Connect the battery radiator lower water pipe.

(c) Fill special coolant in the expansion tank filling port.
(d) Standard coolant capacity of motor cooling system:

![](images/a54c6b66f9ddff5a4957536ab3fd65726c10475803e3a5559c00c642e31924e4.webp)

Tip: Do not replace coolant with water. Long-term vehicle coolant (G30-91) is used throughout the year. (e) Standard coolant capacity of battery cooling system:

![](images/2cc57d794120130427eb70fd1e144b052f03d81a5291596b91ab01ae46c7e99b.webp)

Tip:
Do not replace coolant with water.
Long-term vehicle coolant (G30-91) is used throughout the year.

(f) Press the water inlet hose and water outlet hose of the radiator several times by hand to check the coolant level. Tip: If the coolant level is too low, fill in the coolant.

(g) Install the expansion tank pressure cap and start the vehicle.
(h) Connect the scan tool HQ-VDS/select the vehicle model/select electric water pump/conduct active test to circulate the coolant. Tip: If the coolant level is too low, fill in the coolant.
(i) After the electric drive system assembly and radiator are cooled down, check and confirm that the coolant level is between the MAX and MIN marks. Tip: If the coolant level is low, fill in the coolant to the MAX line in the expansion tank.

![](images/aadde9da68aa054a674ae2dd1bd6a95eeb9cc12e762d63800e926becd58f4630.webp)

3. Check the coolant for leakage

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

### 2. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a15375bb` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/a6e070d8b65d4634a1d70628adc8c306c454d7fa170086a24c0ec11383b03367.webp)

3. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

### 4. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c21d7bf2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The check on the electronic shifter control system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the electronic shifter control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door control system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.
(d) During maintenance, handle electronic components (electronic control units, sensors, etc.) carefully to avoid damage caused by impact and static electricity.
(e) Establish the awareness of environmental protection and effectively dispose of the waste generated in the maintenance process.
(f) It is not recommended to use the method of piercing the skin of the wire to detect the electrical signals of the input and output of the components, so as to avoid short-circuiting the harness.

### System description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7770ba65` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Overview of electronic shifter control system (a) Gently operate the shift lever and make sure the shift is operating correctly.

(b) Release the shift lever to reset it after each shift operation.
(c) Initial operation of shift lever: The vehicle adopts electronic gearshift mechanism, which needs to be operated according to the gear information on the instrument cluster information display and the above gear operation instructions, and should not be operated by sense consciousness to avoid danger.
(d) Be sure to shift to P and apply the parking brake: It is very dangerous to shift to P without applying the parking brake. If the P-gear does not fully immobilize the vehicle, it may move and cause an accident.

### 2. Gear shift
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_69501cba` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When the vehicle is in "READY" state, shift the gears as follows.

(a) P to D: Depress the brake pedal, press the unlock button and operate the shift lever downwards to the first or second stroke.
(b) P to N: Depress the brake pedal, press the unlock button and operate the shift lever upwards to the first stroke.
(c) P to R: Depress the brake pedal, press the unlock button and operate the shift lever upwards to the second stroke.
(d) N to D: When the vehicle comes to a standstill, operate the shift lever downwards to the first or second stroke (if the stay time in N gear is more than 1 second, it is necessary to depress the brake pedal to shift; if the stay time in N gear is less than 1 second, it is not necessary to depress the brake pedal to shift).
(e) N to R: When the vehicle comes to a standstill, press the unlock button and operate the shift lever upwards to the first or second stroke (if the stay time in N gear is more than 1 second, it is necessary to depress the brake pedal to shift; if the stay time in N gear is less than 1 second, it is not necessary to depress the brake pedal to shift).
(f) D to N: Operate the shift lever upwards to the first stroke. It is impossible to shift at a speed higher than 50 km/h.
(g) D to R: Depress the brake pedal until the vehicle comes to a standstill, press the unlock button, and operate the shift lever upwards to the second stroke.
(h) R to N: Operate the shift lever downwards to the first stroke.
(i) R to D: Depress the brake pedal until the vehicle comes to a standstill, and operate the shift lever downwards to the second stroke.
( j) N/D/R to P: Depress the brake pedal until the vehicle comes to a standstill and press the P gear button.

### 4. Gear description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e2348b62` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) P (parking) gear: In P gear, the reducer can be locked to prevent the wheels from turning.
(b) R (reverse) gear: In R gear, the vehicle can only move backwards. The vehicle must come to a complete stop before shifting to or from R gear.
(c) N (neutral) gear: In N gear, the motor drive system will be in servo state, and the wheels and transmission system will not be locked. When parking on a gentle slope, depress the brake pedal or apply the parking brake, otherwise the vehicle will slide freely.
(d) D (drive) gear: D gear is a gear usually used during driving to control the vehicle to move forward.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_39d9164e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the shift lever and leather skirt bottom frame assembly （ IP-12）
3. Remove the upper cover （ IP-12）
4. Remove the electronic shifter assembly

![](images/a68cf7d747995bfe4fd01214b1c1aa7dfc9bcce48b1be98450365ea9c111d697.webp)

(a) Remove 4 nuts to detach the electronic shifter assembly. Tip: Do not completely remove the electronic shifter assembly.

(b) Disconnect the harness connector of electronic shifter assembly and remove the electronic shifter assembly.

![](images/e04f5f8c120342307477f68f00542693411399ce176a246c0c2dfd24466bb1ce.webp)

1. Install the electronic shifter assembly (a) Connect the electronic shifter assembly harness connector.

(b) Install the electronic shifter assembly and tighten the 4 nuts.

2. Install the upper cover （ IP-19）

3. Install the shift lever and the leather skirt bottom frame assembly 7 IP-19） Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7ff650ff` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance.

### Danger:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_addcc108` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Before maintaining the high-voltage system or approaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefully read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

2. Power (ignition) switch notation:

![](images/6215c051fbb5dc1a061bbb88e117a22d7a0fc4ef6cfebeea5cf15e3f31682975.webp)

3. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

4. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### 5. General precautions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1721af04` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Do not remove the airbag assembly and pretensioner at will. If necessary, it must be removed and installed by professional maintenance personnel.
(b) Do not change the airbag assembly, pretensioner and their surrounding layout without authorization.
(c) Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery. (1) Check the DTC, then turn off the ignition switch and disconnect the negative terminal of the battery for 90s before starting operation.
(SRS)
(d) When removing and installing the airbag assembly, place the upper surface of the airbag (the side with the mark) upward. When storing, do not pile up the airbag. (If the metal surface of the airbag is placed upwards, once the airbag is accidentally deployed, it will cause a serious accident)
(e) Before electric welding, disconnect the negative terminal of the battery for more than 90s.
(f) Troubleshoot the airbag system in time, otherwise the following serious consequences will occur. One is that the airbag cannot be deployed to provide protection when the vehicle is in a serious impact; the other is that the airbag is suddenly inflated and deployed when the vehicle is in normal operation, causing the undue accidental injury to the driver and passengers, or even a safety accident.
(g) Never measure the resistance of airbag system components. (It may cause the airbag to deploy accidentally, which is very dangerous)
(h) Do not apply grease on the airbag assembly, nor use any type of detergent to clean it.
(i) Avoid accidental bumps and vibrations. The airbag assembly sensor and other components are very sensitive to collisions and impacts. Therefore, collisions and impacts should be avoided as much as possible to reduce the unnecessary sudden deployment of the airbag assembly and pretensioner.
( j) Keep the airbag assembly components in strict accordance with the regulations. The airbag assembly contains inflammable and explosive materials such as gunpowder and squib, which must be transported and kept strictly in accordance with the regulations, otherwise it will cause serious consequences.
(k) When disposing the vehicle or airbag, use a SST to deploy the airbag: (1) It is strictly forbidden to dispose of the airbag in an undeployed state. (2) The airbag and pretensioner should be deployed in a safe and flat place outdoors. Try not to deploy in residential areas.

(3) When the airbag and pretensioner are deployed, the sound is loud, so the surrounding people must be notified in advance.

(l) Pay attention to check every day. Mainly check whether each impact sensor is firmly connected, whether the ground wire is clean and connected firmly, etc.
(m) Use the airbags along with seat belts. Airbags are passive safety devices and can only be used in conjunction with seat belts to obtain a satisfactory safety protection effect. Therefore, the seat belts must be buckled when the vehicle is running.

### 6. Precautions for clock spring
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_cc65bcf0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When installing the clock spring, removing and installing the steering wheel body, align the center point of the clock spring.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c7a1c190` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

If the steering wheel body is not aligned with the center point during the installation and removal of steering wheel body, it may cause the clock spring circuit to open.

(a) The airbag control unit is the core of SRS. It can sense the changes in acceleration of the vehicle during a frontal and side impact, and then control the corresponding deploying components. Thus minimizing the injury to the driver and passengers in the vehicle and achieving the protection.

### 3. Vehicle speed signal receiving function
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2955dc67` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The airbag control unit obtains vehicle speed signal related information via the CAN bus. The airbag contro unit will sample this signal when a impact occurs, and record this signal to the event data recorder (EDR).

### 4. Impact output
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_df1f8e65` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the airbag control unit senses the impact signal and deploys any safety device, for the safety of the occupants and the vehicle, the airbag control unit should send a impact signal to the BCM and EMS to unlock the door lock and cut off the fuel circuit.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_66d06881` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the auxiliary instrument panel assembly （ IP-12）
3. Remove the airbag control unit assembly

![](images/33cc05af91a7937a74fe082fc2486eae698213e5879da96558468d6e065b3550.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of the airbag control unit assembly.

(b) Remove 3 bolts and detach the airbag control unit assembly.

### 1. Install the airbag control unit assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d9c49b98` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/6c25fea21b929a76f9e0daf951e03fab3d7b5211e7286c8ef2fd893bd4595854.webp)

(a) Install the airbag control unit assembly with 3 bolts.

Torque: 8-12N·m

(b) Connect the harness connector of the airbag control unit assembly.

2. Install the console assembly （ IP-19）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a2203312` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The removal sequen ce for the right side is the same as the left side.
1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the B-pillar lower guard （ IR-24）
3. Remove the middle impact acceleration sensor assembly

### assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2895624b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of middle impact acceleration sensor assembly.

![](images/40d19ad80436416ff72ed9b6641790986e73d5304d6b538f82588d5e9f7046bb.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt to detach the middle impact acceleration sensor assembly.

4. Remove the front bumper assembly （ET-1）
5. Remove the front impact acceleration sensor assembly (a) Disconnect the harness connector of the front impact acceleration sensor assembly.

![](images/466455395223c4f8c5879f026b63762ffa8e227ce21c7d0e5c65af5f2ce519a0.webp)

![](images/f9e955293f13399fceded3280121144131dff5cfa1d049d82da42471a3dbe6fe.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt to detach the front impact acceleration sensor assembly.

6. Remove the front impact acceleration sensor assembly bracket

### assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a3db9df2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/8fef25c94439ffb65f2a261784b35571379e01096897fb98a34668c44540b208.webp)

(a) Remove 3 bolts to detach the front impact acceleration sensor assembly bracket.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6b5d1eb1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

![](images/00d6f81e67500f0c30c95bfe3a540c724a2f685ba994f0be4fbb0eadf447bbfa.webp)

1. Install the front impact acceleration sensor assembly bracket (a) Install the front impact acceleration sensor assembly bracket with 3 bolts. Torque: 8-12N·m

2. Install the front impact acceleration sensor assembly

![](images/fff56847d68d161cc88d21784281f1efae3e133ad1ddf9d03ac41602ba9a3c79.webp)

(a) Install the front impact acceleration sensor assembly with one bolt. Torque: 8-12N·m

assembly

![](images/b788e2bb027662ebbb2b2f06ee0554047f9125418eb141c836844a4e0f4b7577.webp)

(b) Connect the harness connector of front impact acceleration sensor assembly.

3. Install the front bumper assembly （ ET-4）

4. Install the middle impact acceleration sensor assembly

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9aa16051` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Be sure to follow the correct steps for removing and installing the steeringwheel trim cover.

1. Check the driver airbag cover (vehicle without impact)

(a) Perform diagnostic system inspection.
(b) Visually inspect for defects with the driver airbag cover installed on the vehicle. (1) The defects are as follows:

Scratches on the surface and the groove of the steering wheel trim cover Small cracks on the surface and the groove of the steering wheel trim cover Obvious discoloration on the surface and the groove of the steering wheel trim cover Tip: If any defects are found, replace the driver airbag cover with a new one.

2. Check the driver airbag cover (vehicle with undeployed airbag in the impact)

(a) Perform diagnostic system inspection (b) Visually inspect for defects with the steering wheel trim cover removed from the vehicle.

(1) The defects are as follows: Scratches on the surface and the groove of the steering wheel trim cover Small cracks on the surface and the groove of the steering wheel trim cover Obvious discoloration on the surface and the groove of the steering wheel trim cover Cracks or other damage on the connector Deformation of steering wheel assembly Deformation of horn button contact plate of the steering wheel trim cover Mutual interference or uneven clearance of the steering wheel trim cover and the steering whee assembly for the installation Tip: If any defects are found, replace the driver airbag cover with a new one.

2. Remove the driver airbag assembly (a) Turn the steering wheel, and use a suitable tool to push back the 3 circlips that engage the driver airbag.

![](images/426a5199e41e9d7d668c9e9014656e11d55add06c689af01aebb9ca996cd30b4.webp)

(b) Disconnect the harness connector of the driver airbag assembly to detach the driver airbag assembly.

6. Remove the right rear door sill guard （IR-67）
7. Remove the B-pillar left lower guard （IR-24）
8. Remove the B-pillar right lower guard （IR-24）
9. Remove the B-pillar left upper guard （IR-24）

### 1. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b49b7214` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/f49a9700a47274fdb8075324b7a186ab58d9f336b9babec0fa9a98a3f5800e84.webp)

2. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### 3. Operation precautions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_25a89353` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance of ESC must be performed by technicians who have received professional training and mastered maintenance skills, and only original parts can be used for replacement.
(b) Unless otherwise specified in the inspection procedure, it is necessary to ensure that the ignition switch is set to the OFF position, to disconnect the negative terminal of the battery, and remove and install the ESCU and sensor.
(c) If the ESCU or sensor has been removed and installed, it is necessary to reassemble the parts and then check whether the system is faulty.
(d) After the electrical components of the electronic stability control unit are repaired, it is necessary to drive the vehicle and accelerate to over 40km/h for dynamic self-test of the electronic stability control system.

### Precautions for troubleshooting
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_28194a86` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) In case of poor contact of terminals or installation failure of parts, removing and installing suspicious parts may restore the system to a normal state completely or temporarily.
(b) Since the system will be affected by failures of other non-ESC systems, it is necessary to check the failures in other systems before confirming the maintenance plan.

(c) Exhaust is required after replacement of brake system components (such as replacement of brake fluid, brake pipeline, hydraulic unit), or when the brake pedal is weak.

### 5. Precautions for failure detection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5fd1709b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The ESC detects a failure in case of the following conditions: (1) Turn the ignition switch to the ON position, and the warning light remains on after the system self-check is completed. (2) When the vehicle is running, the warning light remains on.

(b) After the system detects a failure, the driver can apply normal braking, but the braking force applied must be reduced as much as possible to prevent the wheels from locking. Attention: After the warning light is illuminated, be sure to drive carefully and go to the dealership for inspection and repair immediately to prevent further failures and the resulting traffic accidents.

![](images/1284235de013cbeb92d1aa0e510c50ef0e9c3d65f254666d63bd893eec409306.webp)

6. Precautions for harness connection of the electronic stability control unit and sensors

(a) Before connecting and removing the ESCU harness and sensor harness, the ignition switch must be turned off and the negative termina of the battery must be disconnected.
(b) Ensure that the connector is dry and clean, and avoid any foreign matter from entering the connector.
(c) The connectors of the ESCU harness must be installed in the horizontal and vertical directions to avoid damage to the connectors.

### 1. System overview
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b5eef39e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The electronic stability control system is an active safety system. It is mainly used to maximize the ground adhesion and maintain the maneuverability and driving stability of the vehicle.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_21797db1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

If the physical limit is exceeded or when driving at high speed on wet and slippery roads, ESC cannot completely prevent the vehicle from slipping.

Tip: Before diagnosing the electronic stability control system, check the easily accessible components that may cause system failure of the electronic stability control system. Performing visual inspections and appearance inspections can quickly identify certain faults, eliminating the need for further diagnosis.

### 2. Initial inspection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_16d00266` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check the tires of the vehicle to ensure that the vehicle is fitted with tires and hubs of the recommended size. The model and depth of pattern for coaxial tires must be the same.
(b) Check the ESC hydraulic regulator, brake pipeline and connections for leaks.
(c) Check that the fuse of the ESC system is not burnt out and of the correct type.
(d) Measure the battery voltage and check whether the battery terminals are corroded or loose.
(e) Check whether the ground point of the ESC ground wire is loose and whether the ground position has been changed. Caution: The ESC ground wire must have good airtightnes to prevent water and moisture from penetrating into the ESCU con ector through the holes in the harnes , causing functional failure.
(f) Perform visual inspection and appearance inspection on the following electrical components to: (1) Check whether the harness and connectors of the relevant components of the ESC are properly connected or damaged. (2) Check whether the harness is too close to high-voltage or high-current devices, such as high-voltage electrical components, after-sales stereo amplifiers and other components. Attention: High-voltage or high-current devices may cause the circuit to produce induced waves, thus interfering with the normal operation of the circuit. (3) The components of the electronic stability control system are very sensitive to electromagnetic interference (EMI). If intermittent failure is suspected, check whether the after-sales immobilizer, lamp or mobile phone is installed correctly.
(g) If the electronic stability control system is noisy, check the following: (1) The fixing between the electronic stability control system assembly and the electronic stability control system bracket is loose. (2) The fixing between the electronic stability control system bracket and the vehicle body is loose. (3) The rubber washer on the electronic stability control system bracket is missing or damaged. (4) The brake pipeline is deformed, bumped, or interfered. (5) The clip of the brake pipeline bracket is damaged.
(h) Check the road conditions of the vehicle. If the physical limit is exceeded or when driving at

high speed on wet and slippery roads, ESC cannot completely prevent the vehicle from slipping. (i) Check whether the fuse is normal before troubleshooting the electrical appliance.

### Tip:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_75b1b575` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

If there is a fault in the braking system, but the ESCU does not store a DTC, this type of fault is called a fault without DTC.

### 1. Correction of fault without DTC
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ae6fe5c8` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Faults without DTC are generally caused by faults of the foundation brake system, which include the following: (1) Leakage of brake fluid; (2) Use of inferior brake fluid; (3) Existence of air in brake pipeline; (4) Brake pipeline blocked; (5) Excessive wear of the brake disc; (6) Failure of the booster; (7) Incorrect connection of the brake pipeline.

(b) If the warning light remains on, but there is no DTC, it may be because the ESCU has no power supply or the power supply is abnormally interrupted. Tip: Check the corresponding components for the fault phenomenon, so as to eliminate the fault.

### 2. Correction of occasional fault
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_80296674` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) In an electronic system, there may be instantaneous poor contact between the electrical circuit and the place where signals are inputted and outputted, which may cause occasional faults. Sometimes the occasional fault will disappear by itself, so it is not easy to find the problem. In case of an occasional fault, it can be simulated in the following way to check whether it reappears.

![](images/cfda46f01c95af5b575cbd35ed92f1d385c12768c4735bd8dd814c3377b4795b.webp)

Tip:
![](images/d08a12635658133769de13aa441f523f3ef26dded284a97eae35386dc1416311.webp)

If the fault does not reappear at this time, it is necessary to wait until the next fault reappears before diagnosis and maintenance. Generally speaking, occasional faults will gradually evolve into reproducible faults and will not disappear by themselves.

### Description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_12b62114` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The yaw rate sensor is integrated in the ESCU. The yaw rate sensor contains three signals of lateral acceleration, longitudinal acceleration, and yaw rate. When the sensor fails, the ESCU will record the DTC.

![](images/155733a106809a98ec9424c13d22b067e1a2df4f2df7684b98d3a2c346f39868.webp)

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6079ff40` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/e9009a8b5107069e956a5613778fabbeabd46dbb1fe8af4fa702e72ee40e96b7.webp)

(a) Check that the installation position of the yaw rate sensor is level.
(b) Check whether the yaw rate sensor is installed tightly.
(c) Check whether the yaw rate sensor and the fixing bracket are bent or worn.

Repair according to the fault

(a) Connect the HQ-VDS scan tool.
(b) Set the ignition switch to "ON”
(c) Re-calibrate the yaw rate sensor.
(d) Clear the DTC.
(e) Carry out the driving test (with the vehicle speed exceed 40Km/h).
(f) Re-read the DTC.

Standard: No DTC output

### 1 The ESCU executes the automatic configuration module program
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_fe96f8db` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(d) Clear the DTC.

(f) Re-read the DTC.

Standard: No DTC output.

### 1. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1982256e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/d7b87dd51011baceb086f02d128a20fe7cd3184eb97b038961cf8b4dc1cb9891.webp)

2. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

3. Note: iBooster is a component related to safety. Therefore, in addition to the general safety and preventive measures, the following diagnostic precautions must also be observed when carrying out maintenance diagnosis on it.

(a) The maintenance of iBooster system must be performed by technicians who have received professional training and mastered maintenance skills, and only original parts can be used for replacement.
(b) Before diagnosing the iBooster system, external faults must be eliminated first, such as installation and dimensional deviation of the brake pedal, dimensional deviation or damage of the front wall panel, failures of calipers, friction discs, friction blocks, brake hoses (hard pipes) and others.
(c) The following points should be paid attention to when connecting the iBooster and sensor harness: Before disconnecting the iBooster and sensor harness, the ignition switch must be turned off; Ensure that the connectors are dry and clean and avoid any foreign matter from entering; The connector of the iBooster harness must be installed in place both horizontally and vertically to avoid damaging the connector.

### 1. Preliminary inspection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e85c6057` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The brake fluid level in the iBooster brake fluid reservoir is within the normal scale range, and there is no leakage around the reservoir.
(b) Check whether there is leakage at the brake pipeline and connection of iBooster master cylinder.
(c) Check the battery voltage and check whether the battery terminals are corroded or loose. The normal operating voltage range of iBooster is 9.8V-16V.
(d) Check the surface temperature of iBooster and ECU, which should be - 40 ° C to 105 C under normal conditions.
(e) Visual inspection and appearance inspection shall be conducted for the following electrical components: whether the harness and connectors of relevant components of iBooster system are correctly connected, clamped or cut; whether the harness wiring is too close to HV or high current devices, such as HV electrical components, stereo amplifiers added in after-sales stage, etc; Tip: High-voltage or high-current devices may cause the circuit to produce induced noise, thus interfering with the normal operation of the circuit.
(f) iBooster components are very sensitive to electromagnetic interference (EMI). If failure check whether

intermittent is suspected, the after-sales immobilizer, lamp or mobile phone is installed correctly.

### Correction of fault without DTC
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c9365863` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
If there is a fault in the braking system, but the iBooster Gen2 does not store a DTC, this type of fault is called a fault without DTC.

1. Correction of fault without DTC (a) Faults without DTC are generally caused by faults of the foundation brake system, which include the following:

(1) Leakage of brake fluid;
(2) Use of inferior brake fluid;
(3) Existence of air in brake pipeline;
(4) Brake pipeline blocked;
(5) Excessive wear of the brake disc;
(6) Connection failure of IBooster's input rod with the pedal;
(7) Incorrect connection of the brake pipeline.

(b) Tip: Check the corresponding components for the fault phenomenon, so as to eliminate the fault.

### 2. Correction of occasional fault
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_80296674` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) In an electronic system, there may be instantaneous poor contact between the electrical circuit and the place where signals are inputted and outputted, which may cause occasional faults. Sometimes the cause of failure will disappear by itself, so it is not easy to find out the problem. In case of an occasional fault, it can be simulated in the following way to check whether it reappears.

![](images/838291b17de9749db5dfd563e9d188c9cb77d83ead1504c7d85f7f23c27b3f44.webp)

Tip:
If the fault does not reappear at this time, it is necessary to wait until the next fault reappears before diagnosis and maintenance. Generally speaking, occasional faults will gradually evolve into reproducible faults and will not disappear by themselves.

The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

Brake fluid pipe assembly
Parts BR-29

### 1. Check the brake fluid
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9566c19d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/16fef65aafb32c65553a0fc908ed72f265b46664c93b284f0e946240e2ef65d8.webp)

(a) Check whether the brake fluid level in the vacuum booster reservoir is between the MAX and MIN lines.

Tip:
If the level is below the MIN line, fill with brake fluid.
Check whether the brake system is leaking. If any, repair or replace abnormal parts.

### Tip:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e75994cd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

If any operation has performed on the brake system or the air is suspected to be entrapped in the brake pipeline, bleed the brake system.

Note:

Before bleeding the brake system, move the shift lever to the P gear and activate the parking brake. Meanwhile, fill with brake fluid to keep the reservoir level between the MIN and MAX lines. If the brake fluid splashes on any painted or rubber surface, clean it immediately.

1. Fill the reservoir with brake fluid Tip: Make sure there is enough brake fluid in the reservoir. Brake fluid capacity: about 0.83±0.01 L (liter). Brake fluid type BASF Hydraulic 404 (BASF brand, DOT4 brake fluid).

### 2. Bleed the brake master cylinder
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_fe38308c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Use a suitable tool to unscrew the brake pipeline nuts on the brake master cylinder respectively.

(b) Slowly depress and hold the brake pedal. (c) Repeat several times until no bubbles are generated.

### 3. Bleed the brake pipeline
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_016c05e6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/b44ede44318dce57370285eb6c69c0d2481130091ba2565779653eff175e2ea8.webp)

(a) Connect the plastic tube to the bleed screw.

(b) Depress the brake pedal several times, and then hold the pedal to loosen the bleed screw.
(c) When the brake fluid no longer overflows, tighten the bleed screw.
(d) Repeat several times until no bubbles are generated in the discharged brake fluid.
(e) Tighten the bleed screw.

### Check
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_bb855e2f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Check the thickness of the brake disc (a) Measure the thickness of the brake disc with a spiral micrometer.

![](images/5e6a55501e1cc7b4f944691601cc1c8fc78100193d5cea80c4bec46fc9806e04.webp)

Note:
Standard thickness: 32 mm (mm)
Minimum thickness: 30 mm (mm)
Tip:
If the thickness of the brake disc is less than the minimum value, replace the front brake disc.

2. Check the radial runout of the brake disc.

(a) Fix the front brake disc with the brake disc locating screws and wheel bolts.
(b) Wipe the surface of the brake disc friction ring with a clean cloth.
(c) Use a dial gauge to measure the radial runout of the brake disc at a distance of 10 mm from the outer edge of the front brake disc. Note:
Maximum radial runout of brake disc: 0.008 mm Tip:
The magnet of the dial gauge should be far away from the hub bearing unit assembly and the speed sensor.
Install the dial gauge on the vibration damper. If the radial runout exceeds the maximum value, change the mounting position of the brake disc on the hub bearing unit assembly to reduce the radial runout. If the radial runout still exceeds the
maximum value after the change, grind the brake disc. If the axial runout of the front brake disc exceeds the maximum value, replace the front brake disc.

![](images/979ea005de3ca544d8d56798b11dca8a1f9db88838e1f9f4cc343cdb130eeda0.webp)

### 4. Disengage the MSD （ CH-44）
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_27e03889` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Danger:
Disengage the MSD and wait for the complete discharge of the high-voltage components. Wait for another 5 minutes before the subsequent operation.
Wear insulating gloves.

5. Remove the battery assembly CH-52）

6. Drain the brake fluid （ BR-1）

7. Disassemble the brake fluid pipe assembly of the master cylinder.

![](images/f9d5510c95c4abf6139e33f8a13732d2d2418a3dee9f0bcbda09ef75ed73cfd4.webp)

(b) Unscrew 2 fluid pipe nuts, and disconnect the connecting tube from the ESC unit assembly.

![](images/59cd2779a1fccdc76170dd2e3f7df95c12d64d2e63eb7347e7fdc5fc54a19465.webp)

![](images/8d9f12000cdccc701ac129b24b2bf7431a792056da648d5714b2d3a5908ac5ea.webp)

10. Remove the right front wheel shieldI（ET-32）

11. Remove the right front brake fluid pipe assembly I

![](images/94d863d05744d5f418819264df777cd7c3605c5089bab660670fccfb964ea8b1.webp)

(a) Unscrew 1 fluid pipe nut, and disconnect the connecting tube from the ESC unit assembly.

![](images/7f23c5f7e0a0ca393197ccc6e0e9709c9f1606c47f099a241e0b6428368384ac.webp)

(b) Disengage 2 double-pipe clips of the right front brake fluid pipe assembly I.

![](images/d0d6ca0b642bced95c3abff9853014a0998068097d8dc211e0fe8f8b2a036bf6.webp)

(c) Disengage 2 fluid pipe retaining clips above the front baffle.

![](images/e914ec522c5146e2e57127ee52df5d8dabd37990090739641d0756e2b8bd4f9c.webp)

(d) Unscrew 1 fluid pipe nut, and remove the right front brake fluid pipe assembly I.

![](images/e511426ef26f8a11503537304f5e3c6d358a147f4298956162d7641402225307.webp)

(a) Unscrew 1 fluid pipe nut and 1 double-pipe clip from the right front brake fluid pipe assembly III.

![](images/ea9313944098c95bedb73c1e2523dfb6e8bf566d6781c4c68cb92917c89b80da.webp)

![](images/5bc2a782e6783d3f32fadebdea59f73320d49ba73701d466e2bb79ca977e7d5b.webp)

(c) Disengage the protective sheath of the right front brake fluid pipe assembly III, and remove the right front brake fluid pipe assembly III.

13. Remove the rear floor bottom guard （ET-47） (only applicable to models equipped with 160KW RWD electric drive system)

14. Remove the rear suspension bottom gurd I（ ET-47）

15. Remove the power batteryassembly （PB-144）

16. Disassemble the high-pressure water heaterassembly. （ CO-64）

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0ed34c47` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the rear brake hose assembly Tip: The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

![](images/e6831de8a7afdc179e189d2b6c9408511a3531696a8f0c45c92f2af7d48d290f.webp)

(a) Install the rear brake hose assembly with one bolt.

Torque: 35-41N·m

![](images/d46735751a5a5c876115fd361623254128214e055bc4cd147b5dd63f07536177.webp)

(b) Install the rear brake hose assembly with 1 clip.

2. Install the front brake hose assembly Tip: The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

(a) Install the left front brake fluid pipe assembly II with 1 fluid pipe nut. Torque: 14\~18N·m

![](images/525984f587c7ba38def178c0435f09e76ed0ba19ef5229fbd4b7c77faab2b9fa.webp)

(b) Install the left front brake fluid pipe assembly II on to the front brake caliper assembly with 1 fluid pipe nut.

Torque: 14\~18N·m

![](images/34e79ccacfa08085f0fe580e01e014336ccbda02d8a46beb9e11e3719b0e2523.webp)

![](images/872373a701b8d1be509fc2e99443e064b39e1768ad6a6f9a5600f66585b1988f.webp)

(c) Install the front hose bracket with 2 bolts. Torque: 8-12N·m

(d) Install the front brake hose assembly with one bolt.

Torque: 14\~18N·m

(e) Install the front brake hose assembly with 1 clip.

![](images/86f426849435e809f7cebe07b208cb0f33fd6be500a3b16d0e8135243557ac1b.webp)

(f) Install the limit fixing device of the front brake hose assembly.

3. Install the rear brake fluid pipe assembly II (a) Install the 4 dual-pipe clamps on the lower part of body.

(b) Install the 5 single-pipe clamps of the right rear brake fluid pipe assembly II.

![](images/e69bcc9982b6755a9b801f263c4e95a31a01ca40e3d3a8c5cf8d773458bd4736.webp)

(c) Install the 4 single-pipe clamps of the left rear BR brake fluid pipe assembly II.

(d) Install the Y-connector with one nut. Torque: 8-12N·m

![](images/3f8997e55ae8364a423bde18cec0780fc0db8a86ab719e698d5fa738b84ee32a.webp)

(e) Connect the union joint with 2 fluid pipe nuts. Torque: 14\~18N·m

![](images/7009771eaa7036d0442e378265ed1405aca8f002691c52aec7e945c07b7e4421.webp)

(f) Connect the left rear brake hose with 1 fluid pipe nut.

Torque: 14\~18N·m

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

![](images/04388c638e6e3f91c07ddb146bac67463932bf93bd37a85c3016a4169d7d8e16.webp)

4. Install the rear brake fluid pipe assembly I (a) Connect the union joint with 2 fluid pipe nuts. Torque: 14\~18N·m

![](images/be59379fac978e888b55608d0ff6aee8e754dd6281d2af6895bdba05c8a1c82c.webp)

(b) Install the 1 dual-pipe clamp of the rear brake fluid pipe assembly I.

![](images/8929c2c2b83ef53b1bd8b99cfd4c34346265662e465cc7d0659cacba3668e4e7.webp)

![](images/57f04bb9f9f46472b41a0ea207a2ce1d7a4e1cdbfb19089f9329b64ccc480091.webp)

(c) Install the 4 fluid pipe retaining clips behind the battery.

(d) Install one fluid pipe retaining clip above the front baffle.

(e) Install the ESC unit assembly connecting fluid BR pipe with 2 fluid pipe nuts.

Torque: 14\~18N·m

5. Install the high-voltage heater bracket （CO-66）

11. Install the right front brake fluid pipe assembly I

(a) Install the ESC unit assembly connecting fluid pipe with 1 fluid pipe nut. Torque: 14\~18N·m

12. Install the right front wheel shield I （ET-36）

13. Install the left front brake fluid pipe assembly I (a) Install the ESC unit assembly connecting fluid pipe with 1 fluid pipe nut. Torque: 14\~18N·m

![](images/a30c3dbe52ce5bff74c65c0f26fa21588952b8359992377e49197c48f067f5e9.webp)

![](images/dd6ce1f7c4cb6ab0c81ef44396fcada541aaeb8ab2586c72e62d90e31d1e68e1.webp)

![](images/3cfe677f3036da093e787160450247f958e706b95ad6dd93ead3cba24da61b06.webp)

16. Fill in brake fluid （ BR-1）
17. Discharge air from the brake system （ （BR-1）

### 2. Removal and installation of battery terminal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_478176bd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Before disassembling and repairing electrical components, disconnect the negative (-) terminal of the battery to prevent the system from short-circuiting.
(b) Before disconnecting or reconnecting battery cable terminals, first turn off the power (ignition) switch and lighting switch, and then completely loosen or tighten the battery cable terminal nuts.
(c) When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

3. Immobilizer configuration is required after the E-PARK control unit is replaced.

### 1. Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_eca93403` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) E-PARK: The electronic parking locking control unit drives the actuating motor to mechanically lock the intermediate shaft of the reducer, so as to realize the P-gear parking function.

### Description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_29466515` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_f70c8dff` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn the ignition switch to the OFF (STOP) position when the vehicle is stationary.
2. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
3. Remove the E-PARK locking control unit.

![](images/5803dd800e0e90504fa62016788bee199ed6e098595d064c03366d7b2b2c73d0.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of the E-PARK locking control unit.

(b) Remove 2 bolts, and then remove the E-PARK locking control unit.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_fb6b0fc6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/bae7b3491f8effa909491b0ad68269ef1775abccd8ae2d82845e11bdd461c6f3.webp)

(a) Install the E-PARK locking control unit with 2 bolts.

Torque: 8-12N·m

(b) Connect the harness connector of the E-PARK locking control unit.

2. Connect the negative terminal of the battery CH-54） Attention: Anti-theft configuration is required after installing the E-PARK locking control unit.

### 1. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_89636fa8` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/6780f0b929bb5153d3d4f613ee07f5a357cf416f14065ca36f13bc8f07efefde.webp)

2. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

3. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

4. General maintenance instructions:

(a) Before the electric steering gear assembly is diagnosed, a detailed visual inspection is required to determine whether it is a mechanica failure or an electrical and electronic failure.

(b) If the electric steering gear assembly fails, first check for mechanical problems.

(c) In case of the following three situations, it indicates that the electric steering gear assembly system detects electrical and electronic faults:

(1) Turn on the ignition switch. After the system self-check is completed, the warning light is still illuminated.
(2) During driving, the warning light remains on.
(3) During the steering process, there is excessive steering force or there is no power assist.

(d) When connecting the power supply harness and sensor harness on the electric gear assembly, pay attention to the following points:

(1) Before removing the power harness and sensor harness on the electric steering

gear assembly, the ignition switch must be turned off. (2) Ensure that the connectors are dry and clean, and avoid any foreign matter from entering. (3) The power harness and sensor harness on the electric steering gear assembly must be installed in place to avoid damage to the connectors.
(e) After the vehicle is started, the electric steering gear assembly will produce a short "click" sound, which indicates the electric steering gear assembly is performing self-check, and is a normal phenomenon.
(f) When the removal of EPS assembly, removal/replacement of outer ball joint, four-wheel alignment, SAS calibration, suspension repair, and tire replacement are performed in the repair and maintenance of vehicle, deviation compensation moment should be configured.
(g) The electric steering gear assembly must be replaced as a whole, disassembly or partial replacement/exchange is not allowed.

### 5. Notes for CAN communication system:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3fcea7e0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the electric steering unit fails, it will send a warning signal to the IP to alert the driver. The electric steering unit is connected to the diagnostic interface through the diagnostic bus of the gateway ECU, and can communicate with the scan tool for relevant data.
(b) When the CAN communication system cannot communicate, the line should be overhauled, and the electric steering system should be checked when the data communication is normal.
(c) It is not recommended to use the method of piercing the skin of the wire to detect the electrical signals of the input and output of the components, so as to avoid short-circuiting the harness.

6. Precautions for airbag system during operation of electric steering unit:

(a) Certain maintenance operations will affect the SRS airbag. Be sure to read the Precautions" of the SRS airbag before maintenance.

7. Precautions for removal, installation and replacement of electric steering system components:

(a) When removing and installing the steering gear with tie rod assembly, make sure that the steering wheel is aligned and the front wheels are aligned straight ahead.
(b) Make a mark before removing the steering wheel.
(c) After replacing the EPS assembly, it needs to be calibrated with a scan tool.
(d) Be sure to align the steering wheel and wheels before calibrating for the replacement of EPS assembly or re-calibration of SAS, which is recommended to be performed during the four-wheel alignment.

### System description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ec4a6192` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. When the driver turns the steering wheel, the steering action of the driver is converted into wheel swing through the steering column, intermediate shaft and steering gear, and the steering function of the vehicle is finally realized. The EPS system cooperates with the driver's operation to provide electric power for the steering system.

2. The EPS is composed of motor, electric steering gear & tie rod assembly, dust cover, bellows, ball joint assembly and other parts.

3. The advantages of EPS are as follows:

(a) Save space.
(b) Reduce noise.
(c) Save energy.

4. According to the difference between the steering wheel angle speed signal and the vehicle speed signal via the CAN bus, the electric steering gear adjusts different speed of motor, so as to realize the variable power assisted steering with speed.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_cd6334b5` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip: Before removal, make the front wheel face the front, and do not turn the steering wheel after removal.

1. Remove the front wheels of thevehicle （TW-5）
2. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery（ CH-52）
3. Remove the lower left guard ofinstrument IP-1）

4 Remove the intermediate steering shaft & dust cover assembly

![](images/f7f854adb5a5c5311cffd38aedefcaadfeb39ee66c93a84f360be46cf0b502b5.webp)

(a) Remove one bolt, and disconnect the intermediate steering shaft & dust cover assembly from the steering column.

![](images/3d8eaa3db282b7c8a161b5b6d528c9ae705b5e11d9e5d1fc692c0549d8885780.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt, and disconnect the intermediate steering shaft & dust cover assembly from the steering gear.

![](images/5c8ac0e1d31a622ea9d40dc3b6831c379c8b3865257c8a6a5735e026357b25a4.webp)

(c) Remove 4 nuts to detach the intermediate steering shaft & dust cover assembly.

### assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5d9d4a2f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/a35ad8dd693d8ec8eb2e47ad821f9e31ad2c6074d0078f19807e6edce44dd5b4.webp)

(a) Connect the intermediate steering shaft & dust cover assembly and the steering gear with one bolt.

Torque: 25-33N·m

![](images/2f1d2d547223cf072f16f9ddaaeff1ea73d9abd97e5335c99cfcf44365779b56.webp)

(b) Connect the intermediate steering shaft & dust cover assembly and the steering column with one bolt.

Torque: 25-33N·m

![](images/8d2883d8cfe8f044a1f16fb00e4a9d6aee6d3327b8cfdd278e48c59e02a61c21.webp)

(c) Install the intermediate steering shaft & dust cover assembly with 4 nuts.

Torque: 4-6N·m

2. Install the front wheel of the vehicle （TW-6）
3. Install the lower left guard of instrument （IP-6） Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）
5. Re-adjust the wheel front toe-in.

ball joint

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_fa44d929` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

1. Remove the front wheels of the vehicle （TW-5）
2. Remove the parallel shaft electric steering gear tie rod ball joint

### ball joint
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_087ca1f5` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/2582bc18d852608981138a813f8e58126d96884cf9b49cf50a6ffe8e66318e58.webp)

(a) Disengage one nut to detach the parallel shaft electric steering gear tie rod ball joint with SST(39H7034010B).

![](images/bb692b35225ffebc02579ccdeed8bb0be511222d9f47924e2d51d4459e49ecd2.webp)

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ebcbef1f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:

The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Install the parallel shaft electric steering gear tie rod ball joint

![](images/af3362358d1c7add11479b21e92825df7232fd84b4e183b938ccc6221c2ad195.webp)

(a) Install the parallel shaft electric steering gear outer tie rod ball joint with one nut. Torque: 68.6-98N·m

![](images/d6b54034f217d34d79f33458e069915cca2657713ebc108320d49c079903c6ab.webp)

(b) Install the parallel shaft electric steering gear outer tie rod ball joint to the steering knuckle with one nut. Torque: 105-135N·m

2. Install the front wheel of the vehicle （TW-6） 3. Re-adjust the wheel front toe-in.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_025e9066` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Remove the front wheels of the vehicle （TW-5）
2. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
3. Remove the electric steering gear outer tie rod ball joint PS-38） Remove the parallel shaft electric steering gear & tie rod assembly

![](images/5a16662c8bd3f7e526f680aab0a30f67a8da54c251728b24cd70bf10334aad77.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of the parallel shaft electric steering gear & rod assembly.

![](images/82fbb4bbbe8d5ad136271320cca686b77f6962a93daf3e18f8505df9dd0b3da2.webp)

(b) Remove 3 bolts to detach the paralle shaft electric steering gear & tie rod assembly from the subframe.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3231e6a6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the parallel shaft electric steering gear & tie rod assembly

![](images/90ccf27685e438e0650498174defad5c19d47ad5453730f48fbd40253d8a142b.webp)

(a) Install the parallel shaft electric steering gear & tie rod assembly with 3 bolts. Torque: 45-55N m + 54 ° 66 Monitoring torque: 120-140N · m

![](images/1d48b7bb6de25281179a5ff75e304d5bdf5e72847da00109e5c71d796d4e0d36.webp)

(b) Connect the harness connector of the parallel shaft electric steering gear & rod assembly.

2. Install the electric steering gear tie rod ball joint （ PS-39）
3. Install the front wheel of the vehicle （TW-6） Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）
5. Re-adjust the wheel front toe-in.

### 2. Removal and installation of battery terminal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_478176bd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Before disassembling and repairing electrical components, disconnect the negative (-) terminal of the battery to prevent the system from short-circuiting.
(b) Before disconnecting or reconnecting battery cable, first turn off the ignition switch and lighting switch, and then completely loosen or tighten the battery cable terminal nuts.
(c) When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### 3. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6df6e7d4` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) During maintenance, handle electronic components (electronic control units, sensors, etc.) carefully to avoid damage caused by impact and static electricity.
(b) Establish the awareness of environmental protection and effectively dispose of the waste generated in the maintenance process.
(c) It is not recommended to use the method of piercing the skin of the wire to detect the electrical signals of the input and output of the components, so as to avoid short-circuiting the harness.

### 1. Function overview of driving mode control system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_baaa7411` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The driving mode control system can provide different vehicle modes, and the vehicle has unique driving performance in different modes to meet the driving needs of the driver.

(b) Driving mode switching: Press and release the steering wheel driving mode selection button or enter the driving mode selection interface in the vehicle setting of the audio system. It can switch between seven driving modes: long range mode, comfort mode, sport mode, all road mode, off-road mode, custom mode and extreme mode.

### 2. Driving mode
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_78c0e125` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) LBL mode: In the LBL mode, the vehicle has good endurance and is suitable to run on common pavements in urban areas.
(b) Sport mode: The sport mode is a mode in which the vehicle has good dynamics and is applicable for driving on highways.
(c) Comfort mode: The comfort mode is a mode in which the vehicle has good comfort and is applicable for driving on common urban paved roads.
(d) All road mode: It is applicable to low adhesion pavement, wet grassland and gravel pavement after snow.
(e) Off-road mode: The off-road mode is applicable for driving on the shoulders of urban roads and light off-road surfaces.
(f) Extreme mode: It aims to provide users with the ultimate driving experience. Under the extreme mode, the vehicle has strong dynamic characteristics and is suitable for well paved roads. (1) To enter the extreme mode, the following conditions shall be met: 1. The power battery temperature is less than or equal to 35°C; 2. The power battery capacity is greater than or equal to 70%; 3. The current driving mode is in sport mode. (2) To exit extreme mode, any of the following conditions shall be met: 1. The power battery temperature is greater than 50°C;
2. The power battery capacity is less than 30%;
3. The single activation duration of extreme mode is greater than 10 minutes; The power (ignition) switch is set to OFF position.

(g) Custom mode: In order to meet individual driving needs, in addition to the above driving modes, the driver can also choose a custom mode.
