### Method for adjusting the suspension design attitude
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_730d0f5f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Method for adjusting the design attitude after replacing parts of the front suspension (only applicable to the model equipped with helical springs)

![](images/d2b42407d6ebff010818479c9b33fccac632456cd4e0d75e116b65ad8e1999c4.webp)

(a) After replacing the parts, do not tighten the bolts directly, which shall be kept in a loose state. Tip: Install the wheels, and lower the supporting parts of the vehicle, so that the vehicle is completely landed on the four-wheel alignment equipment. Before the wheel center is adjusted to the design height, the bolts shall have no torque.

(b) The height from the front wheel center to the wheel arch shall be adjusted through counterweight on the four-wheel alignment equipment, so as to meet the design requirements, with a tolerance of ±10mm.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2f90140f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The height H shall be reached through counterweight.
The height H from the wheel center to the wheel arch shall be 478.8±10mm after counterweight.

(c) Fasten the bolt after measuring the height, (there shall be no torque before tightening; if there is torque before this, it shall be loosened and then fastened). Tip: Please fasten the bolt according to the specified torque.

2. Method for adjusting the design attitude after replacing parts of the rear suspension (only applicable to the model equipped with helical springs)

![](images/ab20e403502e1eccbf4baec53192dafa89881be36d370041562473fde10b464a.webp)

(a) After replacing the parts, do not tighten the bolts directly, which shall be kept in a loose state. Tip: Install the wheels, and lower the supporting parts of the vehicle, so that the vehicle is completely landed on the four-wheel alignment equipment. Before the wheel center is adjusted to the design height, the bolts shall have no torque.
(b) The height from the rear wheel center to the wheel arch shall be adjusted on the four-wheel alignment equipment, so as to meet the design requirements, with a tolerance of ±10mm. Attention: The height H shall be reached through counterweight. The height H from the rear wheel center to the wheel arch shall be 480.2±10mm through counterweight.
(c) Fasten the bolt after measuring the height, (there shall be no torque before tightening; if there is torque before this, it shall be loosened and then fastened). Tip: Please fasten the bolt according to the specified torque.

3. Before installing the following components, the vehicle shall be adjusted to the design posture:

![](images/63fd5dc083e7d441dffe47d99e29fde1e7553230adcc31d889f47ae4529cbd80.webp)

Method for adjusting the design attitude after replacing parts of the front suspension (only applicable to the model equipped with air springs)

(a) For the model equipped with air suspension, the height from the wheel center to the wheel arch in the no-load state shall be 462.7±10mm. At the moment, it is the design posture. Tip: If the height from the wheel center to the wheel arch does not conform to the design height, please make adjustment.

5. Method for adjusting the design attitude after replacing parts of the rear suspension (only applicable to the model equipped with air springs)

(a) For the model equipped with air suspension, the height from the wheel center to the wheel arch in the no-load state shall be 461.3±10mm. At the moment, it is the design posture. Tip: If the height from the wheel center to the wheel arch does not conform to the design height, please make adjustment.

### Check
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0b60c14b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Before adjustment to front wheel alignment, the following inspection and overhaul shall be carried out to ensure the correctness of positioning sampling value and positioning adjustment method.

(a) Check whether the front tire inflation pressure is within the specified range and whether the tire surface wear is approximately the same.
(b) Make sure the vehicle is unloaded.
(c) Press the vehicle up and down to make the suspension in the normal position.
(d) Check whether the wheels and tires are loose. If so, do correct before the adjustment.
(e) Check the balance height of the vehicle.
(f) Check the front mounting components for looseness or damage.

### Adjustment
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b827aa7c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/6748ab0d35cd4a43d1f025e22f9c02cbd88f10524b2048520349527af87fc955.webp)

### Check
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_4126c86c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Before adjustment to rear wheel alignment, the following inspection and overhaul shall be carried out to ensure the correctness of positioning sampling value and positioning adjustment method.

(a) Check whether the rear wheel inflation pressure is within the specified range and whether the tire surface wear is approximately the same.
(b) Make sure the vehicle is unloaded.
(c) Press up and down to make the suspension system in the normal position.
(d) Check wheels and tires for radial runout.
(e) Check the balance height of the vehicle.
(f) Check the front mounting components for looseness or damage.

### Adjustment
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b19fca21` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Loosen the fixing nut of the eccentric bolt of the rear upper control arm and the toe-in adjustment arm.

![](images/d31527a5f48e5b26ba62c3f3b89bdf77e80ce6e1abc1fdcb8295a55ea34841cd.webp)

2. Rotate the eccentric bolt to make the front toe value reach the standard value Tip: If after four-wheel alignment, a significant difference is observed in vehicle height, re-adjustment shall be implemented with reference to the suspension design posture.

Front toe-in

Front toe-in (only applicable to vehicles equipped with AirS)
![](images/c6a79cde5d89846fa30ac8b4ccfdd1daefe3aa8c12a2411700640a0298297dda.webp)

![](images/9db0d57864226ef54b2c3f4db1fa38d0f0067fa30f39d4daefac4fc2f725a622.webp)

3. Tighten the fixing nut of the eccentric bolt of the rear upper control arm and the toe-in adjustment arm. Torque: 135-165N·m

![](images/77698f15cddbf2bf293f76d86097c0b1ba87b95d1c959d8af0a4f44208765751.webp)

4. Standard value of vehicle height: (measured from the center of the wheel to the edge of the fender)

Vehicle height

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Remove the front drive shaft nut (a) Remove the wheel trim, and remove the front drive axle nut.

![](images/b57270ef3b2893a51985b32fee5bc727f5c13582fc0544b2b1a25313f7ed55dc.webp)

2. Remove the front wheels of the vehicle （TW-5）
3. Remove the lower control arm 2# assembly （ SP-16）
4. Remove the lower control arm 1# assembly (a) Remove the one nut and disconnect the steering ball joint.

![](images/ea3416a8e2ac54d5481b2087826aafa2f19ba14a41b30c136ff5672d1695af76.webp)

![](images/183313b5591b47d5ba7a8cd0a46ddbab4dd743e1a2c16b97f91fc806fc9c19b2.webp)

![](images/143cb75a4ef9790c81a40962a8d9c5671849207a7595ab7c40628acc2d68d1ce.webp)

(c) Remove the nut connecting the No.1 lower control arm with front steering knuckle.

![](images/c6db4db8dd5b8257098d67916e587e9a4efe377b5aacb96f982af197a029c7e7.webp)

(d) Pull out the lower control arm 1# assembly and front steering knuckle assembly.

![](images/6c7e2c880c389bc042951df4d6f3b97182e1d687af3913a9546ee452b43b822c.webp)

(e) Remove the lower control arm 1# assembly.

### 1. Install the lower control arm 1# assembly

![](images/7bf54dc808db5637b60174bf325ba7d8df0493f3d6ac5787587b238009f43ac2.webp)

(a) Install the front drive axle nut, and install the wheel trim. Torque: 145\~155 N·m, rotate for 45°±5° to the tightening direction.

5. Re-adjust the front wheel toe-in.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ffc154d7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/2e23f69b61923fa1aea758faa21d3fc6a0e8827a520b6efdfa8cb75ed9dd46ae.webp)

Tip:
The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Install the upper left control arm assembly (a) Install the upper left control arm assembly with 2 bolts. Tip: Do not tighten the bolts directly, but keep them loose.

![](images/31e395cdc90ea9a82ed03ffb56d70da21f677767b177ec8ce8f58f0b851c17f8.webp)

(b) Insert a metal locating pin of φ6mm into the locating hole, to fix the position of the upper control arm relative to the vehicle body.

![](images/8d5d6a5f8b2746b5f6c58248aa2b95763ac3aadd6f67fe754f2141c91330cece.webp)

(c) Tighten 2 fixing bolts of the upper left control arm assembly. Tip: Remove the metal locating pin after the bolts are fastened.

Torque: 50-65 N·m

![](images/dcd6c8974c59fcafdf34483a298354a204ab7dd058b9371b08d59de36e90cdbc.webp)

(d) Connect the steering knuckle assembly with one bolt.

Torque: 40-59 N·m

2. Install the left air spring & continuous damping control vibration damper assembly (only applicable to vehicles equipped with AirS) （AS-175）
3. Install the front vibration damper assembly （ SP-25）
4. Install the body height sensor （ AS-143）
5. Install the front wheel of the vehicle （TW-6）
6. Re-adjust the front wheel toe-in.

### Disassembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_74cb6489` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Disassemble the front vibration damper assembly

![](images/77e14e15af134de594ce2b36656ee7779bf8a51fc379a5777f5d11459ec17d6c.webp)

(a) Compress the front coil spring with SST(39H7029020B). Tip: Do not use an impact wrench, otherwise the special tool would be damaged. The compression spring must be fully pressed to prevent it from falling off.

![](images/6b1ec4ad05c859e7d57686f88ba86cd01590428d34b57cca5460243f4247198d.webp)

(b) Use SST(39H9029080) to remove the self-locking nut. Tip: Check that the front coil spring is completely compressed.

(c) Remove the front upper mounting assembly.
(d) Remove the front spring lower cushion.
(e) Remove the front coil spring.
(f) Remove the front dust cover.
(g) Remove the front buffer block.
(h) Remove the coil spring lower seat cushion.

### Assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d90aafca` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as
the left side

The sequence listed below applies to the left side Caution:

During instalation, check whether the dust coveris damaged and leaksgrease. Once thegrease leaks, replace twith newparts

### 1. Assemble the front vibration damper assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_97670479` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Install the lower cushion of coil spring.
(b) Install the front buffer block.
(c) Install the front dust cover.
(d) Install the front coil spring.
(e) Install the front spring lower cushion
(f) Compress the front coil spring with SST(39H7029020B) .Caution: Do not use an mpact wrench to compres the coi spring, otherwise thespecial to l wouldbe damaged. Make sure thatthe botom endofthe front coil spring ispositioned under the compresion ofthe lower cushion ofcoil spring.
(g) Install the coil spring.
(h) Install the front upper mounting assembly.
(i) Install the self-locking nut with SST (39H9029080).

![](images/fe13dc3a51ccfcf201b39292be51f2c0d2c12c90a6fddcfeb58830902c36edc6.webp)

![](images/69f0ddc0f842f312d57e2506e2b448d15269eb10d5e3d305cef482ce6883dd4d.webp)

1. Turn the ignition switch to the OFF (STOP) position when the vehicle is stationary. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） Danger: Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery after 5s.

### 3. Disengage the MSD （ CH-44）
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9d294035` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Danger:

Disengage the MSD and wait for the complete discharge of the high-voltage components. Wait for another 5 minutes before the subsequent operation.
Wear insulating gloves.

4. Remove the front wheel of the vehicle.（TW-5）

5. Remove the body height sensor （ AS-141）

6. Remove the lower control arm 2#assembly SP-16）

7. Remove the front stabilizer bar connecting rodassembly （ SP-31）

8. Remove the front stabilizer barassembly （SP-27）

9. Remove the front sub-frame assembly Tip: Cooperation of two people is required to remove the front subframe assembly.

(a) Operate the lift to stabilize the electric drive assembly.

![](images/08182dce00269d8c1ea3a7e722e0f737e12f4232102291143f63889a3485a00d.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt to disconnect the lower control arm 1 assembly.

![](images/fe77e87dff128064b2596a50315ae76488d09246f3b6f4401c425b0322585798.webp)

(c) Disconnect the harness connector of the electric steering gear & rod assembly.

![](images/b7c5223f74c3f774812377b70085b6fa676e215542d17cb3d35ddeb3ba7da684.webp)

(d) Remove one bolt to disengage the steering intermediate shaft.

![](images/01c0c8b166457ce624d2a92412a198e14c8e8524e79556e0384df210b8620f30.webp)

(e) Remove one bolt of the front powertrain front mounting assembly.

![](images/2566c2f7286593576baec8ec1969186093c9bc878e657a26f1a94011fb2eb5e6.webp)

(f) Remove one bolt of the front powertrain left mounting assembly.

![](images/ca6877269751e2effcd153eeb8c049183449fef5089efa8b1414e8ae2e8b6fda.webp)

(g) Remove one bolt of the front powertrain right mounting assembly.

(h) Operate the elevator and slowly lift the electric drive assembly.

Danger:
Stabilize the electric drive assembly.
Make sure that there are no wires or hoses on the subframe assembly.

Do not touch the vehicle when removing the subframe assembly from the vehicle. (i) Remove 4 bolts and 2 nuts to detach the front subframe assembly.

![](images/7e1530d38ce254eb1e09f9a4b88dd1d6e67fca089f0e8dcb6121ab5c559beef5.webp)

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a3b87204` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the front sub-frame assembly Tip:

Cooperation of two people is required to install the front subframe assembly.

![](images/6dbd98dd6d1d74280e99dba10409533344f1a04e596ae31c69b5733f9ba0ecde.webp)

(a) Install one bolt of the front powertrain right mounting assembly. Torque: 170-190N·m

![](images/41427cdcbb25e8831987b37c9bf56ccd4ce3d77677c2f3a68fbc1a0e23780473.webp)

(b) Install one bolt of the front powertrain left mounting assembly.

Torque: 170-190N·m

![](images/de4451e4eb78c43beb8aa1f87c6a7f5542fe1c69dac1056f6d607706f5098457.webp)

(c) Install one bolt of the front powertrain front mounting assembly. Torque: 170-190N·m

(d) Operate the elevator, and slowly lift the electric drive assembly. Danger: Please align the suspension hole position before lifting. Do not touch the vehicle when lifting the electric drive assembly.
(e) Install the front subframe assembly with 4 bolts and 2 nuts. Tip: Bolts and nuts are disposable parts and cannot be reused.

![](images/c93e50fd2b965fd304e44550b57fb1aebf523c461af538bb58bd1a3a5bb32146.webp)

Torque: 130-230N·m

![](images/023a19a20eb7e6af18d4695f096a446d8fa648da76cfbf303e122737f75e505e.webp)

(f) Remove one bolt to disengage the steering intermediate shaft. Torque: 25-33N·m

![](images/a5eed44d5035c303074e3c64239701e52a9c4f1428165ecc5a8a3807a498888e.webp)

(g) Install the lower control arm 1# assembly with one bolt. Tip: Bolts are disposable and cannot be reused.

Torque: 135-165N·m, rotation angle: 90°±10°

### 1. System overview of AirS control unit

(a) The vehicle can be maintained at different height levels by adjusting the driving mode, thus making different ground clearances to achieve the better trafficability.

### 2. Adjust AirS
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_978714e0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The vehicle height can be adjusted in the process of selecting a driving mod, and it will also be automatically adjusted according to the driving mode and speed during driving.
(b) During the adjustment, the AirSuspen indicator on the instrument cluster flashes and prompts the vehicle in rising/lowering state, and displays the current level and target level of vehicle height. After adjustment, the indicator stops flashing and displays the current height level.

### 3. Adjustment of AirS system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c64e001d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

In different driving modes, the AirS has different height levels and damping characteristics; The vehicle height can be automatically adjusted with the vehicle speed, and can be adjusted to all height levels below the corresponding height of the current driving mode.

(a) AirS characteristics in off-road mode (1) In this mode, the damper is automatically set to a balanced damping characteristic, and the vehicle height is automatically set to [off-road height 2] (+60 mm).

(2) This mode can be activated when the vehicle speed is less than 20 km/h. When the vehicle speed is more than 40 km/h, the driving mode is automatically adjusted from the off-road mode to the all-terrain mode, and the vehicle height is decreased to [off-road height 1] accordingly.

(b) AirS characteristics in all-terrain mode

(1) In this mode, the damper is automatically set to the damping characteristic adapting to slippery roads, and the vehicle height is automatically set to [off-road height 1] (+25 mm).
(2) When the vehicle speed is more than 80 km/h, the vehicle height will automatically decrease to the [normal level]; when the vehicle speed is less than 40 km/h, the vehicle height will automatically return to the [off-road height 1].

(c) AirS characteristics in comfort mode (1) In this mode, the damper is automatically set to comfortable damping characteristic, and the vehicle height is automatically set to [normal level] (+0 mm).

(2) When the vehicle speed is more than 100 km/h for 30 s, the vehicle height will automatically decrease to the [dynamic level]; when the vehicle speed is less than 70 km/h for 120 s, the vehicle height will automatically return to the [normal level]. When the vehicle speed is less than 35 km/h, the vehicle height will immediately return to the [normal level].

(d) AirS characteristics in LBL mode

(1) In this mode, the damper is automatically set to the balanced damping characteristic, and the vehicle height is automatically set to [dynamic level] (-15 mm).
(2) When the vehicle speed is more than 140 km/h for 20 s, the vehicle height will automatically decrease to the [highway level] (-30 mm); when the vehicle speed is less than 110 km/h for 20 s, the vehicle height will automatically return to the [dynamic level].

(e) AirS characteristics in sport and extreme modes

(1) In the two modes, the damper is automatically set to rigid damping characteristic, and the vehicle height is automatically set to [dynamic level] (-15 mm).
(2) When the vehicle speed is more than 140 km/h for 20 s, the vehicle height will automatically decrease to the [highway level] (-30 mm); when the vehicle speed is less than 110 km/h for 20 s, the vehicle height will automatically return to the [dynamic level].

(f) Suspension adjustment (1) If the power (ignition) switch is set to OFF during the adjustment of suspension, the adjustment will be interrupted immediately until the power (ignition)

switch is reset to ON, where the suspension will be automatically adjusted to the height corresponding to the current driving mode.

### 3. Adjustment of AirS system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ec9d30e4` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(2) If the current vehicle speed is not suitable for vehicle height adjustment, the vehicle height shall not be adjusted. Once the desired speed is reached, the vehicle will be automatically adjusted to the height corresponding to the driving mode.

(3) If any door is opened during the adjustment of suspension, the adjustment will be interrupted immediately, and the suspension will be automatically adjusted to the height corresponding to the current driving mode after all door are closed.

### (g) Automatic adjustment with engine shutdown
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1ce54d26` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

After the automatic adjustment with engine shutdown is activated, if the vehicle is in off-road or all-terrain mode before the power off, the vehicle height will automatically decrease to the [normal level] immediately after power off, to facilitate getting on/off. If the vehicle is in other driving modes before power off, the vehicle height will automatically decrease to the [highway level] after power off, to facilitate getting on/off. You can set the on and off of automatic adjustment with engine shutdown in the vehicle settings of the audio system.

Note: After turning on this function, please pay attention to the parking environment for the vehicle before power off every time, so as not to damage the chassis due to the lowering of the vehicle height.

### (h) Easy access
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e7e3a6e5` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Via the easy access, the AirS can be manually adjusted to [highway level], to facilitate getting on and off of the vehicle. You can set the on and off of easy access in the vehicle settings of the audio system.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6e8c3db5` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When the AirS system fails, the warning lamp on the instrument cluster will light on with corresponding prompt message.

Ignoring the warning lights and prompt messages may result in accidents and personal injury. If the AirS system fails, please contact the authorized FAW Hongqi dealer to check the vehicle immediately.

### 4. Lifting mode
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3cbe4aaf` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

You must turn on the lifting mode before you use a jack or lifter to rise the vehicle. After the lifting mode is entered, all AirS adjustment functions will be disabled. When the maintenance is completed, you must exit the lifting mode.

(a) Enter lifting mode

(1) With the power (ignition) switch placed in the ON mode, touch the [lifting mode] button on the suspension adjustment interface of the audio system, and the instrument cluster will display the prompt message "Vehicle in lifting mode" which indicates that the lifting mode is entered.

(b) Exit lifting mode

(1) With the power (ignition) switch placed in the ON mode, and the vehicle in the lifting mode, touch the [Exit] button on the suspension adjustment interface of the audio system to exit the lifting mode, and the prompt message “vehicle in lifting mode” will disappear; when the vehicle speed is more than 5km/h, the vehicle will automatically exit the lifting mode.

### 5. Loading mode
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_42fc66af` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The vehicle has a loading mode, in which the height of rear suspension can be lowered to (-45 mm) to facilitate loading and unloading of goods.

(a) Enter loading mode (1) Close all doors, apply EPB, open the trunk lid and press the AirS lowering button to enter the loading mode.
(b) Exit loading mode (1) Press the AirS rising button in the trunk or close the trunk lid to exit the loading mode. When the vehicle speed is more

than 5 km/h, the vehicle will automatically exit the loading mode.

### Precautions for activating loading mode:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0f518ac7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When activating the loading mode, there should be enough space under the vehicle. When exiting the loading mode, take care to leave enough space above the vehicle and the opened trunk lid.

1 Check the air compressor motor and relay for current fault

(a) Check whether the compressor running sound is normal.
(b) If the compressor is in continuous operation, immediately remove the fuse or relay.
(c) Check whether the air suspension relay is firmly installed.
(d) Check whether the relay is corroded by water or foreign substances.

![](images/3293725e59f2ca59d1de7dc6e518d0c59cfd007cb4d5c39a9728262eef5bc23d.webp)

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8e8a5865` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_952e3184` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the trunk left surface cover （IR-46）
3. Disassemble the baggage access switch assembly.

![](images/7ad61747c1be0ae2664b6dc8bcdc72355e028412e966e81f9e81853dd708f7c0.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of luggage pick/place switch assembly.

![](images/2796ead3e79b772e430019d6f107e1aec6f916cb2031f2551f306948fbee0105.webp)

(b) Disengage 2 claws and detach the luggage pick/place switch assembly.

![](images/97c486bcd2f6f7a8204974d23fe8e95be5e42f37b9df9f948c7cd2df49e85c1b.webp)

1. Install the baggage access switch assembly.

(a) Lock 2 claws, and install the baggage access switch assembly.

(b) Connect the harness connector of luggage pick/place switch assembly.

2. Install the trunk left surface cover （ IR-54）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_46608d4b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the engine compartment left upper guard （ ET-50）
3. Remove the engine compartment right upper guard （ ET-50） Remove left front acceleration sensor assembly Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

![](images/7068b83be53e3eecb47f4cf64cfde43e4158dbbd02bfd4b062e7d20cffaba409.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of left front acceleration sensor assembly.

![](images/1b52d06e217241a0f8688b10c15642f39367035ea4a7871c00cd0f813e20ec4d.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt and detach the left front acceleration sensor assembly.

5. Remove the trunk right covering （ IR-46）

6. Remove the rear acceleration sensor assembly (a) Disconnect the harness connector of the rear acceleration sensor assembly.

![](images/da659d3eb36ba83e88f388c1b5aa912c58e38db1c453108ba362ee575f0d2f1a.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt and detach the rear acceleration sensor assembly.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9483e20e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Install left front acceleration sensor assembly

![](images/97cfca7aba8e995095140d939381b1f97ae7b43257d5f7e0ff7684bef34823bf.webp)

(a) Install the left front acceleration sensor assembly with one bolt. Torque: 4.8-7.2N·m

![](images/1c855ae639ff6d3ee582c007c1888e2a45ef0018c7d96f3639bcac8d16630f07.webp)

(b) Connect the harness connector of left front acceleration sensor assembly.

![](images/6a1e33e5464c8713b386295d5cc0823c83abd25e2b52dc41c9724dadc3d089db.webp)

### 2. Install the rear acceleration sensor assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d910d999` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Install the rear acceleration sensor assembly with one bolt.

![](images/054560df145c11b51f828cd2a2ffd31a877c3fb1281d777175bcfa6088301d71.webp)

(b) Connect the harness connector of the rear acceleration sensor assembly.

3. Install the trunk right cover（ IR-54）

4. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）
5. Install the engine compartment left upper guard （ ET-52）
6. Install the engine compartment right upper guard （ ET-52）
7. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
8. Connect the scan tool HQ-VDS/select model/read the DTC of AirS controller.
9. Clear the DTC, and disconnect the scan tool.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_46608d4b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the left front wheel assembly （TW-5）
3. Remove the right front wheel assembly （TW-5）

### 4. Remove the front body height sensor
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_44e2df41` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/65424bd2dce449fa1bbd06764a4dad719231495a3d7d6d37b156490da3357e29.webp)

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_96edc87d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

### 1. Install the front body height sensor
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ba2c7fac` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/80f4546056f5dd319784437f5f79b9188a080953a476df05b9db6b22e9e47196.webp)

(a) The installation angle (as shown in the figure) is directly in front of the vehicle, of which a is the lower part of the vehicle and b is the wheel side.

![](images/92b8e649b8d5900a421327c54fbf9830a8936f7d88cb7e94046e435e0884b35d.webp)

(b) Install the front body height sensor with 2 bolts.

Torque: 4.8-7.2 N·m

![](images/412ab35e30c0c567edfacd5ddf25d627b272a0d85e17fba59f840847e8599f62.webp)

(c) Install the fixing nut of front body height sensor.

Torque: 4.8-7.2 N·m

![](images/ff9341d0e565159bc6861c5014e6b94ffdc67a95dc4db487241ce5bc86222a0b.webp)

(d) Connect the harness connector of front body height sensor.

2. Install the left front wheel assembly （TW-6）
3. Install the right front wheel assembly （TW-6）
4. Install the rear body height sensor (a) Mounting angle: right ahead the head of the right wheel (as shown in the figure), a is the wheel direction

![](images/39499f3e98b1ff4ff90e1dc44dcbf4fabb7e4f433c71a11473e503f4c032c59c.webp)

![](images/9908c3d1a73a33c1bc81bef829a6c15746ec25d1e9b69522b868f40bb64c4f00.webp)

(b) Install the rear body height sensor with 2 bolts. Torque: 4.8-7.2 N·m

(c) Install one fixing bolt of rear body height sensor bracket. Torque: 4.8-7.2 N·m

(d) Connect the harness connector of rear body height sensor.

5. Install the rear suspension bottom guard plate I（ ET-48）
6. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）
7. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
8. Connect the scan tool HQ-VDS/select model/read the DTC of AirS controller.
9. Clear the DTC, and disconnect the scan tool.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1adad3cd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） 2. Remove the trunk right covering IR-46） 3. Remove the AirS control unit & bracket assembly (a) Disconnect the harness connector of AirS control unit & bracket assembly.

![](images/2d519a294d495a33b7ab5209bb22fef5274f44e1f53b1e7cd8102bba4a5f6d1a.webp)

(b) Remove 3 nuts and detach the AirS control unit & bracket assembly.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_02689473` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/868d34031aa5dac97a3cadbe389f13cbcac933f6468ba14d95a988b5301d37df.webp)

1. Install the AirS control unit & bracket assembly.

(a) Install the AirS control unit & bracket assembly with 3 nuts.

Torque: 8-10 N·m

(b) Connect the harness connector of AirS control unit & bracket assembly.

2. Install the trunk right cover （ IR-54）

3. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）
4. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
5. Connect the scan tool HQ-VDS/select model/module programming/programmable module installation/select AirS controller/write configuration code, VIN, and carry out vehicle height calibration, etc.
6. Control the vehicle to be lifted and lowered several times to check whether the system is normal.
7. Clear the DTC, disconnect the HQ-VDS, and exit the lifting mode.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e1a62bb1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
2. Connect the HQ-VDS and enter the maintenance mode to exhaust the AirS system. (Reserve 3bar pressure holding gas)
3. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） Remove the rear suspension bottom guard II（ ET-47）
5. Remove the solenoid valve assembly
(a) Disconnect the connecting air pipe of the front air spring & continuous damping control vibration damper assembly. Tip: Please use two wrenches at the same time to ensure that the pressure retaining valve above will not be removed. Attention: There may be air pressure in the pipeline, so loosen the nut slowly. After the air pipe is removed, please press the front air spring to ensure that the air in the spring is not completely discharged.
(b) Disconnect the harness connector of the solenoid valve assembly.

![](images/a0925dffa4ea3e9a0dcd8f2b754b38bc727c0af1fa38e6ba791bf372516d3add.webp)

![](images/6174ef8c7b072bd7a579ee38f89498b54e732ee162fc8914fe92230302773e7d.webp)

![](images/24a8cbececd41f174321d5a84440dc259ea7527904de4b74dd7925ad2b4aefb5.webp)

(c) Remove the 6 connecting air pipes on the solenoid valve assembly.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a4219d69` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

There may be air pressure in the pipeline, so loosen the nut slowly.

![](images/aafdb969579ae70af2f350aeaeb61da10168c51f2fddb6f4e01858e1179d651d.webp)

(d) Disconnect the three air pipes fixed by the three-pipe clamp at the front of the solenoid valve assembly.

![](images/af5ad150c1b2d4dafb12b70b4b5ff76ebcc0558ea0fcd16ebc167fa1cf55f2a9.webp)

(e) Disconnect the three air pipes fixed by the three-pipe clamp at the rear of the solenoid valve assembly.

![](images/55ce5c9e7a6b53218e3f77d8d9cca00c519788737f3c41e2fc635f55d8c050bf.webp)

(f) Remove 2 bolts and detach the solenoid valve assembly.

![](images/512179f1cb1c7c451fbcdff573e8f256859db2f6518c83611cdced9b1d02fd35.webp)

(g) Remove the locking ring A inside the VOSS connector, and detach the connector connecting the solenoid valve air pipe and VOSS. Tip: The VOSS connector connecting air pipe is a disposable part, and must be replaced with a new one each time it is removed.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6450921c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/534a13cd4bcaddba520b337ae4a7fbadf48a9b925e1e366ee37070780ac62da5.webp)

1. Install the solenoid valve assembly (a) Install the solenoid valve assembly with 2 bolts. Torque: 5-6N·m

![](images/39d8908f30806c9103a7a88d225cfb7a61d5a926e995ce81433feb0d22ed29b5.webp)

(b) Install the 6 air pipe connecting VOSS joints to the solenoid valve assembly, and do not pull out the dust cover of air pipe connecting VOSS joint.

### Torque: 5-6N·m
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_64085e4e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip: The air pipe connecting VOSS joint is a disposable part, and must be replaced with a new one during the installation.

![](images/c4b9a81938652127977d252f16743f716e3665fb38e85962345af3607ea7883c.webp)

(c) Pull out the dust cover of the VOSS connector connecting air pipe, and insert the air pipe. Tip: The insertion depth of the air pipe is 17 mm-25 mm, or only one label mark can be seen after inserting the air pipe. When inserting the air pipe, the color of the air pipe should correspond to the color of the solenoid valve sticker.

![](images/47d1cd74ff70726fd66ffc6bc2c8ff38e6d86ef61539ab832c0dc9e4e1e58fa6.webp)

(d) Install the 3 air pipes fixed by the three-pipe clamp at the front of the solenoid valve assembly.

![](images/36bfcb650dcbf179c34c2b5384a87d6fa779e248ec193d2af3ad4d313effb3b3.webp)

(e) Install the 3 air pipes fixed by the three-pipe clamp at the rear of the solenoid valve assembly.

![](images/57cb252a65b5f4de94075a6d596068deb810f3384efba27472b0878af70ee14d.webp)

![](images/66100c2b8581884887be6be383425748e361ddc8bf253036844053b14e798427.webp)

(f) Connect the harness connector of solenoid valve assembly. Tip: After the installation is completed, the HQ-VDS should be used to adjust the body height mode to check whether the AirS functions normally. Inflate with the HQ-VDS, and use a leak detector or a reagent that is harmless to rubber to check for leakage.
(g) Install the connecting air pipe of the front air spring & continuous damping control vibration damper assembly. Tip: Please use two wrenches at the same time to ensure that the pressure retaining valve above will not be damaged. After the installation is completed, the HQ-VDS should be used to adjust the body height mode to check whether the AirS functions normally. Inflate with the HQ-VDS, and use a leak detector or a reagent that is harmless to rubber to check for leakage.
2. Install rear suspension bottom guard II（ET-48）
3. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_643c15e5` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
2. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
3. Remove the rear suspension bottom guard II（ ET-47）
4. Remove the solenoid valve assembly （AS-153）
5. Remove the air compressor assembly

![](images/c3a5cb6bc80d315c588a5fd1db8d48ddf5a6b0447d18f4946651eb35f483fc53.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of air compressor assembly temperature sensor.

![](images/95b8a89211d31a991144de6f1902f6ba75c67068cda7f0f3e244257a9ac353b4.webp)

(b) Disconnect the harness connector of the air compressor assembly solenoid valve.

![](images/744628020c546a0cb376c552521d71a870ef15d00abd59a3c692369514d1f4cf.webp)

(c) Disconnect the harness connector of air compressor assembly.

(d) Disengage the retaining clips for the harness connector of air compressor assembly.

![](images/e8b4c1fc59976e2eb9720964fe66b9f936404046030389da7bf5aa8ddab50f67.webp)

(e) Disconnect the connecting air pipe of air compressor assembly.

![](images/8e61ab3b3b40c516209c7caae23d2c3d022b3dad7718b5f4df26cbc77201bdc2.webp)

(f) Remove the locking ring A inside the VOSS connector, and detach the VOSS connector connecting the air pipe of the compressor assembly.

Tip: The VOSS connector connecting air pipe is a disposable part, and must be replaced with a new one each time it is removed.

![](images/dee1e12bb22b2df81f6bcd360569d8a709db306646c4478536698d93ecfd9010.webp)

(g) Detach 1 hose clamp and disconnect the connecting intake pipe of air compressor assembly.

![](images/a1e74e6dc2ec767b18872c4d01eea73ea9c4439aa6da52e46afdff21b60f9351.webp)

(h) Remove 4 nuts and detach the air compressor assembly.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ff883ab1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the air compressor assembly (a) Install the air compressor assembly with 4 nuts. Torque: 22-27 N·m

![](images/277c7f3b6b2742b54e7d3b57e0677f4a9c8b030c72dc91bc0f05f8e6d38fa067.webp)

(b) Connect the connecting intake pipe of air compressor assembly with 1 hose clamp.

(c) Install the VOSS connector connecting air pipe to the air compressor assembly, and do not pull out the dust cover of the air pipe connecting VOSS connector.

### Torque: 5-10 N·m
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1825f997` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip: The air pipe connecting VOSS joint is a disposable part, and must be replaced with a new one during the installation.

(d) Pull out the dust cover of the VOSS connector connecting air pipe, and insert the air pipe. Tip: The insertion depth of the air pipe is 17 mm-25 mm, or only one label mark can be seen after inserting the air pipe.

![](images/ea7ffc9ef0701cf67687f9a1e431d4e2f7ae42f9ab890b3dd39a8cce435ed3a7.webp)

(e) Install the harness connector fixing clip of air compressor assembly.

![](images/b3dfeaa365491fc986d8758e2da0699d903013e06defe260cb8876b358c197b0.webp)

(f) Connect the harness connector of air compressor assembly. Tip: After the air compressor assembly is installed, inflate with the HQ-VDS, and use a leak detector or a reagent that is harmless to rubber to check for leakage.

![](images/6c8c89b84ee69adfe44a6ba681d3fcb27453053d654397eb76052fe5d8d414c2.webp)

(g) Install the harness connector of the air compressor assembly solenoid valve.

![](images/ee7d8a3a3874cdb1ca8a9d54f3570fcbb2b69214b0a46cba524b0d5d900de912.webp)

(h) Install the harness connector of air compressor assembly temperature sensor.

2. Install the solenoid valve assembly （AS-155）
3. Install rear suspension bottom guard II（ET-48）
4 Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）

5. Connect the scan tool HQ-VDS to adjust the body height mode and check whether the air compressor functions normally.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c51abcd8` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the right rear wheel shield II（ET-32）
3. Remove the compressor intake pipeline assembly

(a) Disengage 1 hose clamp and disconnect the compressor inlet pipe assembly.

(b) Remove 1 air pipe retaining clip.

![](images/c7c862fa7589a70bb4163c9169dba3f03c0cf1e9ab9c31f4af960f4fdb6cc8e4.webp)

![](images/689341f5743bf8881163228a830b34aa3df184897afbd621f63f160bed3d7bb1.webp)

![](images/c8c51062afa2d9f789f1252f08f89b7ed8a709426e56e7ac72fcacbc3e6f240d.webp)

![](images/853ca1622a206696031922ce889fc02fa813d13d1340308b903e758d4a9a23c4.webp)

![](images/02d9d7176ce699bb0906e8a427ea656ac99cc4969c9239fd1cb1415e48aa03ad.webp)

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_cc888527` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/95109e41f16a069f5cc444116239f649f0a21f5954a4556eaa35ff3d53c1671e.webp)

Tip: The air pipe connecting VOSS joint is a disposable part, and must be replaced with a new one during the installation.

(c) Pull out the dust cover of the VOSS connector connecting air pipe, and insert the air pipe. Tip: The insertion depth of the air pipe is 17 mm-25 mm, or only one label mark can be seen after inserting the air pipe. After the air reservoir is installed, inflate it with the HQ-VDS, and use a leak detector or a reagent that is harmless to rubber to check for leakage.

damper assembly

2. Connect the HQ-VDS and enter the maintenance mode to exhaust the AirS system. (Reserve 3bar pressure holding gas)
3. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） Disassemble the front wheel of the vehicle TW-5）
5. Remove the front air spring & continuous damping control vibration damper assembly (a) Remove 2 bolts and detach the left front hose bracket.

![](images/f925711452edaf241c9bb1f7b7af5a039d88c73693cf0f7fd6ab9ce80ac8b7ef.webp)

(e) Disconnect the connecting air pipe of the front air spring & continuous damping control vibration damper assembly. Disconnect the fixing claws for connecting air pipe of the front air spring & continuous damping control vibration damper assembly.

damper assembly

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e338705e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
2. Connect the HQ-VDS and enter the maintenance mode to exhaust the AirS system. Attention: Before air discharging, lift the vehicle until the wheels are off the ground. The vehicle must stay off ground after air discharging.
3. Remove the rear air spring assembly

![](images/f446ce6e50185d37af4f677a2d599b0db1ffcc4e0d15c3c98476121b348785ee.webp)

(a) Disconnect the connecting air pipe of the rear air spring assembly.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_533e3c8c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

There may be air pressure in the pipeline, so loosen the nut slowly.

![](images/4b6874bec6174ab8bfdb5837543c032436f9a3454b82d1c0d2d00f72628a6213.webp)

(b) Press down the rear air spring assembly and remove it.

![](images/cafeeff6666481aa95c924566289793a58a1ac98a9e90a501339abc776bef370.webp)

(c) Remove the locking ring A inside the VOSS connector, and detach the VOSS connector connecting the air pipe of the rear air spring assembly. Tip: The VOSS connector connecting air pipe is a disposable part, and must be replaced with a new one each time it is removed.

![](images/29d2062a5cb2f10f8a6d3f73f1ed589679217226855ab4861d94c5013615b6c0.webp)

### 1. Install the rear air spring assembly.
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_89dc77f4` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Install the VOSS connector connecting air pipe to the rear air spring assembly, and do not pull out the dust cover of the VOSS connector connecting air pipe. Tip: The VOSS connector connecting air pipe is a disposable part, and must be replaced with a new one during the installation.

![](images/0df4a318ea5dc52dc056afa5fa8709f60bd143c28435af41da2f39c01a9a147e.webp)

(b) Press the air spring assembly and place it on the steering arm. Tip: Note that the lower end of the spring and the corresponding structure of the steering arm should be clamped completely.

![](images/b4b373bcc143fd21ebe6443e624674d9d1c6ac2e4edb6c9b973b5f0f7a43955f.webp)

(c) Pull out the dust cover of the VOSS connector connecting air pipe, and insert the air pipe. Tip: The insertion depth of the air pipe is 17 mm-25 mm, or only one label mark can be seen after inserting the air pipe.

![](images/fb9f574d23de3054e5af90b1a70912ecb4101964314537edb97dbad5f2dcb299.webp)

(d) Clamp the air spring assembly to the chuck on the body.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b29a876f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

After connecting the HQ-VDS for inflation, check whether the upper end of the spring and the body are clamped smoothly. Be careful not to damage the rear air spring assembly.

Press firmly on the air spring body and check for fold. If there are folds, stop the inflation and disassemble the spring and air pipe joints, and then reinstall them on the vehicle. If there are still folds, the spring needs to be replaced with a new one.

Tip:

After inflation, it is recommended to use a leak detector or a reagent that is harmless to rubber to check for leakage.

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

### 2. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_65476ada` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/3d76a9dd041cb0c87922ec7ed998ab5ba26249d98c27c5ec50b0c2ea8a1e240f.webp)

3. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

### 4 General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_55ceae72` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the trailer identification control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(b) After reconnecting the battery, the door control system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.
(c) During the driving process, the driver is still the first responsible person and needs to observe the surrounding conditions of the vehicle.

### System description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_289def81` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Trailer left turn signal control: After receiving the command to turn ON/OFF the left turn signal, control the trailer left turn signal to turn ON/OFF, and detect the lamp status.
2. Trailer right turn signal control: After receiving the command to turn ON/OFF the right turn signal, control the trailer right turn signal to turn ON/OFF, and detect the lamp status.
3. Trailer position light control: After receiving the command to turn ON/OFF the position light, control the trailer position light to turn ON/OFF, and detect the lamp status.
4 Trailer rear fog light control: After receiving the command to turn ON/OFF the rear fog light, control the trailer rear fog light to turn ON/OFF, and detect the lamp status.
5. Trailer reversing light control: After receiving the command to turn ON/OFF the reversing light, control the trailer reversing light to turn ON/OFF, and detect the lamp status.
6. Trailer brake light control: After receiving the command to turn ON/OFF the brake light, control the trailer brake light to turn ON/OFF, and detect the lamp status.
7. Trailer emergency brake light control: After receiving the command to turn ON/OFF the emergency brake light, control the trailer emergency brake light to turn ON/OFF, and detect the lamp status.
8. Feedback trailer mode: After receiving the trailer mode ON or OFF command, feedback the trailer ON/OFF status.
9. Trailer power supply: Power the trailer when TICU wakes up.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_162f752e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-47）
2. Remove the trunk rear wall guard （ IR-46）
3. Disassemble the trailer identification controller assembly.

![](images/05b66ac732ec0a1b9f234343665b77398c597d4ec1fcb9711d4a96aee16aca44.webp)

![](images/4562421999d81338415a5250004844a2352a9031b790e2a74ad287e10e6214e9.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of the trailer identification controller assembly.

(b) Remove 2 nuts to detach the trailer identification controller assembly.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_dfb918aa` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the trailer identification controller assembly.

![](images/69c8d5c9d2e4b91184add121c77d8b88c6a9e45784631d1e33b681d27cd031ff.webp)

(a) Install the trailer identification controller assembly with 2 bolts. Torque: 6-8N·m

(b) Install the harness connector of the trailer identification controller assembly.

2. Install the trunk rear wall guard （ IR-54）

### 3. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_351cafbf` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check on the BCM control system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the BCM control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door contro system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 1. BCM
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_379eb05d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The BCM mainly controls the switching signal input of some body electrical appliances, such as front anti-theft horn, interior light, footwell lamp, ambient light, tire pressure monitoring, windshield cleaning pump, charging port cover, etc. and it also communicates with light rain sensor, sunroof motor, front wiper, combination switch, ambient light and RF transmitter through LIN bus.

### 2. The BCM has the following functions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_025d312b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) BCM integrates and manages various body electrical systems such as interior light, wiper system and tire pressure monitoring system, which greatly improves the intelligent control level.
(b) High-speed CAN bus and LIN bus communication, allowing CAN high-speed communication with various electronic control systems, as well as LIN communication with light and rain sensor, ambient lamp, sunroof motor, front wiper, combination switch, RF transmitter etc.
(c) Self-diagnosis monitoring and control, which can monitor the working state of each interface when the input and output equipment works normally, and can store data in the memory chip in time, exchange data with the scan tool, and transmit self-diagnosis information to the scan tool for rapid troubleshooting when the system fails.

2. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

3. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### 4. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9d6e24d3` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When it is necessary to replace parts or disconnect the connector during the maintenance of the steering column and combination switch control system, the negative cable of battery should be disconnected.
(b) After reconnecting the battery, the door contro system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

5. Precautions for airbag system during operation of steering column and combination switch control system:

(a) Certain maintenance operations will affect the SRS airbag. Be sure to read the Precautions" of the SRS airbag before maintenance.

### 1. ESCCU
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c0de8782` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The regulation of the electric steering column is realized by the control unit, which triggers the manual regulating switch to control the

### (ESCCU)
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_539e79e0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

actions of the two regulating motors. The memory switch signal is collected by the seat control module (SCM) which judges the position memory/recall and other working modes according to the functional logic definition and sends the working mode and other information to the CAN network.

(b) The ESCCU communicates with other control units through the high-speed CAN bus, obtains ignition switch position information from the bus, gear position signals and vehicle speed signals from the gateway, memory and recall commands from the SCM, thus controlling the function mode of the steering column.

### 2. Steering column position regulating function
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6bf56f54` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The steering column assembly integrates the regulating motor and the controller, and the up and down regulating motors and the front and back regulating motors can be controlled by the steering column control unit to extend/retract or tilt up/down the steering column.

When the steering column tilt motor and sensor are open-circuited, or short-circuited to ground or power supply, the power adjustable steering column control unit will record the DTC.

![](images/e46001d1397f9a2e6d9e91f638396b1d39de121a471abf306988da52354c53ff.webp)

### Description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_49bafe0b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When the communication between the power adjustable steering column control unit and other systems is abnormal or interrupted, the power adjustable steering column control unit will record the DTC.

![](images/88d7c5a9bf008153c5626a151423e2c52ce43bce81d032b8eaab68003a53d874.webp)

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8e8a5865` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Note: For the communication-related DTCs, please refer to CAN communication system for specific analysis steps.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0c8debaf` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the lower left guard of instrument IP-1）
3. Remove the ESCCU

![](images/e6fb44a8201d99ba2454f32240b5d93ee8e745690fbbec2b169383cab90b213a.webp)

(a) Disconnect the ESCCU connector.

(b) Remove 2 bolts to detach the ESCCU.

### 1. Install the ESCCU
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_68559d13` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/df8ed9e3589dd3511eac22e772aca6ecaa9c6e0e283b817b7229d98fe16a5133.webp)

(a) Install the ESCCU with 2 bolts. Torque: 4-6N·m

![](images/a997f63c6bc5abadfb15966de33a5e36decdc649d1ffc3db503f5e9c2b98a116.webp)

(b) Connect the ESCCU harness connector.

2. Install the lower left guard ofinstrument （IP-6）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e366d364` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the steering column upper cover （SR-40）
3. Remove the steering column lower cover （SR-40）
4. Remove the combination switch （ SR-34）
5. Remove the lower left guard of instrument IP-1）
6. Remove the steering column assembly

![](images/619622efc81596057bc306fdc3a79a20c01a53d68c8629af5df0d18d1e0c947c.webp)

(a) Disconnect the steering column harness clip.

![](images/ed512bd0fd81c34b6098fc266a77d24705428b947716e651824a7526f41f2976.webp)

(b) Disconnect the steering column harness connector.

![](images/3d6a0b118419516b0c807ca460c25079c66b9ddaa77e55855a732d03b02bc469.webp)

(c) Remove one bolt to disengage the steering intermediate shaft with dust cover assembly.

![](images/00390611ff46cec6f0b1403ee7c4c694a97500db2676d0bafa6828492232cdfc.webp)

(d) Remove 4 bolts to detach the steering column assembly.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d0f2db10` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the steering column assembly (a) Install the steering column assembly with 4 bolts.

![](images/def11fe8a90fcd3782ae552a63e2712a7646ecc392e8b8d7e82ca40473efc38e.webp)

Torque: 17-23N·m

![](images/69d8893f429ca8a23067eb91af79442945a12630cb4f13c12b7ddad02c124f7f.webp)

(b) Install the intermediate steering shaft & dust cover assembly with one bolt. Torque: 25-33N·m

(c) Install the steering column harness clip.

![](images/e9b0538efa963878f124cd85aafb3173b506a59a362d23a67f3e45af63b2efb3.webp)

(d) Connect the steering column harness connector.

2. Install the combination switch （ SR-35）
3. Install the steering column uppercover （SR-42）
4 Install the steering column lowercover （SR-42）
5. Install the lower left guard ofinstrument （IP-6）
6. Connect the negative terminal of thebattery CH-54）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_cba3f29d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the steering wheel（ SR-44）
3. Remove the steering column upper cover （SR-40）
4. Remove the steering column lower cover （SR-40）
5. Remove the clock spring （ SR-37）
6. Remove the combination switch

![](images/0a4868809930c54498f69c01f39ecd22ac10a509a32a7d19c4ea7af435a58c8f.webp)

(a) Disconnect the combination switch harness connector.

![](images/0a0a0faf2bcacd69700530c123e70a690f63b582c9f5c2d11d90d2f27330dc4b.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt to detach the combination switch.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9ee3bfeb` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the combination switch (a) Install the combination switch with one bolt.

![](images/998148b571064bc2112b23a9c1ad84ec3cd5ef4d074297e8a9228ab2ff7c2d93.webp)

![](images/30dd3b6699e769c0b579b487f626cc450ea471d7cee44d389500bb8cb719f8e1.webp)

(b) Connect the combination switch harness connector.

2. Install the clock spring （ SR-38）

3. Install the steering column lower cover （SR-42）
4. Install the steering column upper cover （SR-42）
5. Install the steering wheel（ SR-45）
6. Connect the negative terminal of the battery CH-54）
7. Re-adjust the front wheel toe-in.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_cba3f29d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the steering wheel（ SR-44）
3. Remove the steering column upper cover （SR-40）
4. Remove the steering column lower cover （SR-40）
5. Remove the clock spring

![](images/0c96f7c11408fbf9aad27c59eca37a14e568c3cdb779843a71c5f65b0859db07.webp)

(a) Disconnect the clock spring harness connector.

![](images/f03f5cfb02069af29130daeb692042762894efc2ee0c4b02208160050582d382.webp)

(b) Disengage 3 retaining clips to detach the clock spring. Tip: Use tape to secure the clock spring to prevent it from moving before removal.

### 1. Install the clock spring
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_755f8c6f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/6bf1027c5898716d8018b11175fd93aedfac64f0cd9f0a537981b14662f84001.webp)

(a) Engage 3 retaining clips and install the clock spring. Tip: Check that the clock spring fully contacts the steering column.

![](images/119d3630b66753a21a66289ed7984636b5974c20e2e3ce2c73fe472e57726a0e.webp)

(b) Connect the clock spring harness connector.

2. Install the steering column lowercover （SR-42）

3. Install the steering column upper cover （SR-42）
4. Install the steering wheel SR-45）
5. Connect the negative terminal of the battery CH-54）
6. Re-adjust the front wheel toe-in.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_375dce71` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the driver airbag （ RS-207）
3. Remove the steering wheel （ SR-44）
4. Adjust the driver seat to a proper working position
5. Remove the steering column upper cover

![](images/41cb6fc17fc3a3f5378095f57d3128f436de4841dcfd7be62bb731d11dc9cc32.webp)

(a) Disengage 2 fixing claws to detach the steering column upper cover. Tip: Use a screwdriver to pry off the steering column upper cover.

6. Remove the steering column lower cover (a) Remove one fixing screw of the steering column lower cover.

![](images/9ca1efbc2eaf1d2c684b15671b0d1dbf295611336657e2dfd4de79b63fbd77ac.webp)

![](images/16c756fe53c2b6913bcef64375b81bfaade6a07614dc27a4776f488ac2b3b86c.webp)

(b) Remove 2 fixing screws to disengage the steering column lower cover.

![](images/6e9a5a47bbd01299d14b6b704fd4ef6a6d28ea2bbb637b799b99c08b7e0b5783.webp)

(c) Disconnect the harness connector of the steering column adjustment switch to detach the steering column lower cover.

![](images/751cfe429a403c38da117a08025c561b66ac77087319a32fb041a462d6f172d8.webp)

(d) Disengage 2 retaining clips to detach the steering column adjustment switch.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2db83276` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the steering column lower cover (a) Engage 2 retaining clips and install the steering column adjustment switch.

![](images/a452eb250428f55d4ea4b41654447fb7b5abe28d75ce211a741485d0f63e0b49.webp)

![](images/8baed0d0a4ee658dd67113decfdbd23fb92b77ce99c6d69dcd46299b63f74018.webp)

(b) Connect the harness connector of steering column adjustment switch.

![](images/071b6b72b9e392f98443ecf7dcc2b253174d305f50f25c90f0c4bca265aa1588.webp)

(c) Install the steering column lower cover with 2 screws.

![](images/4ebc3e7389e94b47d90aa1342566b7eda9a88708b3cfc1ba806302f5fe9e817a.webp)

(d) Install one fixing screw of the steering column lower cover.

![](images/58751342ae8939d2b2c4e7a8786de89f6faa996cb9d8cc9af18a73d5d8314d86.webp)

2. Install the steering column upper cover (a) Engage 2 fixing claws and install the steering column upper cover.

3. Install the steering wheel SR-45）
4. Install the driver airbag （ RS-208）
5. Connect the negative terminal of the
battery （ CH-54）
6. Re-adjust the front wheel toe-in.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_4cf4e8a2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the driver airbag RS-207）
3. Remove the steering wheel

![](images/64b628c483af8dd24c2607933bea347ca2d1b9f78527cf74b496f408d924370f.webp)

(a) Disconnect the steering wheel harness connector.

(b) Remove one nut to detach the steering wheel.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_70887e3d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the steering wheel

![](images/e50687a0b58bec08a3435115b000e8d527c5f6f4e9ab0731963e6683b65b950e.webp)

(a) Install the steering wheel with one nut. Torque: 32-48N·m

(b) Connect the steering wheel harness connector.

2. Install the driver airbag （ RS-208）

3. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54） Re-adjust the front wheel toe-in.

### 3. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8ac6a6d9` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The check on the LF door control system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the LF door contro system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door contro system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 1. LF door control unit
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ece625ec` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The LF door control unit mainly realizes the functions of controlling the windows, door locks, exterior rearview mirrors and closing doors, detecting the state of the doors and locks, and driving the door lights.
(b) Self-priming door: during the door closing process, after the latch gets in touch with the buckle, the door control unit drives the self-priming motor to complete the door closing.

### 3. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_26f14d8d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The check on the RF door control system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the RF door control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door contro system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 1. RF door control unit
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_76c6d72a` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The RF door control unit mainly realizes the functions of controlling the window, door lock and pull-in door, detecting the door and lock status, driving the door lamp.
(b) Self-priming door: during the door closing process, after the latch gets in touch with the buckle, the door control unit drives the self-priming motor to complete the door closing.

### 1. Power (ignition) switch notation:

2. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### 3. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7e7a9590` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The check on the door control system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation after overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the LR door control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door control system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 1. LR door control unit
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_546e9fd5` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The LR door control unit mainly realizes the functions of controlling the window, door lock and pull-in door, detecting the door and lock status, driving the door lamp.
(b) Self-priming door: during the door closing process, after the latch gets in touch with the buckle, the door control unit drives the self-priming motor to complete the door closing.

### 1. Power (ignition) switch notation:

### 3. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_35965b78` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check on the RR door control system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the RR door control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door contro system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

RR door control unit

### 1. RR door control unit
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_bd0a9c11` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The RR door control unit mainly realizes the functions of controlling the window, door lock and pull-in door, detecting the door and lock status, driving the door lamp.
(b) Self-priming door: during the door closing process, after the latch gets in touch with the buckle, the door control unit drives the self-priming motor to complete the door closing.

### 1. Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_19f6d766` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The trunk lid can be opened by using the trunk lid opening button, passive entry function or wireless remote control.

(a) Opening the trunk lid (1) Opening the trunk lid from inside the car When the vehicle is stationary and the trunk lid is closed, press the internal opening button of the trunk lid to unlock and open the trunk lid. (2) Open the trunk lid from outside the vehicle When the vehicle is locked, if you carry the smart key, you can press the external opening button of the trunk lid to unlock and open the trunk lid; when the vehicle is unlocked, press the external opening button of the trunk lid to unlock and open the trunk lid. (3) Wireless remote control When the power (ignition) switch is in "OFF" mode, and the trunk lid is closed, press and hold to unlock and open the trunk lid.
(b) Closing the trunk lid (1) Trunk lid switch 1. Trunk lid close button: Press the trunk lid close button, and the trunk lid will automatically close. 2. One-click lock button: When the power (ignition) switch is turned to OFF, all the doors will be closed; carry the RKE and ensure that no other recognizable RKE is in the vehicle, press the one-click lock button, the trunk lid will automatically be closed and the vehicle will be locked after a few seconds.

(2) Trunk lid inside open button

1. When the vehicle is stationary and the trunk lid is open, press and hold the open button in the trunk lid until the trunk lid is closed.

(3) Wireless remote control

1. When the power (ignition) switch is in "OFF" mode, and the trunk lid is opened, press and hold the button until the trunk lid is closed.

### Description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a097c971` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When the communication between the back door control unit with other systems is abnormal or interrupted, the back door control unit will record the DTC.

![](images/1a24e9fe5071829c0ab78915e42200828af6272c22b4fd03393361f8edd27ac9.webp)

![](images/37595b0bd1785a0e675634897c7f16004a5afb86b36e829dbc9b570f663e40ca.webp)

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8e8a5865` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Note: For the communication-related DTCs, please refer to CAN communication system for specific analysis steps.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9603af48` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） 2. Remove the trunk closing switch assembly

![](images/74a89ed6d8f603a171dbdc524a3e6637fc03e9a11b770c965159994b66e5ea2d.webp)

(a) Separate 2 locking clips and disengage the trunkclosing switch assembly. Tip: Do not completely remove the trunk closing switch assembly.

![](images/df53b85ae2c38cd89ac79183f94c4c41ef571ed59408a6a07411dac57788caf7.webp)

(b) Disconnect the harness connector of the trunk closing switch assembly to detach the trunk closing switch assembly.

3. Remove the trunk outside release switch assembly

![](images/a32e726f710ed0e0e1ace2435bc2519196fda866c40affe9b3e8f4d0fdb78e9d.webp)

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

2. Power (ignition) switch notation:

![](images/dc31879f528a40635b0a8274b1623a65b3ef6a7c6362dfde3425ba1ae159b84a.webp)

3. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, the seat control systems need to be initialized, otherwise the memory function may not be enabled.

4. General maintenance instructions

(a) Checking the seat control system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the seat control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.

### 1. System description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_033d1d2c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Driver seat controller: exchange information with the door controller assembly, electric steering column control unit and GCU through the CAN bus, complete the driver seat adjustment and memory function, as well as

the rearview mirror position and steering column memory function, and confirm system functions through the sound of the alarms and speakers. (b) Seat climate controller: to realize the heating and ventilation of seats. The corresponding function can be realized by operating the seat ventilation and heating switch.

### 2. Memory function
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3d77c75a` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Memory storage: after adjusting the position of the seat, steering wheel and exterior rearview mirror, press and hold any memory button, the button will be highlighted, and √ will be displayed. Then the position information will be memorized in the button.
(b) Call out the memory: press and release the memory button, the position of seat, steering wheel and exterior rearview mirror automatically adjusts to the memory position set by the button.
(c) Initialization setting: put the power (ignition) switch in the "IG-ON" mode, and press buttons 1 and 3 at the same time to initialize the setting. The alarm speaker buzzes once, indicating that the initialization is successful.

### 3. Welcome function
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d8aee66f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Automatic back: After you turn off the power (ignition) switch and open the left front door, the seat and the steering wheel will automatically move backward for the convenience of the driver getting out of the vehicle.
(b) Automatic return: After you turn on the power (ignition) switch, the seat and the steering wheel will automatically return to the position before leaving the vehicle.
(c) Welcome function setting: the welcome function can be turned on and off in the vehicle settings of the audio system.
