`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5dfd4227` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip: The front passenger seat and the driver seat are removed and installed in the same sequence. 1. Remove the driver seat headrest assembly

![](images/7125a0740d0cb59b5fa519fc777258aa913bfa2ccf7e98a43b026edd51717d87.webp)

(a) Tilt the driver seat assembly back at an angle.
(b) Press and hold the button on the driver seat headrest assembly and pull out the headrest upward.

2. Remove the footwell lamp assembly (a) Disconnect the footwell lamp assembly harness connector.

![](images/5d64213d92783c1be3f506ab687f7b7ae1ee108c0bffbd338dc56818437b9c7c.webp)

![](images/bbd6c7412da787d6eedd581993e10d5e1b33cc27c7414401ec723ac982bb2a05.webp)

(b) Disengage the locking clips and remove the footwell lamp assembly.

3. Disengage the driver seat assembly and the driver side seat belt SB-2）

4. Remove the driver seat assembly

![](images/7e624d1596d8e3f96b764a944afe3787ab74d2cccae396b38d969052a9ee9780.webp)

(a) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the driver seat assembly to move the driver seat assembly to the foremost position.
(b) Remove the 2 bolt covers on the rear side of the driver seat assembly.

![](images/a535197625066f37e02d2710c076b06feb40c850dfa3045bd577064870f9ccb4.webp)

(c) Remove the 2 bolts on the rear side of the driver seat assembly.

![](images/00d3ea326f773aec94d87fa0a53c531fb06c2f0e96c5cbc16eea4d7f20eb05de.webp)

(d) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the driver seat assembly to move the driver seat assembly to the rearmost position.
(e) Remove the 2 bolt covers on the front side of the driver seat assembly.

![](images/2a8fab3a83ee222a937283ba1a7e5cce962210e9560c0228dbeb69c66600a5fd.webp)

(f) Remove the 2 bolts on the front side of the driver seat assembly.

![](images/067414c27968701fc6b78d36eba64407c0d89dd9f6165cb6f87c8ac581933f57.webp)

(g) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the driver seat assembly to move the driver seat assembly to the middle position. At the same time, operate the backrest of the driver seat assembly to the upright position.
(h) Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
(i) Disconnect the 2 connectors under the driver seat assembly.
( Remove the driver seat assembly. Tip: Do not scratch the body or interior trims.

5. Remove the driver seat belt buckle assembly (a) Disengage the harness connector under the driver seat belt buckle assembly.

![](images/9b554ef3642805f675026f5a6402e66fdd51c345488c0350b5bdf4e58f83c731.webp)

![](images/2dce22f7d65409150535b0296fc7e86c57eb980bd531eec60332376157da772d.webp)

(b) Separate 2 clips.
(c) Remove one bolt and remove the driver seat belt buckle assembly.

6. Remove the driver seat back cover assembly (a) Disengage the 2 hooks under the driver seat back cover assembly.

![](images/ba5ecc8d16a5ca0c04ed39304d6a7054d1e4dfd0fdbf821bc7d38a52b9c8f886.webp)

![](images/f7373c0bc2ca9d4f37442fc4c44c0cd2dacd46de45321125627f87631a62ec16.webp)

(b) Separate 6 clips. (c) Separate 2 claws downward and remove the driver seat back cover assembly.

7. Remove the driver seat right shield (a) Remove one screw.

### Removal

![](images/cd0952f3b52e1362ab84c7085d83a44757e0858779d638a4ace6616fda071228.webp)

![](images/6f18622d107a026e0af75a3ab54da408b611b1246f1b0af8ed4dfe4968375c88.webp)

(b) Disengage one clip and remove the driver seat right shield.

8. Install the driver seat left shield (a) Detach the one rear screw.

![](images/816e1f2bac75ead13fddd714fa71ec521a9b875bd4c2dfe5f538a41299a861c0.webp)

![](images/e8ff074ca06c0d9a0d1269f26bdcdb6504c18d370b6bb7e382e27a389b914057.webp)

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_50f891e6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip: The front passenger seat and the driver seat are removed and installed in the same sequence.

1. Install the driver seat backrest assembly

![](images/87595d1356e3581f148b0778a11d2b0b0696b7241105dd9100dc6adc2fb7a378.webp)

(a) Install the driver seat back assembly and tighten 2 bolts. Torque: 16.5–25 N·m

(b) Tighten the 2 bolts. Torque: 16.5–25 N·m (c) Connect the harness connector.

2. Install the driver seat adjustment switch assembly

![](images/a4620aa4c40b0636c4eeed60f4dec81ac25a08bc2bcc85bc5c229d667530988a.webp)

(a) Install the driver seat adjustment switch assembly and tighten 3 screws.

![](images/538cbaa5a95154f158c20b23369f716d0f064967f8afa8721ffd153564bc7b6d.webp)

(b) Install 2 protection covers.

3. Install the driver seat left shield (a) Tighten the one front screw.

![](images/aaec53fe9c2fd6daf7953f81a249185b8d9b3b8ef812b24964cb7b229fcfaba3.webp)

![](images/54cb14172f3f7fbc0ce338619b505efe1a385f390ec09eea4dbe902e6ef58ea7.webp)

(b) Tighten the one rear screw.

![](images/5af9afca114f5ae1b369de630429e11d35915166dd3020d7b6b593e0ecc50eb3.webp)

(c) Install the driver seat outer shield, connect the harness connector and ensure that the 3 clips are installed in place.

![](images/52ab5ed65402401fcd39c35e360f129d76cdddde9b9fb95a1525f172780abcc6.webp)

4. Install the driver seat right shield

(a) Install the driver seat right shield and ensure 1 clip is installed in place.

![](images/110c1f76253c25a0e5170d716771f71f6c0485b30f7cc7d56cb16228ab1af20f.webp)

(b) Tighten one screw.

![](images/b4e724a3537b74b64f40c48fddb2e05ed9ec6aeb654e1efb7fe99962a808e8ed.webp)

5. Install the driver seat back cover assembly

(a) Install the driver seat back cover assembly, ensure that the 2 claws are installed in place and the 6 clips are installed in place

![](images/a1d1d73c8793062f1c61bb2ea672d20fb0c34f27661a6a9f73296d3ba62d45eb.webp)

(b) Install the 2 hooks under the driver seat back cover assembly.

6. Install the driver seat belt buckle assembly

![](images/4a2aad1afa2e43b90c0cc29933f780a9683419b3be57f25918cc99facb64b597.webp)

(a) Install the driver seat belt buckle assembly and tighten one bolt. (b) Make sure that the 2 clips are installed in place.

![](images/ada696c67cc4af4961b3abc236526a4697b7491bc0434b22ebdcd3fd8be498e0.webp)

(c) Connect the harness connector under the driver seat belt buckle assembly.

![](images/14fefd694b51238dc31340d8d406e6472fa507c3ab7a235783ba4f303c1b4f93.webp)

### 7. Install the driver seat assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_32b56e9d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Install the driver seat assembly. Tip: Do not scratch the body or interior trims.
(b) Connect the 2 connectors under the driver seat assembly.
(c) Connect the negative termina of the battery （ CH-54）
(d) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the driver seat assembly to move the driver seat assembly to the middle position. At the same time, operate the backrest of the driver seat assembly to the upright position.

![](images/2898545a1b89d6a69368918adaa14705138ccf0aa09bf7ae40174489cf684ddc.webp)

(e) Tighten the 2 bolts on the front side of the driver seat assembly.

![](images/41aae1865455f5f96efade32662b1fcd5f303563af8d93a43b58871c78dc83c4.webp)

(f) Install the 2 bolt covers on the front side of the driver seat assembly.

![](images/9dcd990625b35e702c2adcae20a7f39ea505a5b3d398f0def2d121c354576e8a.webp)

(g) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the driver seat assembly to move the driver seat assembly to the foremost position.
(h) Tighten the 2 bolts on the rear side of the driver seat assembly.

![](images/afe3fe31c4185ffbca7ba1bf38fb24259a9cfebeda2d0862f4beefc16699a569.webp)

(i) Install the 2 bolt covers on the rear side of the driver seat assembly.

8. Install the connection between the driver seat assembly and the driver side seat belt （SB-5）

9. Install the footwell lamp assembly (a) Connect the harness connector of the footwell lamp assembly.

![](images/a52a08c2ec571371369d0fb4dc5160873a961313ebead1a02dbd35cb2250d2eb.webp)

![](images/11849c3c818a6ddfa2e1c424d08817f475b7a8a129685cd3381366dbe249b2be.webp)

(b) Install the footwell lamp assembly and ensure that the locking clips are installed in place.

![](images/8a8431c99f6b068e33a669604e07896b2d010cfec518972febd4016cfa5709dc.webp)

### 10. Install the driver seat headrest assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_fa3183b8` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Tilt the driver seat assembly back at an angle.
(b) Press the button on the guide sleeve assembly of the driver seat headrest assembly, and press the headrest downwards. Tip: There is a sound when it is completely clamped; shake the headrest 3 times vertically, and confirm that the headrest is locked.

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_63d164c7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:

The removal and installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. The sequence listed below applies to the left side. 1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） 2. Remove the trunk carpet（ IR-46） 3. Remove the storage box under trunk carpet. （ IR-46） 4 Dismantle the rear seat headrest assembly

![](images/6d7b6920289babca72dc24771400458ee3ce0b77d08482e50e7ce0273ea7b115.webp)

(a) Press the button on the guide sleeve assembly of the rear seat headrest assembly, and pull out the headrest upwards.

![](images/eaa3d670cddc42bc616d44d11c45f4f88bc043567c2f1be7f1d07a037f798740.webp)

5. Remove the rear seat cushion.

(a) Disengage 2 fixing clips at the lower part of the rear seat cushion, and remove the rear seat cushion.

6. Disassemble the left rear backrest assembly.

(a) Remove the cover cap of 2 rear seat slide rails at the front.

(b) Remove the 2 front bolts.

![](images/3aae02803471b8b0c7709039c912c0b16c30d59b3ec485f51f971d8ae875817c.webp)

(d) Remove the 3 rear bolts.
(e) Remove the left rear backrest assembly. Tip: Do not scratch the body or interior trims.

7. Disassemble the cover cap of the backrest adjustment handle of the left rear seat.

![](images/b661bbbc6bd576a1ae2168beaf06d07e4fbb51b4d8627bf37ce35753907355c3.webp)

![](images/f4e4e059c81654af038c666a51f31ab6ef7622ae82a4a5f444b9c1db794dc468.webp)

(b) Disengage 5 clips, and remove the outer guard plate assembly of the left rear seat.

9. Disassemble the inner guard plate assembly of the left rear seat.

![](images/25deda4d0e411114885e5227ea34461bd8f99b9f3c7d9a623f2d375d8ed5c82f.webp)

![](images/2c559116c789b209268a1c26ec2574cb429b84c26f98cad923c740c9d9b916a9.webp)

![](images/132d58d9bfa8292d788b6f5d4786aff32bba2e811c3cdad787552ba152483e64.webp)

(c) Disengage 3 clips, and remove the inner guard plate assembly of the left rear seat.

10. Remove the rear left seat belt buckle assembly (a) Disconnect the harness connector of the left seat belt buckle assembly of the back row.

![](images/6723f5e8e5cf540c21c7a8257738a78f274a51b79ebdabe909e455390abfc474.webp)

![](images/8ad08ca5927098eced5df09a78da747f97461eda3b56a99e39e4f75a1e1addc6.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt, and remove the seat belt buckle assembly on the left side of the back row.

11. Remove the rear middle seat belt buckle assembly

![](images/dd5cfa0e70bd93a85fb62fab1a468670ff70978d254cc0a40cfc498f2e0c964b.webp)

### Tip:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_13726175` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The removal and installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Install the left rear seat backrest assembly.

![](images/0d1821e27377c9f1b33af8ab935f0256e257b143f7e937ffea6cb2dbeee24b5c.webp)

(a) Install the left rear seat backrest assembly.
(b) Tighten the 2 bolts. Torque: 39-51N·m

![](images/35aae9ab2c820c9331e2421cbd03fa91164ede8ed1571bffd9cc1bacc77f2618.webp)

(c) Tighten the 2 bolts. Torque: 39-51N·m

2. Install the rear middle seat buckle assembly

![](images/1d6def0b1011b8aed11d9f1182671293cb385466245593aed54768b32b8824d3.webp)

(a) Install the seat belt buckle assembly in the middle of the back row, tighten one bolt, and ensure that the fixing clip is properly installed.
(b) Connect the harness connector of the seat belt buckle assembly in the middle of the back row.

3. Install the rear left seat belt buckle assembly (a) Install the left seat belt buckle assembly in the back row, and tighten one bolt.

![](images/78a70c9665a4c12580b5a5b646b61fecf5e04c3f99e3254e1ee82b0456760341.webp)

![](images/6e34940d1abae92d5450395809366f304ab9a0ccf942b0cb40d6ae0125d9c805.webp)

(b) Connect the harness connector of the left seat belt buckle assembly of the back row.

4. Install the inner guard plate assembly of the left rear seat.

![](images/338460f8fb1784e616b4ef0275c0a763b787f65b83b9abfa5e6dab37ad852fb4.webp)

(a) Install the inner guard plate assembly of the left rear seat, and ensure that 3 clips are properly installed.

![](images/d87710d56a64b2d8b6373305ce0f61850f31ea61c5066bd78f714cd18d4b35f3.webp)

(b) Tighten one screw.

![](images/f78b46142c8335f898fe1ff2e99d0f67c5a3361ae9e9700624994667d2531b52.webp)

(c) Tighten one screw.

5. Install the outer guard plate assembly of the left rear seat.

![](images/f2536e66e78722e0a2451557455c7ee55d4ba8b021c69f24df156591bda5920d.webp)

(a) Install the outer guard plate assembly of the left rear seat, and ensure that 5 clips are properly installed.

![](images/17bb98da5a921f9abe0b68ac63584f91365b5914fa3c04ce6c2afe0096497516.webp)

(b) Tighten one screw.

6. Install the cover cap of the backrest adjustment handle of the left rear seat.

![](images/cc6527ff41b544588d739ff021b5a2a40007b19d0c888f48abdbd01a2d61d120.webp)

(a) Install the cover cap of the backrest adjustment handle of the left rear seat in the arrow direction.

![](images/751f755dfdb3091b1350d16e267ca4a44b9fcac871c18dd43c75fe288fd6147a.webp)

![](images/20361f80c622b52e45716f801d4ce68baff07c00d1ab4e146e502994d6e4f59a.webp)

7. Install the left rear seat assembly

(a) Install the left rear seat assembly. Tip: Do not scratch the body or interior trims.
(b) Tighten 3 rear bolts. Torque: 39-51N·m

(c) Install the cover cap of 2 rear seat slide rails at the back.

(d) Tighten the 2 front bolts. Torque: 39-51N·m

![](images/64ba547bbe4c119fea004217298e093fe1f4c1a76b6ecccc244edb98c9734f83.webp)

(e) Install the cover cap of 2 rear seat slide rails at the front.

![](images/f34c32bc88061e5cd5751be97cd7f5e1eb223e87d678c813f72c8acbb231823f.webp)

### Tip:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_dfa41ed1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

8. Install the rear seat cushion (a) Install the rear seat cushion, and ensure that 2 fixing clips at the lower part of the rear seat cushion are properly installed.

![](images/59e487c0577d6dada917717e1c2cee9e16bf4d9fcc90a69617c9a8caafd17ac5.webp)

### 9. Install the rear seat headrest assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8cd2ded4` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Press the button on the guide sleeve assembly of the rear seat headrest assembly, and press the headrest downwards. Tip: There is a clamping sound when it is completely clamped in; Shake the headrest up and down for 3 times to confirm that the headrest is locked.

10. Install the storage box under trunk carpet （IR-54）
11. Install the trunk carpet IR-54）
12. Connect the negative terminal of the battery CH-54）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a5f44fdd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:

The removal and installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. The sequence listed below applies to the left side.
1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Disassemble the headrest assembly on both sides of the rear seat.
(a) Tilt the left rear seat assembly backwards to a certain angle.
(b) Press the button on the headrest assembly of the left rear seat assembly, and pull out the headrest upwards.

![](images/cd26a4c04858a28cf8aadf32417dcad28c40e91702a2150235ecdf998fe6b948.webp)

![](images/ccc58294d77a906338e4e337f8f4614cfbb9871b5aca40b5fc2dd2ac4e1216ae.webp)

3. Disassemble the left rear backrest assembly.

(a) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the left rear seat assembly to move the left rear seat assembly to the foremost position.
(b) Remove the protection covers of 2 bolts on the rear side of the left rear seat assembly.

![](images/d8941485f256fa04c1859b09659257e10a76aaf3c7292e13280b95c6a350e190.webp)

(c) Remove 2 bolts on the rear side of the left rear seat assembly.

![](images/da9a2dc1112020a7d6f511712e1ba74f6e33f0eafadfe2db6cf5de19110229df.webp)

(d) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the left rear seat assembly to move the left rear seat assembly to the final position.
(e) Remove the protection covers of 2 bolts on the front side of the left rear seat assembly.

![](images/cba0a236c24b49064a28b55f719c603fc91cc3affc5250b2cc054266fdc65c2e.webp)

(f) Remove 2 bolts on the front side of the left rear seat assembly.

![](images/3d6ef2769bd1ab12be024129db8689b6be7b4c0d3b1f43ffa22361aaf90f1cc1.webp)

(g) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the left rear seat assembly to move the left rear seat assembly to the middle position. Meanwhile, move the backrest of the left rear seat assembly to the upright position.
(h) Disconnect 2 connectors under the left rear seat assembly.
(i) Remove the left rear backrest assembly. Tip: Do not scratch the body or interior trims.

4. Disassemble the left rear seat backrest cover assembly. (a) Disengage 2 hooks at the lower part of the left rear seat backrest cover assembly.

![](images/1ba4ba01dd2bcc238506de12b32c02a434500922a34af8a5281a11efccecfdde.webp)

![](images/e695dcb6c1da91679f54e740dfbb64c7da1590ef0eec7860b703c24b9cdc80c9.webp)

(b) Separate 6 clips. (c) Separate 2 claws downwards, and remove the left rear seat backrest cover assembly.

5. Disassemble the left guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/42b42e536dcdae9d83f1e891924c1ed6be8a95840affab2af9931fe6000f6861.webp)

(a) Detach the one rear screw.

![](images/aee5652bcc34bdd3e30a9af6d2502123bc2a770f7bdaa4ccccdb1333cf419657.webp)

(b) Detach the one front screw.

![](images/6fbe9c34862ea9824e90a9b91cdc207ba765cd90add97cf848b17b8c9c12c002.webp)

(c) Separate 3 clips, disengage the harness connector, and remove the outer guard plate of the left rear seat.

6. Disassemble the left rear seat adjusting switch assembly. (a) Remove 2 protection covers.

![](images/f59866bf036624f0c99a91a29dc92aeee9691b4f531c18150815c59f889c1ad7.webp)

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_17b6889c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/088b2e40bc37dbd7f775e8b8933cdcbe3a95ed99517e1d0f29c7cfb7397e79ea.webp)

(b) Remove 3 screws, and then remove the left rear seat adjusting switch assembly.

7. Disassemble the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/119c614ace39a3d318d3500f262bfb6d7c0a37c2f04d68f54d55371f313c816c.webp)

(a) Remove the blanking cover of the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/180680205c47d917a2aa36c5bbe93fd1b4675f49c0c2dbab0d2d7113f5c1c20d.webp)

(b) Remove one screw at the front of the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/c63ef527ab93cab3fc7c81596fc311c2a5842765bf6c2dce305fa29012383832.webp)

(c) Remove one screw at the rear of the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/c6188743ce00b412679aa0aa50f447fc868bb0c8cc0c7d268c1a615eb482e737.webp)

(d) Remove the fixing bolts of the left seat belt buckle assembly in the back row. Tip: Do not completely remove the seat belt buckle assembly on the left side of the back row.

![](images/d0a294510702cb4e22375c164beb0b49c58332ac26972141c557964d5aa53110.webp)

(e) Remove 5 clips, and remove the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/03ae065c8bba0a8894bc59e994a62484794f23ff2e460145b006c80b7ba85ca1.webp)

(f) Disconnect the harness connector, and remove the left seat belt buckle assembly.

![](images/35c6ea7cb937287159fc74932fd91dce9cc1f97a924f76a67e8a2573052bae87.webp)

8. Disassemble the left rear seat backrest assembly.

(a) Detach the harness connector.
(b) Remove 2 bolts.

![](images/f042615b92a43a983c32ad62ff1a5ca428d5e59ef9a52bd86197afd1719ea2f1.webp)

(c) Remove 2 bolts, and then remove the left rear seat backrest assembly.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1ea1f716` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:

The removal and installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Install the left rear seat backrest assembly.

![](images/10b3a3b96bdce577e05488e6bcafcfceaf67dc66e617b1ee5206c1c0d7a86625.webp)

(a) Connect the harness connector.
(b) Install the left rear seat backrest assembly, and tighten 2 bolts. Torque: 39-51N·m

![](images/d813382f943f0699c2f718853ec07c792eb68de3e1cecb45581d436c6bf5c134.webp)

(c) Tighten the 2 bolts. Torque: 39-51N·m

2. Install the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/8ec2208d2c5ec3209a12ea446ee001998ebfa834dde2f7790f2e3971f006f5fc.webp)

(a) Connect the harness connector of the left seat belt buckle assembly.

![](images/3b707371bb9722fe2ffea8b64fa4d1d72277895e4b481d4abffe884e2ce6c2df.webp)

(b) Install the right guard plate of the left rear seat, and install 5 clips at the front properly.

![](images/afa144e9eeb9ea19ced22ed140be23998bd4e9c84a5d1e74309d06e3541a3264.webp)

(c) Install the left seat belt buckle assembly in the back row, and tighten the fixing bolts.

![](images/793131096b4582f9a3072625ffe66934568ad989b0f3dc757ccecbc0afeb0c25.webp)

(d) Tighten one screw at the rear of the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/56b8faf0144917022a9fb356ccfe7990b23b16bccfbaaa3954cfb6ae4d2d4319.webp)

(e) Tighten one screw at the front of the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/a21acadecb5a17f327d43d79bcdbc6881e94da89b1974f2b349603b05b95a7a0.webp)

(f) Install the blanking cover of the right guard plate of the left rear seat.

3. Install the left rear seat adjusting switch assembly.

![](images/a8988e7b1f2f7ebbb0cb219e3a5fdfa470ae10f3b50800f81a4cc5cd350f8636.webp)

(a) Install the left rear seat adjusting switch assembly, and tighten 3 bolts.

![](images/8191c6ec579de20babc0edf094366230e59c6127edd4f2221d0b055baaec2be4.webp)

(b) Install 2 protection covers.

4. Install the left guard plate of the left rear seat.

![](images/e752ee8579089c601c795b880b0d8f9804594517d527cf0c7dbf2d4db80be904.webp)

(a) Connect the harness connector, install the outer guard plate of the left rear seat, and install 3 clips at the front properly.

![](images/51c499d728875da880d45e2a12d5faa46761eacfe88d3813af0f9c74319ed361.webp)

(b) Tighten the one front screw.

![](images/02323f8a682b583dc88dbe0cacf29463144ab323fdbd38d653b81def3dd00470.webp)

![](images/74a7ec0a70b473c2125990e769af85eaacfb8ae037b3cd205668d76620e5d52e.webp)

(c) Tighten the one rear screw.

5. Install the left rear seat backrest cover assembly.

(a) Install the left rear seat backrest cover assembly, and clamp 2 claws upwards. (b) Make sure that the 6 clips are installed in place.

![](images/d55c1d0e1186bc99195a8396ec540c7462aed8662520dd36d1200e6255f1ab0f.webp)

(c) Connect 2 hooks at the lower part of the left rear seat backrest cover assembly.

### 6. Install the left rear seat assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_676cde84` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/928b984db37e385e034d0d6714662ec0c5af6399cd3d3d6db80f048833fed9c1.webp)

(a) Install the left rear seat assembly, and disconnect 2 connectors under the left rear seat assembly.
(b) Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）

![](images/3b37586277b25450eb079ff988c298e71d8575a5d88026e56fa03a295a8bdf50.webp)

(c) Tighten 2 bolts on the front side of the left rear seat assembly. Torque: 39-51N·m

![](images/34b5e26a1279aa4221dac92eb170ce0944fcc8e91a1a8aa392e43e574cfdbff7.webp)

(d) Tighten the protection covers of 2 bolts on the front side of the left rear seat assembly.

![](images/6067a27143247ad9f1f343314e02a1b67b8d304d6efeda75a894f0dd793e4958.webp)

(e) Operate the sliding adjustment frame of the left rear seat assembly to move the left rear seat assembly to the foremost position.
(f) Tighten 2 bolts on the rear side of the left rear seat assembly. Torque: 39-51N·m

(g) Tighten the protection covers of 2 bolts on the rear side of the left rear seat assembly.

![](images/2493994dcffbbd788ab220cd6026e30af96ad39d3c797ff862f79f29afcba63d.webp)

7. Install the headrest assemblies on both sides of the rear seat.

(a) Tilt the left rear seat assembly backwards to a certain angle.
(b) Press the button on the guide sleeve assembly of the driver seat headrest assembly, and press the headrest downwards. Tip: There is a sound when it is completely clamped; shake the headrest 3 times vertically, and confirm that the headrest is locked.

### Third-row seat assembly Parts
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2b975fc1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/16033bb66281a2d0939980aafa87ba80bc0d028a9d48bd7e3c10cf830a537e1e.webp)

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_28ba1717` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the headrest assemblies on both sides of the third-row seat

![](images/9a44089ec2fef58be64a59ec495ccea4fcadabf9e8f7879c7c65f93abca564dc.webp)

![](images/d131f908bcbb3c3501a1d70071b9965a4e094f0245591e35c460924361619704.webp)

![](images/868228e93d7123adaeb1a186d9329d7fba4e64ef469a8887e821bec12c78187a.webp)

![](images/46e97e982b1dae5852e42295162d6774d1210f6212a63f0a7e6103c989763da7.webp)

(a) Stretch the retractable belt of the headrest assembly on both sides of the third-row seat, and remove the headrest assembly on both sides of the third-row seat.

3. Remove the 3rd row seat cushion assembly (a) Disengage 2 lower locking clips.

(b) Disengage 2 lower hooks and remove the third-row seat cushion assembly.

4. Remove the 3rd row seat belt buckle assembly (a) Remove 2 bolts and two third-row seat belt buckle assemblies.

5. Remove the trunk carpet （ IR-46）
6. Remove the trunk left cover （ IR-46）
7. Remove the trunk right cover （ IR-46）

8. Remove the trunk left lower guard （ （ IR-46）
9. Remove the trunk right lower guard （IR-46）
10. Remove the third-row seat back cover assembly (a) Remove 2 bolts on the left side.

![](images/957454550e44848125d46505d0d0015aeac35fbcd1fd50f3152622d7cc9450bd.webp)

![](images/ae47d6647dae88f1be5743da40a67f9babfd967314f006453e1b0d4ee409fff4.webp)

(b) Remove the 2 bolts on the right side and remove the third-row seat back cover assembly.

11. Remove the left guard of the third-row seat (a) Remove one clip on the outer side.

![](images/085e8c8a70fad06c52c2fed9e11cf63ccaf03e526d6d1e4128226c5565a42dfe.webp)

![](images/9d61c908dd4ab525d6c59fbfff589ac7e57c24384b0cfa9741012c533d3a39bb.webp)

(b) Remove one clip on the inner side.

![](images/75da659bbd2197863dd3811f5de1d5b79c33a8718077afe88db90d3330acaeb5.webp)

(c) Disengage 1 clips at the front.

![](images/6f9e28981788280f1b5b395c4e580c90e2c3dbd8f6a04b3a5e7ed519d931a3bd.webp)

(d) Disengage one clip at the rear and remove the left guard of the third-row seat.

12. Remove the middle guard of the third-row seat (a) Remove the middle guard cover of the third-row seat.

![](images/f3cc2883257de0f7feefa89e4750deff5708f8990d5992ff4fd3b9ff24aa3dea.webp)

![](images/21fd4575263f9f6d24dd500347ad10012c51340399a09d42d95f1524d9d437fe.webp)

(b) Remove the two clips on the left and right sides and remove the middle guard of the third-row seat.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_259bf657` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the middle guard plate of seats in the third row.

(a) Install the middle guard plate of seats in the third row, and ensure that 2 clips on the left and right sides are properly installed.

![](images/044530ace68ca7c5f5ced64061fe52699f057eb4ccfdb5b04adb63aa2b1d5636.webp)

(b) Install the blanking cover of the middle guard plate of seats in the third row.

2. Install the left guard plate of seats in the third row.

(a) Install the left guard plate of seats in the third row, and ensure that 1 clip at the rear is properly installed.

![](images/f5ffff478ac899b5114ed2199854bd5ff16983e7140cb991c02215b973dd5730.webp)

(b) Make sure that the one front clip is installed in place.

![](images/6ee4b6123debae4951a5536b991c8cf890e6ca2f517f54d2e2d91fc897fb752a.webp)

(c) Ensure that the 1 clip on the inner side is installed in place.

![](images/05b3293c7459b5645bcc1c3ffc503bd046b492ec54ed01a0125198f2f2a1455b.webp)

(d) Ensure that the 1 clip on the outer side is installed in place.

3. Install the protective covering assembly of the seat backrest of the third row.

![](images/5c35d4fd5f50db276f80589421249cb093ed689753f09bbb570a5bf1f1d53e21.webp)

(a) Install the protective covering assembly of the seat backrest of the third row, and tighten 2 bolts on the right side. Torque: 39-51N·m

![](images/23c3b80828e5e1cc58a6f13ae262e80e46dc1d37576507d3dbdd979660654aa6.webp)

(b) Tighten 2 bolts on the left side. Torque: 39-51N·m

4. Install the trunk right lower guard IR-54） 5. Install the left lower guard plate of the trunk IR-54） 6. Install the trunk right cover （ IR-54）

7. Install the trunk left cover. （ IR-54）

8. Install the trunk carpet（ IR-54）

9. Install the 3rd row seat belt buckle assembly (a) Install two seat belt buckle assemblies of the third row, and tighten 2 bolt.

![](images/94ba7620af87958104700a70b2739090413ad7b7af1d1cd79ba171b635f23adf.webp)

10. Install the 3rd row seat cushion assembly (a) Install the seat cushion assembly of seats in the third row, and ensure that 2 slip hooks at the lower part are properly installed.

![](images/29790e9935e19f7990b5cd425d3fff798c6775fe427269883441874427183620.webp)

![](images/eb785561d15d5ab4bc2f6efa985666601be915bf233b4b6a49ff29cc11336172.webp)

(b) Ensure that the 2 lower clips are installed in place.

11. Install the headrest assemblies on both sides of third-row seat

![](images/942d1940877dc9ba52a0ce8af1d7f3e796ac5eba7ba405ae8c10c47de057f5f0.webp)

(a) Install the headrest assemblies on both sides of third-row seat.

### 2. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7c2a8c14` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during overhaul of the headlamp contro system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(b) After reconnecting the battery, the door control system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 1. Overview of headlamp control system overview
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7ea2434a` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The headlamp leveling system can automatically adjust the headlamp beam height according to the number of occupants,

the load of the vehicle and the road environment to ensure that the headlamps will not interfere with other road users.
(b) Control the front light.
(c) The front lighting control unit has a diagnosis function.

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8e8a5865` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Note: For the communication-related DTCs, please refer to CAN communication system for specific analysis steps.

### 1. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_086aeb0e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/1239cf603adf9ac3ffdf34962cbd0c40fd589d6bea2ab3ab1f3ef4f1163585c2.webp)

2. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

3. General maintenance instructions

(a) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during overhaul of the tail lamp control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(b) The door, seat and other control systems need to be initialized after reconnecting the battery. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 1. Overview of rear light control system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1d9d8069` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The rear lighting control unit controls the lights at the rear of the vehicle, mainly including rear position lights, rear turn signal lights, brake lights, high-mounted brake light, license plate light, reversing lights and rear fog lights. It can protect the external circuit, and the control unit can diagnose the state of the external load.

(b) The rear lighting control unit has a diagnosis function.

### 2. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0656b2bf` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the IHC, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(b) The door, seat and other control systems need to be initialized after reconnecting the battery. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 1. Overview of intelligent high beam control system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0686aa66` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When a vehicle is driving, if there is no other vehicle in front of the vehicle or in the opposite direction within a certain distance in front of the road, this function will be activated. If a vehicle is detected in the front or in the

opposite direction, the system will automatically adjust the high beam to form a dark area in the normal lighting area, so that the driver of the opposing vehicle will not feel dazzling, and increase the driver's sight distance. When the vehicle passes or reaches a certain distance, the high beam will automatically return to the initial state.

(b) The IHC unit has a diagnosis function.

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7ff650ff` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance.

### Danger:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_addcc108` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Before maintaining the high-voltage system or approaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefully read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

2. Power (ignition) switch notation:

![](images/7e5c7f666c58ff8901f3a69b4db5e8d37135823e28606ffc3a82a6cb0e2ab720.webp)

3. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

4. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

5. The refrigerant must be R-1234yf.

6. Do not handle refrigerant in a confined environment or in an area close to open flames.

7. Use the equipment specific to R-1234yf for recycling and filling. Wear protective goggles when working.

8. Precautions for maintenance:

(a) If liquid refrigerant splashes into the eyes or on the skin:

(1) Wash these parts with plenty of cold water and do not rub the eyes or skin.
(2) Apply clean petroleum jelly on the skin.
(3) Go to the hospital for professional treatment immediately.

9. It is forbidden to heat the container storing refrigerant or expose the container to an open flame. Do not drop or impact the container storing refrigerant.

10. Do not run the electric compressor if there is insufficient or no refrigerant in the refrigerant system.

11. Be careful not to add excessive refrigerant to the system. (a) If the refrigerant is overfilled, it will cause problems such as insufficient refrigeration, refrigerant sucking into the compressor and increase in working power consumption of the compressor.

12. Pay attention to check the A/C system for leakage.

(a) The electric compressor is equipped on the model, and the air conditioning system shall be checked for leakage on schedule according to the user manual.

### 13. Compressor refrigerant oil.
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2e83bf8b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The refrigerator oil must be ND-OIL 11.
(b) Because the refrigeration oil is highly hygroscopic, when removing the A/C parts, a plug or plastic tape must be used immediately to isolate the oil from air.
(c) For the electric compressor lubricant, the resistance values of the compressor lubricant of different bands are different. Replacement with other brands of compressor lubricants will affect the insulation impedance value of the compressor.

14. When the refrigerant charging system is connected, and the compressor is working, do not open the high-pressure manifold valve.

(a) It is only allowed to open and close the low pressure valve. If the high-pressure valve is opened, it may cause the refrigerant to flow in the reverse direction and the filling cylinder to rupture.

### 1. A/C performance inspection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_898ad202` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Connect the refrigerant recovery machine to the A/C pipe interface.
(b) Set the vehicle according to the following conditions.
(c) A/C works to stabilize the outlet temperature. (About 5 \~ 6 minutes)
(d) The measured temperature difference between the air outlet and inlet should be: standard value: 10 ～ 20°C

![](images/527673d77eb63ece1fc2869bdf784cc6a294684c763aea221c9863bfc4b8a6da.webp)

2. Check compressor oil level (a) Replace the compressor.

![](images/964ad61394f1866cbf36ea5dcea3a1d2ad8ba8780ccc5df7d818e78c871dac7e.webp)

(1) After removing the old compressor, discharge all compressor oil into a measuring cup. (Discharged oil V1 ml)
(2) If the new compressor has been added with oil in advance, discharge all the compressor oil into a clean measuring cup. Then, fill new oil of V1 ml (the same amount as that discharged form the old compressor) into the new compressor.
(3) If the new compressor is not added with compressor oil in advance, it is necessary to fill V1 ml new oil.

Tip:

About 120 ml oil shall be added to the compressor in advance. During operation, avoid foreign matter and moisture from entering the compressor and the compressor oil.

### system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7f5e26e5` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(b) Replace other parts of the A/C system assembly

(1) After removing the corresponding assembly parts, discharge all the compressor oil in the assembly parts, measure the volume of the oil discharged with a measuring cup, and refill compressor oil of the same amount as the discharged oil after the new assembly parts are installed;
(2) If the amount of oil discharged from the removed assembly is less than 10ml, no replenishment is required.
(3) The new liquid-gas separator is filled with oil of about 150 ml.

(c) Refrigerant recovery and supplement (1) After the refrigerant is recovered from the A/C system with the refrigerant filling machine, the amount of old oil discharged (V2 ml) should be recorded, and then the same amount of new oil (V2 mL) should be filled into the A/C system. Then start vacuuming, and refill the refrigerant.

(d) Replace the assembly components that are obviously damaged and have caused complete leakage of the refrigerant in the A/C system.

(1) If there is no obvious oil stain around the damaged part, follow Point b.
(2) If there is obvious oil stain around the damaged part of the component, add another 20 ml of compressor oil while following Point b;

(e) Specification of compressor oil (1) Refrigerant oil: ND-OIL 11.

(f) Filling amount (1) 120 ± 15 cc

Note:

If the recovery machine has been filled with “refrigerant and compressor oil of another types", it is strictly prohibited to be used for refrigerant filling of EV vehicles.

3. Check condenser assembly

### system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1f639b77` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the heat sink of the condenser assembly is dirty, wash it with water and then blow it dry with compressed air.
(b) When the heat sink of the condenser assembly is bent, straighten it with a screwdriver or plier. Attention: Do not damage the heat sink of the condenser assembly.

### 4. Check the refrigerant gas for leakage
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ca7e163a` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Use a halogen leak detector to check the piping joint for air leakage.
(b) If there is air leakage at the piping joint, check the torque of the standard parts used at the piping joint.

### 5. Replace refrigerant
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_11aa927b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Recover the refrigerant in the "heat pump A/C system"

(1) Start the powertrain.

(2) Operate the cooler compressor under the following conditions:

![](images/945d8d20497883c4b076397771b4d68a76b0ba3f7b4b36881a6a703c524bf5c9.webp)

Tip:
If the A/C does not work because the compressor locks or due to other reasons, there is no need to operate the cooler compressor.
(3) Stop the motor compressor.
(4) Use a refrigerant recovery device to recover refrigerant from the A/C system. Tip: Please use the refrigerant recovery device in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

(b) Fill refrigerant in A/C system (1) Use a vacuum pump or suitable equipment for vacuum cleaning. It is recommended that the ambient

temperature when vacuumizing be at least greater than 0°C. If the temperature is too low, the refrigerant dissolved in compressor oil may not be completely discharged.

(2) Fill refrigerant R-1234yf in A/C system.

Standard filling amount: 1120±25g

Tip:

Do not turn on the A/C switch before filling the A/C system with refrigerant. Otherwise, the compressor may work without refrigerant, causing the compressor to overheat. The amount of refrigerant shall be checked according to the quantity (weight).

Tip:

When using the refrigerant recovery device, make sure that the system can be added with sufficient refrigerant. The refrigerant recovery device cannot recover 100% of the refrigerant in the A/C system.

(c) Warm up the compressor (1) After the battery cable is reconnected, the A/C system will be in warm-up operation after starting, and the compressor speed will not be higher than 4500rpm within 2 minutes.

Tip: When turning on the A/C after removing and installing the A/C system pipeline (including the compressor), be sure to warm up the compressor to prevent damage.

(d) Check for refrigerant leakage.

(1) After refilling the A/C system with refrigerant, use a halogen leak detector to check for refrigerant leakage.

(2) Test under the following conditions:

Turn the ignition switch to the OFF position.

Ensure good ventilation (the halogen leak detectors may react to volatile gas that is not refrigerant, such as gasoline vapor and exhaust gas).

Repeat the check 2 or 3 times.

### system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7a3c401e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Measure the pressure to confirm that there is refrigerant remaining in the A/C system.

![](images/0fd4d01776e6d481438c47f90d642fa3fcf5b6df660c059820a50f7369d6ef85.webp)

(3) Use a halogen leak detector to check the A/C system for refrigerant leakage.

(4) Power off the halogen leak detector, bring it close to the discharge hose, and then turn on the detector. Tip: Once the blower motor stops operation, leave the HVAC assembly idle for more than 15 minutes. Place the halogen leak detector sensor under the drain hose. When the halogen leak detector approaches the discharge hose, make sure the halogen leak detector does not react to volatile gases. If the interference of volatile gas cannot be avoided, the vehicle shall be lifted to check for leakage.

(5) Disconnect the pressure sensor connector and leave it for about 20 minutes. Place the halogen leak detector sensor close to the pressure sensor to check for leakage. Tip: When checking for leakage, the presence of oil stains at the connections indicates that there is leakage.

### 1. Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1edc6875` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The vehicle is equipped multi-temperature zone climate system. This system adopts both advanced heat pumpA/C system and high-voltage water heater PTC, to realize cooling and heating functions with only one

### system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8a34d700` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

system. The electric A/C system is used for cooling in summer, the heat pump A/C system is used for heating in winter, and the high-voltage water heater PTC heater is used to supplement heating when the ambient temperature is low. The heat pump A/C system is efficient and energy-saving, which can effectively improve the range of the vehicle. (b) The A/C system is fully automatically controlled, which can realize the cooling and heating functions automatically according to the temperature set by the user, and can also realize manually the ventilation function and the setting of the air inlet and outlet modes.

### 2. Operating the automatic A/C system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e08ccd69` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) In the AUTO A/C mode, you can set the temperature by tapping the temperature setting button according to your personal needs, and the set temperature is shown on the temperature display.

(b) AUTO button indicator: The vehicle is provided with auto A/C control for the driver, the front passenger and the three zones of the 2nd row respectively. If the air volume setting is operated, the AUTO button indicators for the three zones of the 2nd row turn off. If the air outlet mode for each zone is operated separately, the AUTO button indicator for the corresponding zone turns off.

(c) In AUTO mode: The outlet temperature, air volume, outlet mode and circulation mode are adjusted automatically according to the temperature setting and environmenta conditions.

(1) In summer, when the low temperature setting is selected or in winter, when the high temperature setting is selected, the system will automatically switch to the internal circulation mode.
(2) When the switch is pressed, the blower may not turn immediately or may be in low gear operation until the heated or cooled air is ready for normal air delivery operation.

3. Switching the air outlet mode

### system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3f7c70f3` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The air outlet mode can be selected according to the indication of the wind direction, and the air outlet mode can be cancelled by tapping again. The air outlet modes can be selected in combination, but they cannot all be turned off.

4. Internal/double flow/external circulation mode switching

(a) Tap the internal/double-layer flow/external circulation button to switch among the circulation modes.
(b) When the automatic A/C mode is switched to, the A/C system automatically switches the circulation modes.

### 5. Forced defrosting/defogging of front windshield
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_01a15724` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Tap the front windshield forced defrost/defog button, the indicator turns on and the forced defrost/defog function of front windshield is activated.

### 6. Auto defog sensor (ADS)
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d7b6305e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the current windshield is fogged and has a tendency to affect driving safety, the A/C system will activate the ADS, and the air volume will be appropriately increased and blown to the front windshield. When the tendency is released, the A/C system will automatically switch back to the operating state before defogging. After entering the automatic defogging mode, you can exit this mode by operating the automatic A/C start button or the air outlet mode adjustment button. Then the A/C system will not restart this mode for a certain period of time.

### 7. Natural ventilation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ebb658aa` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Touch the natural ventilation button to enter the natural ventilation mode. Then the air intake mode will be switched to external circulation, and the air outlet mode is switched to face + foot blowing. At this time, the compressor stops operating, thus saving energy.

### system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_f4efee60` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

cooling/heating; However, if the battery cooling/heating function is also activated during charging, the performance of the A/C system may be limited.

### 9. Deicing function
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_49f0809c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the vehicle is charging, check whether there is icing through the deicing test cycle. If there is icing, the deicing mode is entered automatically, and then exit automatically when ended. During deicing, it is impossible to provide heating to the cab temporarily.

### 10. Battery cooling/heating function
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_edfdc4ad` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) If the battery needs to be cooled/heated, the vehicle will cool/heat the battery automatically. After the cooling/heating function is activated, the comfort of the A/C system may be poor.

### 12. Circulation mode
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ae9a591e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Switch to inner circulation mode when driving on dusty roads (e.g. tunnels) or on roads with traffic congestion. This effectively prevents outside air from entering the vehicle. During cooling operation, setting the inner circulation mode will also effectively reduce the interior temperature.
(b) If the inner circulation mode is used for a long time, the windows may fog up.

### 13. Windshield defroster
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5c53eedc` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the defrosting/defogging function is activated, the air volume may be increased, and increasing the air volume can defrost/defog the front windshield as soon as possible.

### 14. Air conditioning odor
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e93acd96` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) During use, various odors from inside and outside the vehicle may enter and accumulate in the A/C system. This may cause odors to emanate from the air outlets.

### On-vehicle inspection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2a43dd24` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Use the manifold pressure gauge assembly to check the refrigerant pressure.

Tip: The examples given below show the readings of the manifold pressure gauge assembly and the corresponding A/C system faults.

(a) Read the pressure of the manifold pressure gauge when the following conditions are met:

Park the vehicle at a cool place.
The doors are fully open.
The A/C switch is turned on.
Switch the A/C to internal circulation.
The temperature is set to the coldest.
The blower speed is set to high.
The air inlet temperature is 25°C to 35°C.
(Normally wet)

![](images/236c527c9513f1976eab0095d3a861d0fd48bc06683b5583e3c2722bf45aead4.webp)

(b) The A/C system works normally.

(1) Pressure gauge reading (c) The A/C system works abnormally.

![](images/94c1f73706017d5e0338942e712e9b11e8d4be813443f5351beb964166a36490.webp)

![](images/50367e09c4820dad63a5ed34c8429c8624079632885117b57b8a2f207b5fd938.webp)

(1) During operation, the pressure on the low pressure side changes between normal and vacuum.

![](images/078efe228285b939a59b73c1ee493ec879d08347abdcbfcdb59e096305f0452f.webp)

![](images/7fe50e809d3a8ff4e9ce166b0d8c8308b122a850a276b4320794db36551c9078.webp)

Tip:
In the above examples, there is moisture in the A/C system.

![](images/77618a2d42374625ec54049c791234b0a17ae8842f24870e11a0427916a57839.webp)

(2) There is too low pressure on the low pressure side and high pressure side.

![](images/5452528a0b871c2a22c57d24dc712dc2d2da7ebca42bd6be321f32a6009e496c.webp)

Tip:
In the above examples, there is insufficient refrigerant.

![](images/301035fce60c1b8bb781f1d666f787ba2199f45115748b155e86d7fd10817399.webp)

(3) Vacuum is indicated at the low pressure side, and very low pressure is indicated at the high pressure side.

![](images/f397d9ff6db38203604b9e3eec58ab6dafc21b91dcc745c056a8dc1a278bce99.webp)

![](images/e7805af5caf13911ed24fe499605237c75e5c5c6de7ad50ba03b5f2d7ab142a6.webp)

Tip:
The refrigerant does not circulate in the above examples.

![](images/4bfd7626eff26f10b520d4ae279f91f955b918c15375e0535028380cf4111747.webp)

(4) There is too high pressure on the low pressure side and high pressure side.

![](images/ee4e4c1ab5317ef59e40440ad15276d2a20a97c1ab427109d4b63297a395b52c.webp)

Tip:
In the above examples, the A/C system is overfilled or the cooling effect of the condenser is poor.

![](images/118292450a7e445d4ca976cd00be57ed5fc3328efb6d5f4aa955927ee7fcaed5.webp)

(5) There is too high pressure on the low pressure side and high pressure side.

![](images/e061394e89d00c91aa3feb1c650bce0b8f8e00b52765c3be44d6af732523f6a9.webp)

![](images/eb3134aa31d422cbb2ae52cb06ace92ac19d34932701226af6fb8a7e330c779f.webp)

Tip:
These indications will appear on the instrument if the A/C is turned on and refilled without draining the system. Attention:
In the above examples, there is air in the A/C system.

![](images/16688abb2afb38b59a02fe73f44458b0bc3d1b96f6d29e4e516e45fcb11b9f07.webp)

(6) There is too high pressure on the low pressure side and high pressure side.

### On-vehicle inspection
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c1b72bb9` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/4d7cbb492f1de0b0efc02badc2e9f9c636546f249c8315a2ff6365318ecc658c.webp)

Tip:
In the above examples, the expansion valve is faulty.

![](images/b4665b7f950070e71a57b290cb8479d3cc0361c762fa64e18cd18993fe5f1dfd.webp)

(7) There is too high pressure on the low pressure side and high pressure side, or there is too low pressure on the high pressure side.

![](images/e2d586c3bfee59a5109f83cd6bf1071ea3fc538b85fd086217359502062c3fb9.webp)

Tip: In the above examples, the compressor has insufficient compression capacity.

### A/C filter element Replacement
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6d8b709b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Remove the A/C filter element (a) Open the glove box

![](images/f6b10a1cc57d6e80bdaabf445b1b9322eff280d228762fe04f342d5b4b58cc40.webp)

![](images/be9e78214772afb59d3c9346747a2a476025f82d72f79a0a171d758dca1cbde7.webp)

(b) Disengage 3 claws and remove the A/C filter element service port cover.

![](images/4fe6269657514b8bb8b960a3eb4733fd35eab45db6ef64755a9417edbc8a8bdd.webp)

(c) Disengage 2 claws and pull out the A/C filter element and bracket assembly.

![](images/e63ac20f1ebc306bac967deba2606b048b0707ab91d9ba773f7f0e9506fe8dcc.webp)

(d) Press the A/C filter element inward and remove it as shown in the figure.

2. Install the A/C filter element

![](images/0b07bf9e6c1865f222e63340674fe79aa8a31301542acd483eb09e8aa5882fcc.webp)

(a) Press the A/C filter element inward and install it as shown in the figure.

![](images/15498b883360b194e9f28c6733d74acffddd721acaf7f7d97d5677c381ba86b3.webp)

(b) Insert the A/C filter element and bracket assembly and fix 2 claws.

![](images/28cf6988cd82466adfb6dcaae850ab5577b802033532b25525f65ba8d65cdd16.webp)

(c) Fix 3 claws and install the A/C filter element service port cover.

![](images/d4a61c74db44a28f53fcdf5531a578990254cfc13d94705bddd64067c445558d.webp)

(d) Close the glove box.

assembly

assembly

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_ea0a98d1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8130bd14` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Before bonding, the corresponding glass surface shall be free of dirt and dust. The bonding ambient temperature shall be 20°C 40°C and the humidity shall be less than 65% RH.
Tear off the adhesive film before bonding, press it evenly with a pressure of 100KPA for 5s-10s, and do not apply force to it within at least 1 hour after installation. After the anti-fog sensor is bonded to the glass, apply a 50N pull-out force perpendicular to the anti-fog sensor, and the anti-fog sensor shall not fall off.

![](images/f593953ed6de58aae638332b96d176936150ae6712280313f498a6be47f6d286.webp)

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_25055cc3` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/2031f65c7beec771d0fe907fd1445381b289d38c6dd041bcc0b74cdcd375e46a.webp)

(a) Remove 2 fixing screws of the air outlet assembly of the console.

![](images/9d68f3fe78f172aac4b80cd711b84bad327d5a6db89f9db0495befc7a9220043.webp)

(b) Disengage 5 claws, and remove the rear end plate and air outlet from the console. Tip: Do not completely take out the console air outlet assembly.

![](images/cb62e3a8fb275144c012607d3488892622e125559500cb986dd9ea28f2119762.webp)

(c) Disconnect the harness connector from the console air outlet assembly, and remove the console air outlet assembly.

![](images/23f251265ff779b4d11ea0288631b151d1282f060beb735ce25bf3bbb23df595.webp)

10. Disassemble the air outlet assembly on the left side of B-pillar. Tip: The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. (a) Disengage 1 spring caliper, and remove the air outlet assembly on the left side of Bpillar. Tip: Do not completely take out the air outlet assembly on the left side of B-pillar.

![](images/61957385286438ab0210ec3330f8c49127f09c9dbe4b0e8fa53975b904826fa1.webp)

(b) Disconnect the harness connector from the air outlet assembly on the left side of B-pillar, and remove the air outlet assembly on the left side of B-pillar.

11. Disassemble the air outlet assembly on the left side of C-pillar (only applicable to the model with third-row RAC) Tip: The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. (a) Disengage 1 spring caliper, and remove the air outlet assembly on the left side of C-pillar.

![](images/8b866afb225e0c5da021be6fc14f7d8830155ba40a0cc0fb999462c5a2e183b9.webp)

12. Remove the rear foot blowing grille Tip: The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. (a) Remove the rear foot blowing grille plug cap.

![](images/2c45f69d4440b9d75c279889e14e241cc70a910fbcc8d3425534664e8a006dae.webp)

![](images/affe704e8189ff0eb37abd3b0b365dcfc28ca6c0c8820b2e4ee461e2fc34d649.webp)

(b) Remove 2 screws and detach the rear foot blowing grille.

13. Remove the rear bumper assembly （ ET-1）

14. Disassemble the exhaust port assembly. Tip: The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

![](images/a0128a61f3b089f97377f39485f07129967996a8ced78ca830a5585bb3b80d7e.webp)

(a) Disengage 2 claws, and remove the air outlet assembly.

1. Install the A-pillar left defrosting nozzle.

Tip:

The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

![](images/1c94ef3698e30434e6bc3c0479e325df45d4dff1949433adb0edbbcd8e9aa128.webp)

(a) Fix 1 clip, and install the A-pillar left defrosting nozzle

2. Install the A-pillar upper left guard plate assembly. （ IR-28） 3. Install the IP left trim panel IP-1） 4. Install the IP left air outlet assembly.

![](images/4ab3a0d1b9d4178dbc0fa426d2b8887658a5a49368f7519cd561133cca27fe0e.webp)

5. Install the air outlet assembly on the right side of the instrument panel.

![](images/2bbadb5083853b72f0755348845d5b4c81f26281eab95d0baa9eab05bf58036d.webp)

![](images/59e95bfe95b0d7258d5983d4177c51fe9d2a2f17210a341d4c7101ae7ccaa37a.webp)

![](images/ad4042a621904eb7c0902972ec2096fa058700c1272eda5eef910c3c63ed7293.webp)

(b) Install the central air outlet assembly of the instrument panel with 10 spring calipers.

7. Install the air conditioning screen assembly. （ AC-157）

9. Install the rear cover plate of the console. （IP-19）

10. Install the air outlet assembly on the left side of B-pillar. Tip: The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. (a) Connect the harness connector of the air outlet assembly on the left side of B-pillar.

![](images/50130858fae0be61bcc0ac4c1411eaccf62dad542acd4951e37222a0ba304b8b.webp)

11. Install the air outlet assembly on the left side of C-pillar (only applicable to the model with third-row RAC) Tip: The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

![](images/690233b119bc8ebb6fb94000a3317373359b621171d4897d68f5ab974089b9a3.webp)

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_bdcc238a` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Recover refrigerant in the refrigeration system （ AC-139）
3. Empty the coolant （ CO-3）
4. Remove the A/C controller assembly （AC-170）
5. Remove the IP body assembly （ IP-1）
6. Remove the front HVAC assembly

![](images/5bae456ab6b121c4a1d4bf8b1c4bf5e8f51b445c5c5cca9ae7226649f66af1f6.webp)

(a) Disengage 2 stee band elastic hose clamps to disconnect the front HVAC assembly water pipe.

![](images/e8ffb2a15773085665d7ae151676d1bd54effb55f2d629378306d86c92dce39f.webp)

(b) Remove one bolt and disconnect the LP rubber hose line assembly from the evaporator to the liquid-gas separator.

![](images/d45507eb401548e5eb1063b2f077a622acb2d2e80e9ba1716b2c3cd47d83c2af.webp)

(c) Disconnect the blower harness connector.

(d) Disconnect the harness connector of the front HVAC assembly.

![](images/78ebf637e99aecfae0bcebb6c4566f6f7cd2260188f4e4e0432552cf2351c520.webp)

(e) Disengage the front HVAC drain pipe assembly fixing clamp on the lower part of body.

![](images/d21762291b231b20fe6c2b7880267cbec4c2d23e377f28807e90fd6c3d51b6c7.webp)

(f) Remove 3 nuts to detach the front HVAC drain pipe and bracket.

![](images/86bcac9c518c50cba5211d8ebdae3294020485f65a7a7c6be458d2d02e535de4.webp)

(g) Remove the air pipe from the internal temperature sensor assembly.

![](images/d0017cf3e2bbf83b544effd04c84c1421986cf84d5362463fe5bd231db4b1983.webp)

(h) Remove 2 fixing bolts in the middle of the front HVAC assembly.

![](images/77cdbb1ef6eeb74364de5e39fa21b4f41896c3652801c3259586d7ac7ae184d1.webp)

(i) Remove 2 fixing screws from the lower part of the front HVAC assembly.

![](images/9a17ec8a44d066bc94ed9cf4ae86cffdddafbe1b1cc8de991eedd071097fc8c8.webp)

( j) Remove one bolt on the upper right side of the front HVAC assembly.

(k) Remove the IP and cross beam assembly IP-1）
(l) Remove one nut and detach the front HVAC assembly.

![](images/6cd7f891837eeba8dbca60f37e8394d25a3eeb0a9b157b6a1bdcf7368a25f3d4.webp)

### 7. Remove the air inlet assembly

![](images/6092efde88add6abe3eb6e58961117e2d1c440ced5bfb274abb40cc241bbf2f4.webp)

### 1. Install the air inlet assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9e377ad7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/bf69d495f2b0e31687aff593a556c7de572386747726948c7e3f2fc1bb90f145.webp)

(a) Install the air inlet assembly with 3 nuts. Torque: 4-6N·m

2. Install the front HVAC assembly

![](images/9a86798642523a73fa27e2c4dbc65740bfa4e1e41954fcd384bd99ec404141f6.webp)

(a) Install the IP and cross beam assembly （ IP-6）
(b) Install 2 fixing bolts in the middle of the front HVAC assembly. Tip: Install the bolts on the left side before on the right side.

Torque: 7.8-11.8 N·m

![](images/b0c7cee70128df11e7ff9d7c7b03c61dcb60c9a705c532d9ad22211bc04b1926.webp)

(c) Install one bolt on the upper right side of the front HVAC assembly. Torque: 7.8-11.8 N·m

![](images/2a619f389818a87cf0e7bd3f68495207c3dccf87107f40c47e37d4bd215e8383.webp)

(d) Install 2 fixing screws at the lower part of the front HVAC assembly.

![](images/87dfff2e64888d81a18f02f4a085d8e79e2819c50f1b51c75a6e1f6107c53a87.webp)

(e) Install the front HVAC assembly with one nut. Torque: 8-12N·m

(f) Install the air pipe to the internal temperature sensor assembly

![](images/c5657a0c56f10a57b0391a577a0b93eb05ba8359db087adb403a4d33ee978114.webp)

(g) Install the front HVAC drain pipe and bracket with 3 nuts.

Torque: 8-12N·m

![](images/8b2cd58564bf7dbf8d0564cca70186a3a621cb454e37f031bde33b958b02557a.webp)

(h) Fasten the front HVAC drain pipe assembly fixing clamp on the lower part of body.

![](images/27385204fe36069dc6cbe6f7e33399d8b2423df77593bed398cccc464c0774a6.webp)

(i) Connect the harness connector of front HVAC assembly.

![](images/ab6e54e930b97ca65ee978cd9d3ec40f806fe61b7328ac329c13370d7fefaee3.webp)

( j) Connect the blower harness connector.

![](images/85b11469f094b3b15f3e13da4ca269a5c4a5f333e82a771d9628525844f98704.webp)

(k) Install the low-pressure hose line assembly between the evaporator and liquid-gas separator with one bolt.

Torque: 4-6N·m

![](images/aa330250e77d8bfe9a7ff1206c8cd4f68b473f49ea794d2f2047a68790ee8cc5.webp)

(l) Install the front HVAC assembly water pipe with 2 steel band elastic hose clamps.

3. Install the IP body assembly IP-6）
4. Install the A/C controller assembly （AC-168）
5. Fill in the coolant（ CO-3）
6. Refill refrigerant in refrigeration
system （AC-139）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6a1a7a7b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn the ignition switch to the OFF (STOP) position when the vehicle is stationary.
2. Disengage the MSD （ CH-44） Danger: Disengage the MSD and wait for the complete discharge of the high-voltage components. Wait for another 5 minutes before the subsequent operation. Wear insulating gloves.

3. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） Danger: Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery after waiting for 5s.

4. Recover refrigerant in the refrigeration system （ AC-4）

5. Remove the electric compressor assembly (a) Disconnect the LV harness connector and HV harness connector of the electric compressor assembly.

![](images/8341c4a8c60b0434dd933d0eb250e9744ffd074b80f9a1af0c60623df3e0120d.webp)

![](images/49520028e345d25abc0bbc7dc49779b3829f4ccd9a4d38e07595b92c598d1480.webp)

(b) Remove 2 bolts, and disconnect the connecting pipeline of the compressor assembly.

![](images/201650d8a7dff9b232f52f148602e3f66615fa67ac28cd57b2f7af43dd385560.webp)

(c) Remove 4 bolts and detach the compressor assembly.

6. Remove the acoustic cover of electric compressor

![](images/5d9c0985919a43f29a6779563418e1c8a2335fa7e8007fc3371c9bd21756b72a.webp)

(a) Remove 6 claws and remove the acoustic cover of electric compressor.

### 1. Confirm whether the body is poorly insulated
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7bfab86b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Measure the resistance between the HV positive and negative terminals of the compressor and the compressor housing. Tip: Measure with the maximum resistance gear of the multimeter. If it is greater than 10m Ω, the compressor is well insulated. If it is less than 10m Ω, confirm whether refrigeration oil or other refrigerant other than ND11 is used. If it is used, clean the pipeline and replace the compressor. If other types of refrigeration oil or refrigerant were not used, replace the compressor directly.

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

### 2. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_f9c85e7a` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/2b9c94e2682feff2c85ffbfd61b8a20872e315ae6153d957bd377742a9cfdd63.webp)

3. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

### 4. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b7b7b485` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check on the A/C panel control unit system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When it is necessary to replace parts or disconnect the connector during the maintenance of the A/C panel control unit system, the battery negative cable should be disconnected.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door control system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_65b863c7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Select the air outlet according to the temperature setting, and adjust the air volume automatically.

2. In the AUTO A/C mode, you can set the temperature by tapping the temperature setting button according to your personal needs, and the set temperature is shown on the temperature display.
3. Swipe down at the top of the display screen of the front air conditioner to pull out the setting menu, and the environment mode, button sound and screen brightness can be set.
4 The rear air-conditioning control system can synchronously or individually adjust the temperature and air outlet mode of the rear area according to the needs of the occupants, so as to improve riding comfort.
5. In the AUTO A/C mode, you can set the temperature by tapping the temperature setting button according to your personal needs, and the set temperature is shown on the temperature display.

### Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_607370f2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Manual setting (a) Adjust the air volume: adjust the air volume of the air conditioning system from Level 1 to

5 through the air volume setting button on the operation panel.
(b) Adjust the temperature: set the temperature through the temperature setting button on the operation panel (the temperature of left and right occupants of the third row can be adjusted separately).
(c) Turn off the air conditioner: touch the [OFF] button on the operation panel to turn off the air conditioning system.
(d) Switch the outlet mode: touch the outlet mode button to switch the outlet mode.

### 1. Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_22d1c4e3` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The full-automatic parking includes automatic parking in automatic parking out.

(b) The full-automatic parking can identify side, vertical, and diagonal parking, perform automatic backward parking, and support the automatic parking out of horizontal and vertical parking spaces.

### 2. Working principle
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0691be1e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the vehicle is in the automatic parking state, the intelligent driving integrated control unit will send an enable signal to the PA system control unit through the CAN bus, and the system will start to work until the automatic parking process ends.
(b) When the vehicle is in the automatic parking state, the PA system control unit needs to collect real-time information from sensors, calculate the position and size of the vehicle, real-time distance information of obstacles, etc., and output them to the intelligent driving integrated control unit through the CAN bus, which then performs trajectory planning and calculation according to the information, and performs horizontal and vertical control of the entire vehicle until the end of the parking process.

### 3. Automatic parking sensor system prompt
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_88bc03d7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The PA system control unit sends obstacle distance information and graded alarms to the EnHost, which then provides video and sound prompts.
(b) During the working process of the system, the PA system control unit continuously monitors the normal functions of the sensors and peripheral circuits. If a fault is found, it will be classified into the memory and sent to the EnHost via the bus, which will then give an alarm prompt.

4. Parking control: During the parking process, the number of parking steps, the current vehicle operating state and the surrounding image of the vehicle are displayed on the EnHost, and the vehicle can be started and stopped in three ways.

(a) Control through the shift lever unlock button.

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b28ef309` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1 Power off or cool down the intelligent driving control unit

(d) Re-read the DTC.

Replace the intelligent driving control unit（ AD-30）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b330d700` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the left end cover assembly （IP-1）
3. Remove the lower left bottom guard assembly （ IP-1） Remove the lower left guard assembly （IP-1）
5. Remove the advanced autopilot controller

![](images/93a7bd3137d89f9f80880149caff4c1ee1d91e23a817c76cf9feaf6cf661c37c.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of advanced autopilot controller.

(b) Remove 4 nuts to detach the advanced autopilot controller.

(c) Remove 4 nuts and detach the advanced autopilot controller bracket.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d5f698a0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/698de710be452649983be6aac4f1e1c1ee355cb12d371fa98d8e46e9495af98e.webp)

1. Install the advanced autopilot controller (a) Install the advanced autopilot controller bracket with 4 nuts. Torque: 3.5-5.7N·m

![](images/150463f93f2e2b3952376ef5f66ee9d44b09c859bff4cd7b0eca67a7c7a3c931.webp)

(b) Install the advanced autopilot controller with 4 nuts.

Torque: 3.5-5.7N·m

(c) Connect the harness connector of advanced autopilot controller.

2. Install the lower left guard plate assembly （IP-6）
3. Install the lower left bottom guard assembly （ IP-6）
4. Install the left end cover assembly IP-6）
5. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

### 2. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9e80b37e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/35a0a67e3ee6dee4b13af905e2a84b209a83548cdfdd79a6bdb12c463ee3b915.webp)

3. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

### 4 General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2d14cdbd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check on the intelligent camera system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) Weather conditions may affect the monitoring of the intelligent camera system, so drive with caution.
(c) The driver is the main manipulator of the car, and his control of the car takes priority over that of the intelligent camera control system. The driver should take over the vehicle according to the actual situation to ensure the safety of the vehicle.

5. After the intelligent camera is replaced, it needs to be calibrated with a scan tool.

### 1. Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_08e87e2b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The system includes active cruise function (ACC), front collision warning (FCW), advanced emergency braking function (AEB) for

pedestrians/suburbs/cities, lane departure warning function (LDW), road traffic sign recognition (TSR), driver status monitoring (DSM), intelligent headlight control (IHC), and super autonomous cruise control (SACC).

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

2. Removal and installation of battery terminal

(a) Before electrical operation, disconnect the battery negative (-) terminal to prevent the system from short-circuiting.
(b) Before disconnecting or reconnecting battery cable, turn off the ignition switch and lighting switch, and completely loosen the terminal nut.

### 1. MMW radar system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5f60c5c7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Detect the speed, distance and position of vehicles or moving objects, and transmit the information to the smart front camera through the CAN network. The IFC performs data fusion of two types of sensors to achieve the driving assistance function, and controls the power motor control system, ESP control unit and other controllers, so as to improve the driving safety of the vehicle.
