### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_05cc0ee1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the front bumper assembly （ET-1）
3. Remove the forward MMW radar assembly

![](images/3f65265d96f9005c5d6ca1764711a87795aef3b9652d55eb10e2e5ba901c3cd0.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of forward MMW radar assembly.

![](images/34c122affe0cc626a1d85e41cd6ef6f8832100689009c28997dd02e71ebab6c4.webp)

(b) Disengage the forward MMW radar assembly harness retaining clips.

![](images/2eff6062049a4d28ceae55c19546355619484549fb7065cdbb77b8b1c44e79b4.webp)

(c) Disengage 5 jaws and remove the forward MMW radar assembly.

4 Remove the forward MMW radar assembly bracket

![](images/9b55360600027c151972f7d5f3f772bbc39020a33f3b416a9a1901ba47e51425.webp)

(a) Remove 4 screws and remove the forward MMW radar assembly bracket.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3dfcbad2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the forward MMW radar assembly bracket

![](images/211ea35272a2a9a994833c0b5af61692806ebea7778b3a3cf9908a06626f5cb4.webp)

(a) Install the forward MMW radar assembly bracket with 4 screws.

2. Install the forward MMW radar assembly

![](images/cd3437bd29653aae5dd02cc591e04ca6b0c8e6cf7babd815a9d5694a6a498fd4.webp)

(a) Clamp 5 claws and install the forward MMW radar assembly.

![](images/65896e5470e16dda58fcc21ef73e013cd57a5bc0ca84f9e88745e4600ee50683.webp)

(b) Install the forward MMW radar assembly harness retaining clips.

![](images/313a0463d8eeedf4fc8c9c2f8361da6453f4e8543bb588b9eab74f373bfed08f.webp)

(c) Connect the harness connector of forward MMW radar assembly.

3. Install the front bumper assembly （ ET-4）4. Connect the negative terminal of thebattery （ CH-54）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_46608d4b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the rear bumper assembly （ ET-13）
3. Remove the left rear corner MMW radar assembly

![](images/f5ecc6ad9ec49955dd191fbe5470851bf35ed9e4b5e08bff9d5190a17134893d.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of left rear corner MMW radar assembly.

![](images/f0c54f2541307867d44f3e43567873cb071b7e9f8be0082ef7b4db27cd9ac0a3.webp)

(b) Disengage 5 claws to detach the left rear corner MMW radar assembly.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_812a9a0b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Install the left rear corner MMW radar assembly

![](images/f7194da946fb9ca078f4252f99e09c328ca9526fdc7dba45dba7a4bb0faa3ccd.webp)

(a) Secure 5 claws to install the left rear corner MMW radar assembly.

![](images/f25aa1459256989e88be31ed474542070204a7018b021b410edc49da5f06b2ff.webp)

(b) Connect the harness connector of left rear corner MMW radar assembly.

2. Install the rear bumper assembly （ ET-16） 3. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_cc77d8f0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance.

Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

### 2. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0cb0587b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/e4fff4ccb8df4865f0c9de8e7ded80d82c2ac53bfd71878a64ef5fea97a0ddca.webp)

3. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

4. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### 5. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a951f970` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When it is necessary to replace parts or disconnect the connector during the maintenance of the PA system, the battery negative cable should be disconnected.
(b) After reconnecting the battery, it is necessary to use the scan tool to perform "clear DTC" operation to all electronic control systems.

### 6. Precautions for parking assist system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_12a663b7` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Due to the influence from various external sound and electromagnetic fields determined by physical characteristics (e.g. other vehicles using ultrasonic ranging, air pressure, engine noise, electric gears, induction loops, etc.), the

system cannot achieve absolute immunity to interference.
(b) If the camera becomes dirty, it will not transmit a clear image. Rinse it with water and wipe with a soft cloth. If the camera is very dirty, clean it with a neutral cleaner and wipe it off.
(c) When the system temperature is low, the displayed image may be darkened and the moving image may be slightly distorted.

### 1. General Description of AVP
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5c718385` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) APA measures the length of the parking spaces on both sides of the road through ultrasonic waves and cameras. If the appropriate parking space is selected, the system will automatically control the vehicle to perform auto parking in the selected parking space. APA includes auto parking-in and auto parking-out. They can be selected through the multimedia display.

### 2. Access APA system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e17e650f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Press the APA button to enter the Auto Park selection interface.
(b) In the parking selection interface, you can select the parking mode as parking in or parking out.

### 3. Auto parking-in
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d8a81900` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Select the parking space type: You can search parking spaces in automatic mode and manual mode. And in each mode, there are three types of parking spaces available: vertical parking, inclined parking, and horizontal parking (when the vehicle speed is not zero, the system defaults to Auto mode. Only when the vehicle speed is zero, you can select Manual mode).

(b) Select a parking space:

(1) Method 1: Auto mode When the automatic mode is selected, it defaults to full parking space, and all parking space types can be searched. If the user has selected a type, the search success rate of single parking space type can be improved. The system will recognize the parking spaces of the same type as that selected by the user on both sides of the driving direction while driving. The system defaults the preferred parking space as the target parking space; and you can also touch other optional parking spaces on the display as the target parking space.

### (2) Method 1: Manua mode
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_34e60546` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

After selecting the manual mode and parking space type, the corresponding target parking space frame will appear on the screen, and the user can drag and rotate the target parking space frame. When the vehicle in the parking space frame is shown in red, it means that the vehicle cannot be parked in the area, the position and posture of the target parking space frame on the display needs to be adjusted.

(3) Parking control

In the process of parking, the number of parking steps, the current vehicle running state and the surrounding images of the vehicle are displayed on the display screen, and the vehicle can be controlled by three methods.

1. Method 1: Use the Start Parking-in button of the audio system to determine the target parking space, depress the brake pedal, touch the Start Parking-in button and release the brake pedal to start parking-in.

2. Method 2: Use the remote key search button to determine the target parking space, stabilize the vehicle, and continue to press the remote key search button until the vehicle is parked.

3. Method 3: Use the mobile APP to determine the target parking space, stabilize the vehicle, and continue to press the mobile APP parking button until the vehicle is parked in.

In the process of parking, touch the parking Pause button or release the key and the button on the APP to stop the parking process. Press the parking button again to continue parking. The three parking control methods can be used interactively.

### 4. Auto parking-out
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_d9438970` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Selecting the parking-out type

(1) Method 1: Audio system display screen selection. Four parking-out modes can be selected through the audio system display screen: vertical backward, vertical forward, parallel left and parallel right.
(2) Method 2: Mobile phone APP selection. After starting the vehicle remotely, you can select four parking-out modes: vertical

forward, vertical backward, horizontal left and horizontal right.

### (b) Parking-out control
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7e442677` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

After selecting the parking-out type, depress the brake pedal, touch the Start Parking-out button and release the brake pedal to start departure.

(1) Method 1: Use the Start Parking-out button of the audio system to select the parking-out type, depress the brake pedal, touch the Start Parking-out button and release the brake pedal to start parking-out.
(2) Method 2: Use the remote key parking button to remotely start the vehicle, and continue to press the remote key parking button until the vehicle is parked out.
(3) Method 3: Use the mobile APP (vertical forward, vertical backward, horizontal left and horizontal right) to continue to press the mobile APP parking-out button until the vehicle is parked out.
(4) Method 4: Use the mobile APP (remote parking-out). During parking-out, turn the Steering Wheel and touch the Drive and Reverse buttons to control the vehicle.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b84a0413` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The driver is the main operator of the vehicle. Automatic parking assist (APA) is only a driver assistance system. Although the system can help the driver during parking, the parking system can not replace the driver to park, the driver must assume the responsibility of parking. In the process of parking the driver needs to pay attention to the environment around the vehicle and take over the vehicle when necessary to avoid danger.

### 1. Site size requirements
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_7a28711f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/575c2601e261ebcc0af99ca57590f74f4df74bb853b0215de628d8a6853b4f35.webp)

(a) The minimum area required for the site is 5.5m X 9.3m, and 4 black and white calibration blocks (A, B, C, D) resembling Chessboard are the areas where vehicles are placed.

### 2. Preparation for calibration operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_38149023` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Confirm that there is no protective film or attachments (water drops, mud, etc.) on the camera surface.
(b) Fold the exterior rearview mirror, and ensure that it is not in the abnorma calibration position.
(c) Check whether the air suspension level is in Normal mode.
(d) Check whether there are strong light sources that interfere with the camera at the surrounding.
(e) Confirm that the trunk is not open.
(f) Confirm that the four doors are not open.

3. Requirement for ground flatness and calibration cloth laying

(a) In order to ensure the calibration effect, select the flat ground as the calibration site to the extent that no obvious dent and protrusion will occur on the calibration cloth after laying;

(b) When laying the calibration cloth, pay attention to fully opening and flat placement, and align each piece according to requirements.
(c) The recommended error range for the ground flatness of the calibration space is within 3-5 mm.

4. Illumination conditions (a) Mode Illumination (sunlight, etc.) is without a reflected light source around the ground.

### 5. Storage of calibration cloth
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_95a852b9` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The calibration cloth shall be leveled and rolled up after use and stored properly. Attention: If the calibration cloth is soaked with water, please dry it and roll it up for storage, so as to avoid wrinkles affecting subsequent use during rolling.

### 1. Parking sensor control system
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9f525acc` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Parking Distance Control (PDC) System consists of controller and ultrasonic sensor. The ultrasonic sensor can measure the distance between the vehicle and the obstacle. According to the distance change of the

obstacle in the detection area, the audio speaker will sound with different frequencies, while the audio multi-function display will show the distance and orientation information of the obstacle. When using the system, be sure to be aware of the surrounding area.

### 2. Turn on/off parking sensor system:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_59751460` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the vehicle speed is less than 15 km/h, press the PDC/RVC ON/OFF button, and it will light up, which indicates that the PDC is turned on; press the PDC/RVC ON/OFF button again, and it will go out, which indicates that the PDC is turned off.

### 3. Radar settings
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e3eae9f3` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

You can set the radar alarm volume and the front radar auto-on function in the AVM interface of the audio system.

(a) When the automatic radar is set to ON:

(1) With the gear shifted in D/N and the vehicle speed less than 15km/h, if there is an obstacle within 80 cm, the audio display will pop up a radar warning screen. Press the return button to exit the radar warning. At this time, the radar auto-on is turned off during this ignition cycle. Note: The radar will not give an alarm when the gear position is N and the vehicle is stationary.
(2) With the gear shifted to R and the PDC ON, the PDC can be turned off by pressing the PDC/RVC ON/OFF button.
(3) The PDC, if turned on, will stop working when the vehicle speed is more than 15km/h, and will resume working when the vehicle speed is less than 10 km/h.

(b) When the automatic radar is set to OFF:

(1) With the gear shifted to R and the PDC ON, the PDC can be turned off by pressing the PDC/RVC ON/OFF button.
(2) When the gear is in R after the system is turned on, the system will stop working when the vehicle speed is higher than 15km/h, and when the vehicle speed is lower than 10km/h, the PSS will work again. When the gear is in D, the system

will stop working when the vehicle speed is higher than 15km/h and will not resume automatically.

### 4 System performance limitations
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3619a9f3` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Certain vehicle conditions and surroundings may affect the sensor's ability to correctly detect obstacles:

(1) Dirt, snow or ice on the sensor. (2) The sensor is covered. (3) The vehicle is significantly tilted sideways. (4) On particularly bumpy roads, slopes, gravel surfaces or grass. (5) The vicinity of the vehicle is very noisy due to the sound of vehicle horns, motorcycle engines, air brakes of large vehicles or other strong noises that produce ultrasonic waves. (6) There is another vehicle equipped with parking assist sensors nearby and the sensors in that vehicle are working. (7) The vehicle is equipped with a wing antenna mast or wireless antenna. (8) The vehicle is fitted with a traction ring. (9) The bumper or sensor has been subjected to a strong impact. (10) The vehicle is approaching a high or curvy curb. (11) In hot sun or severe cold weather. In addition to the above, traffic signs and other objects may sometimes be judged by sensors to be closer than they actually are due to their shape. (b) The shape of the obstacle may prevent the sensor from detecting it. Pay particular attention to the following obstacles: (1) Electric wires, fences, ropes, etc. (2) Cotton, snow and other materials that absorb radio waves. (3) Objects with sharp edges. (4) Low obstacles.

(5) High obstacles with the upper part reaching outward in the direction of your vehicle.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_951a6684` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Warning for using front and rear parking sensor To avoid an accident, please observe the following precautions:

1. Do not attach any objects within the working range of the sensor.
2. PSS is only a driver assistance system, so do not over-rely on it and the driver must drive carefully. If necessary, actively intervene in the vehicle to avoid danger.
3. The driver is the primary controller of the vehicle and must maintain control of the vehicle at all times and has full responsibility for the vehicle.
A When the vehicle speed is too fast, the system will stop working, therefore the driver should drive carefully.

### Caution:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_471b1e12` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Precautions when washing your car: Donotrinse with water or steam against the sensor area. Otherwise, it may cause the sensor to malfunction.

### Inspection procedures
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e9c9a00b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/0794a4190900ca27ff4b5f97e61d9889ef8147e9057cef4ce89b9ff4cafc42d8.webp)

(a) Set the ignition switch to "OFF"
(b) Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery.
(c) Disconnect the PDC connector.
(d) Disconnect all the front sensor connectors.
(e) Measure the resistance according to the values the table below.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5ca845b1` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the front bumper （ ET-1）
3. Remove the rear bumper ET-13）
4 Remove the ultrasonic sensor assembly Tip: All ultrasonic sensor assemblies and automatic parking sensor assemblies at the front and rear are removed in the same sequence.

![](images/dc513abc7a3a98fab3fcb14e7c5485f5ea5d4df5d6930ebccda802ebc9fc0a83.webp)

All ultrasonic sensor assemblies and automatic parking sensor assemblies at the front and rear are installed in the same sequence.

![](images/0ff5227aa6348281648b03814b5a2384132edfbf3dec9d28d06158c39814e15e.webp)

![](images/f0df4d26038e6986429fafba191f5e5b1b5488256677cb6438e1dc4ddfc72bef.webp)

(b) Connect the harness connector of ultrasonic sensor assembly.

2. Install the front bumper ET-4） 3. Install the rear bumper ET-16） 4. Connect the negative terminal of the battery CH-54）

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

### 2. Power (ignition) switch notation:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_c7e4e1bc` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/bd30ae818eb03ac15474bf4ad8e1204a07fe9ce82b1fc12660d3cd601326f399.webp)

3. When checking and replacing electronic components, ensure that the negative terminal of the battery is disconnected before system maintenance.

### 4 General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_4bea91d2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Checking the PAS control unit may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during repair of the PAS control unit, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door contro system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 1. Function description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_46d84ccd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) When the driver shifts the gear to D or R, and the vehicle speed is within the range of 0 to 30km/h (km/h), the PAS will send a warning

sound. In D gear, the sound level changes with the change of vehicle speed; in R gear, the warning sound will not change. (b) The pedestrian warning sound can be turned on and off in the vehicle settings of the audio system.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_932808e2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the engine compartment front upper guard （ ET-50）
3. Remove the radiator grille ET-61） Remove the front bumper assembly （ET-1）
5. Disassemble the PAS.

![](images/429f09c3a017a223e3dc3f3deaed09e5594ab5629c7f46e02cf8f3788ad7d2e2.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of the PAS.

(b) Remove 2 bolts, and then remove the PAS.

### 1. Install the PAS.
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a299854c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/d4fe8858ebfd244ef095c544400d2ee2c9bddd2817ca8329b0e79cb06fb2bcb4.webp)

(a) Install the lower PAS, and tighten 2 bolts. Torque: 8–12 N·m

(b) Connect the harness connector of the PAS.

2. Install the front bumper assembly （ ET-4）
3. Install the radiator grille ET-64）

4. Install the engine compartment front upper guard ET-52）
5. Connect the negative terminal of the battery CH-54）

![](images/5e5c303abfacb58246f7c35feb43388445abcd320558fc683194cd02e76a6c7d.webp)

(b) Check the video signal (AVM) connector of the IVI control unit for fracture and aging.
(c) Check the video signal (AVM) harness of the IVI control unit for short or open circuit.

Abnormal

Repair or replace the harnesses and connector

Normal

2 Check the harness and connector of the AVM.

(a) Check whether the connector of the AVM is firmly secured.
(b) Check the connector of the AVM for fracture and aging.
(c) Check the harness of the AVM for short or open circuit.

(b) Check the AVM camera connector for fracture and aging.
(c) Check the AVM camera harness for short or open circuit.
(d) Check whether the front, rear, left and right cameras of the around view monitor (AVM) are working properly.

Repair according to the fault

Normal

![](images/72d7b7c4ca3781e0d0411502e8e089a9dc2a4472361726bdf675311732e5ee7c.webp)

(b) Connect the HQ-VDS scan tool.

(d) Re-read the DTC.

Normal

### A-pillar tweeter assembly Parts
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1013a678` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/ab812d7ff981f8168cee111e9e78596cc544f1567866a5adcaf1dbd159975e9e.webp)

N•m : Specified torque

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_20458d43` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the A-pillar upper guard assembly （ IR-24）
3. Remove A-pillar tweeter assembly Tip: The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

![](images/e6040aa6ef49aa1f2591b1d9892a838d322c00726d65076241653c6fd6d1520e.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of rear door tweeter.

![](images/1612a3de2de6a9a28478a26fa43e2b24e26cdb7a090ba7c3e939c7f7e1a8aafe.webp)

(b) Disengage 3 claws and detach the rear door tweeter.

### 1. Check A-pillar tweeter assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8fa2fb93` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Measure the resistance according to the values in the table below.

Standard resistance:

![](images/abae74f3f51d7fb8276e619e70a17ae1e08a6e249da02cfba7157855faffab6b.webp)

If the result is not acceptable, replace the A-pillar tweeter assembly.

### 1. Install A-pillar tweeter assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1486a205` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:

The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

![](images/b0be1b2f1b94b53276597d17ff01fbda3f21219b3e89fac9e701257c33afbbee.webp)

(a) Fix 3 claws and install the rear door tweeter.

(b) Connect the harness connector of the rear door tweeter.

2. Install the A-pillar upper guard assembly. （IR-28）
3. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_1da28a84` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the front center squawker and tweeter assembly

![](images/0731a66a3e77b65947f184fff6bb2d314a0881ac5f1951f362279651a7d79aa9.webp)

![](images/4e0d52a4afcf63f85b3c0982dfb314e116d11c1db71b667bbfa822808b6b19ef.webp)

![](images/a7ff36aea6d5fbedd10b6e6354ca886fb44bc1831cf05d5548a7314a224dd404.webp)

(a) Disengage 8 claws and detach the center speaker cover.

(b) Disconnect the harness connector of center IP ambient lamp assembly.

(c) Remove 2 screws of the center squawker and tweeter assembly.

(d) Disconnect the harness connector of the front center squawker and tweeter assembly.

3. Remove the ceiling left speaker grille
4. Remove the ceiling right speaker grille

5. Remove the ceiling left squawker and tweeter assembly Tip: The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side. The sequence listed below applies to the left side. (a) Disconnect the harness connector of the ceiling left squawker and tweeter assembly.

![](images/1cf4d0ba72fd9962dadc995c71111445a669b7146b022a78504cc1150dcc635c.webp)

(b) Remove 2 screws to detach the ceiling left squawker and tweeter assembly.

### 1. Check the center squawker and tweeter assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3c7dc2f4` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Measure the resistance according to the values in the table below.

Standard resistance:

![](images/899d74d02128f09ea552c2c8c88b0caa705fd183586d98ec7afe9f0bf6015afe.webp)

If the result is not acceptable, replace the center squawker and tweeter assembly.

2. Check the squawker and tweeter assembly on the left side of the ceiling Tip: The inspection sequence on the right is the same as that on the left.

![](images/3a00ffa1718996957709b992acc35e6f063d255cf486e126ae341f1456c31e6a.webp)

(a) Measure the resistance according to the values in the table below.

Standard resistance:

![](images/0c44277b6045f9f104249a0a4efd32d20822099d56879ed6409a3790a2f9c714.webp)

If the result is not acceptable, replace the ceiling left squawker and tweeter assembly.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9a60acdc` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the front center squawker and tweeter assembly.

![](images/a5f08898f005401af9be0e80b97e89fa64de03d7341adca4da68d219b4fff8a3.webp)

(a) Connect the harness connector of the front center squawker and tweeter assembly.

![](images/17f7fe7621ade762b1424746d7bcb16ec727b11670521ed6236fd393a65de0f7.webp)

(b) Install the 2 screws of the center squawker and tweeter assembly.

![](images/c1c339bbb99c728e447e71562b180fec2eef7b5f0888703e8ce9594b38c6443a.webp)

### 2. Removal and installation of battery terminal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_478176bd` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Before disassembling and repairing electrical components, disconnect the negative (-) terminal of the battery to prevent the system from short-circuiting.
(b) Before disconnecting or reconnecting battery cable terminals, first turn off the power (ignition) switch and lighting switch, and then completely loosen or tighten the battery cable terminal nuts.
(c) When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

(b) When a user encounters a problem while driving a vehicle, the user can consult through the Hongqi VIP line.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5973c8ec` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52） 2. Remove the ceiling handle IR-42） 3. Disassemble the intelligent antenna assembly.

![](images/5b05b14c2d3e1a3fad02f91c25d0e25a2424c5379412084f61bc6ebf429baee9.webp)

![](images/1881d501021e490ff063f696953d8ce303fbd2bacb84a39a13876d1792c4bd01.webp)

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of the intelligent antenna assembly.

(b) Remove 4 bolts to detach the intelligent antenna assembly.

4. Disassemble the shell of the shark fin antenna. (a) Remove 3 nuts, and then remove the shell of the shark fin antenna.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8d0d8d0b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/9fe71b9b94d8da1fdbf8ed1d09b8e3cca701d9d064a963934a5fe8a5d17402fa.webp)

1. Install the shell of the shark fin antenna.

(a) Install the shell of the shark fin antenna with 3 nuts.

Torque: 1.3-1.9 N·m

2. Install the intelligent antenna assembly.

![](images/00d03f3082fc7dc27cd53c1311a106b167f752a5547d2450bdd054b61ea01685.webp)

(a) Install the intelligent antenna assembly with 4 bolts.

Torque: 8-12N·m

(b) Connect the harness connector of the intelligent antenna assembly.

3. Install the ceiling assembly （ IR-44） 4. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）

### 1. Precautions for high-voltage operation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_0e4b215d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) The maintenance technician shall obtain a low-voltage electrician operation certificate and a technical training certificate before it is qualified to use this manual for vehicle maintenance. Caution: Before maintaining the high-voltage system or ap roaching the components of the high-voltage system, carefuly read the Instructions and Precautions for Maintenance in the introduction!

2. Power (ignition) switch notation:

![](images/046527e9fe3539283cdd73ad469ec1c26e644ea9971075fb2e4c4913977f452a.webp)

3. When the disconnected battery cable is reconnected, some systems need to be initialized.

### 4. General maintenance instructions
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_14edeaf9` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check on the gateway system may affect the airbag operation. Therefore, please carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag operation before overhaul.
(b) When any components need to be replaced or any connectors need to be disconnected during overhau of gateway system, disconnect the battery negative cable.
(c) After reconnecting the battery, the door contro system needs to be initialized. Perform "clear DTC” operation to all electronic control systems with a scan tool.

### 5. Bus maintenance
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3b5d92df` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) After welding and repairing the bus, wrap the repaired location with insulated adhesive tape. Danger: The CANL bus and the CANH bus must always be installed together.

Ensure to twist them together when installing. If the CAN buses are not twisted together, they are more susceptible to electrical noise.

![](images/2ac8ec9bca6c9870838e4023869081c09baae62ee836eee84ca74f9e7c34ddb2.webp)

(b) Do not use bypass harness between connectors. Danger: If the bypass harness is used, the twisted buses will lose anti-interference capability.
(c) During overhaul, do not short the CAN-H or CAN-L bus between two connectors with wires, which will affect the bus transmission performance.

### System description
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_59a4603f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. The vehicle is equipped with multiple modern high-tech electronic control systems, the communication between them is managed by gateway, and the data exchange and communication between electronic control systems can be realized via CAN (controller area network). The system has good data communication capability and self-diagnosis function.
2. The vehicle network system consists of CAN subnet, LIN subnet and vehicle Ethernet.
3. CAN combines CAN-H and CAN-L into a pair, and implements communication under differential voltage to ensure high-speed communication.

### Removal

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the console fitting assembly （IP-12）
3. Disassemble the central computing unit assembly.

![](images/51543ee07cf585f3eec31fedd20908196cf9ef3f0ae04a47b82548aeaf3ca60b.webp)

(a) Disconnect the central computing unit assembly harness connector.

![](images/599ded43af4d66c777d186791348609dd2be57dea0d9c2a12322b95278605303.webp)

(b) Remove 4 nuts to detach the central computing unit assembly.

### Installation

![](images/e96c44a8301b5eec4020f107658abb7c96551b54a2e24f432cf279b9ef0ed6a3.webp)

(a) Install the central computing unit assembly, and tighten 4 nuts. Torque: 4\~6N·m

![](images/f6c2ceb2d485cf284a709b762718a26501189226ea5a9e7bd118c978ebea6cd5.webp)

(b) Connect the central computing unit assembly harness connector.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_5133ac8c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）
2. Remove the engine compartment bottom guard Ⅰ assembly ET-44）
3. Remove the engine compartment bottom guard II assembly （ ET-44）
4. Drain front reducer oil （ MC-129）
5. Remove the left front steering knuckle assembly （ AH-1）

6. Remove the left front drive shaft with bracket assembly (a) Remove 2 fixing bolts of the left front drive shaft with bracket assembly.

![](images/9014313b3ac1d0ad4b6759482062460d959a727b4dc7af96167618535c3d683a.webp)

![](images/6c5ad9dc910ad7be36c4bc664e05efd6ab7c198c31099595d56beff45e611738.webp)

(b) Pull out the left front drive shaft and bracket assembly. Danger: Be careful not to damage the dust boot, retarder output shaft oil seal and the front drive shaft and bracket assembly. When removing, hold the two universal joint shells with both hands to prevent the movable joint from pulling off.

7. Remove the right front steering knuckleassembly （ AH-1）

8. Remove the right front drive shaft assembly (a) Remove the right rear drive shaft assembly by using fork wane with a small wood block as the supporting point, as shown in the figure. Danger: Be careful not to damage the dust boot, retarder output shaft oil seal and the right front drive shaft assembly. When removing, hold the two universal joint shells with both hands to prevent the movable joint from pulling off.

![](images/6841df1d5fc582102dd522a053ad45bf4e8624467004d1799e428c274a3c13d2.webp)

### 1. Check the front drive shaft
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_44d5c1f6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check that there is no excessive clearance in the radial direction of the outer universal joint.
(b) Check that the inner universal joint slides smoothly in the thrust direction.
(c) Check that there is no excessive clearance in the radial direction of the inner universal joint.

(d) Check whether the 2 universal joint dust covers are damaged.

### 1. Install the right front drive shaft assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_e706ce7f` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Align the inner universal joint spline of the front drive shaft assembly, and push in the main reducer with force. Danger: Please confirm whether the snap ring is assembled in place after installation. Do not damage the oil seal during knocking.

### 2. Install the left front drive shaft assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_71576879` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Align the inner universal joint spline of the left front drive shaft assembly, and push in the main reducer with force. Danger: Please confirm whether the snap ring is assembled in place after installation. Do not damage the oil seal during knocking.
(b) Install 2 fixing bolts of the left front drive shaft & bracket assembly. Torque: 45-55N·m
3. Install the front steering knuckle assembly （ AH-4）
4. Fill front reducer oil（ MC-129） ）
5. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）
6. Install the engine compartment bottom guard II assembly （ ET-45）
7. Install the engine compartment bottom guard I assembly （ ET-45）

![](images/f3897baa174882a63111db76a084b29ec7302597acd21e446ec48b46878d6c93.webp)

### 1. Check the rear drive shaft
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_44d5c1f6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check that there is no excessive clearance in the radial direction of the outer universal joint.

(c) Check that there is no excessive clearance in the radial direction of the inner universal joint.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_17549ebb` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the right rear driving shaft assembly (only applicable to the model equipped with 245KW RWD electric drive system).

![](images/750d0b86363880d7c81941f2490a86d6c87d5580344dbc06c2760ba5979c874f.webp)

(a) Align the inner universal joint spline of the rear driving shaft assembly, and push in the main reducer with force. Danger: Please confirm whether the snap ring is assembled in place after installation. Do not damage the oil seal during knocking.

![](images/8c12ed86dc7c878a66954975ec7952f6add24b1e52e1acdf26b195fb14d60633.webp)

### 2. Install the right rear drive shaft assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_fc7ad389` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Align the inner universal joint spline of the rear driving shaft assembly, and push in the main reducer with force. Danger: Please confirm whether the snap ring is assembled in place after installation. Do not damage the oil seal during knocking.

3. Install the right rear steering knuckle assembly （ AH-13） Install the intermediate shaft bracket (only applicable to the model equipped with 245KW RWD electric drive system).

![](images/ed7b5aa1eaaf02260612794ae039a23958b23e310c1cbea8f5f8a9564a44d32e.webp)

![](images/59e00d15c7f1db264148b235db592ded3fc60a7f2369aab7682e459bd6d0a301.webp)

(a) Align the inner universal joint spline of the left rear driving shaft assembly, and push in the main reducer with force. Danger: Please confirm whether the snap ring is assembled in place after installation. Do not damage the oil seal during knocking.
(b) Install 2 fixing bolts of the left front drive shaft & bracket assembly. Torque: 45-55N·m

6. Install the left rear driving shaft with bracket assembly.

(a) Align the inner universal joint spline of the left rear driving shaft assembly, and push in the main reducer with force. Danger: Please confirm whether the snap ring is assembled in place after installation. Do not damage the oil seal during knocking.

![](images/ea348cf9b7e731a8455aec683314c7fd2644d0fd1080241f92e0091e42ddceff.webp)

(b) Install 2 fixing bolts of the left rear driving shaft with bracket assembly. Torque: 45-55N·m

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_9e96f836` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Turn the ignition switch to the ON position.
2. Connect the scan tool Q-VDS and enter the repair mode to exhaust the air spring assembly. (Only for vehicles with air suspension)
3. Remove the front drive shaft nut.

![](images/35be803666da6e0bc9b362cd541bd2472e2af28fbb4b3475b05321dcaeaf2a9a.webp)

(a) Remove the aluminum wheel trim cover assembly, and remove the front drive axle nut. Tip: Adjust the wheel to a proper angle, and depress the brake pedal to remove the front drive axle nut.

4. Disassemble the front wheel of the vehicle. （ TW-5）
5. Remove the front brake caliper body assembly （ BR-17）
6. Remove the front brake disc （ BR-16）
7. Remove the front body height sensor （AS-145）
8. Remove the front wheel speed sensor （BC-194）
9. Remove the parallel shaft electric steering gear tie rod ball joint 1 PS-41）
10. Remove the lower control arm 2# assembly （ SP-16）
11. Remove the lower control arm 1# assembly （ SP-11）

12. Remove the front steering knuckle (a) Remove 2 bolts and the left front wear alarm bracket. Tip: The front wear alarm bracket is only applicable to the left side.

![](images/09d1eee7dedcb81061e28e64476374474b7f2e6830799c0f78ae4db7a99f0748.webp)

![](images/2f63970e6cb8eb03bada91ff52148a7f6204597ccb60e2093ff96e58bc682695.webp)

(b) Remove 4 bolts and detach the left front dust plate.

![](images/ba3f996010c08b03495736ce9c20a4df8f072232732e72ce7e7641a187853b51.webp)

(c) Take out the front driving shaft from the front steering knuckle. Danger: The drive shaft is not allowed to hang freely, and proper tools should be used to fix the drive shaft, with the angle of the mobile joint less than 20°, and the angle of the fixed joint less than 40°.

![](images/ab8d13492dfcaf509b46d590e0ac3513753dff32fd3464d83cb92e5230b7461d.webp)

(d) Disconnect the lower control arm 1# from the steering knuckle.

![](images/e037e4d366e623173abbd0d8b00b3fe36c4b7aa84971ba9aba08e3036c73f57d.webp)

(e) Remove one bolt and detach the front steering knuckle.

13. Remove the hub bearing unitassembly （AH-8）

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2f001c7d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.
The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Install the hub bearing unitassembly （AH-8）

2. Install the front steering knuckle (a) Connect the lower control arm 1# with the steering knuckle.

![](images/a79707c7bea1793909e3b1df323db4d73986353af1cfd46d6b09eb02f544a336.webp)

![](images/4a55fca99756152e56d099124b063676ad3c7aa6a806b499366a40b69bf6afcb.webp)

(b) Install the driving shaft into the front steering knuckle.

![](images/3f0b8e5d3ebcf2ad9ccfee4ddbe17c592d90b5494bb97409ccafcff8fb52013e.webp)

(c) Connect the steering knuckle to the upper contro arm.

Torque: 40-59 N·m

![](images/ef2f7466fc77c0ee1e4bc2a3aea4effe3ae83ed59507c5c656c6a94ffc619153.webp)

(d) Install the front dust plate with 4 bolts. Torque: 14\~18N·m

![](images/15c52324da4cc4b596d014d1a18791b21e3e5716e1126fb964a4f33983cbee7d.webp)

(e) Install the left front wear alarm bracket with 2 bolts.

Torque: 14\~18N·m

Tip:
The front wear alarm bracket is only applicable to the left side.
3. Install the lower control arm 1# assembly （SP-13）
1 Install the lower control arm 2# assembly （SP-17）
5. Install the parallel shaft electric steering gear tie rod ball joint PS-42）
6. Install the front wheel speed sensor （BC-195）
7. Install the front body height sensor （AS-147）
8. Install the front brake disc BR-16）
9. Install the front brake caliper body assembly （ BR-19）
10. Install the front wheel of the vehicle （TW-6）
11. Install the front drive shaft nut.

![](images/6735c5aa65867ca49797a0451ac885b23bfb7e26ff97db7b0587dfd70a97e56d.webp)

(a) The drive axle nut is disposable, please replace it with a new one for installation, and install the aluminum wheel trim cover assembly. Tip: Adjust the wheel to a proper angle, and depress the brake pedal to install the front drive axle nut. Torque: 145\~155 N·m, rotate for 45°±5° to the tightening direction.

12. Re-adjust wheel toe-in

### 4. Check front hub bearing unit assembly for radial runout
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_4631a1d5` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/1351473347a90573379ac598e9d07a6e0f6036357a086a16dbda60eb917a302b.webp)

(a) Use a dial indicator to check the bearing surface of the front hub bearing unit assembly for radia runout.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_4055e554` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Make sure that the dial indicator is perpendicular to the measuring surface. If the radial runout exceeds the standard value, replace the front hub bearing unit assembly. Standard value: 0.05mm

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_4c787190` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.
The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Install the hub bearing unitassembly （AH-18）

2. Install the rear steering knuckle (a) Install the rear drive shaft into the rear steering knuckle.

![](images/90cdae0d253f95c75c8a903cc9897584d0d601da0ca66e80cff511fd912b45d0.webp)

![](images/d22ad77b57755679e7f13c23862f2a38b23d1fdb05b4e435138b3fe63f027d94.webp)

(b) Connect the rear upper control arm to the steering knuckle with one bolt. Torque: 140-220N·m

![](images/f737ec48433d84e33db3aa3069d1a88d09da707a6cb3c53d004f946e4d26a0bd.webp)

(c) Use a column jack to support the rear trapezoida arm. (Only for vehicles without air suspension)

![](images/7ec99ec4b4da841ea8bea07ecfb6d7abb03e359561919f14970a62b2358d54fb.webp)

(d) Install one fixing bolt at the front of the rear tie rod arm.

Torque: 140-185N·m

![](images/9cf53857335420b3c516d6bfc535926ed381af0617956c0564be39a11cd77094.webp)

(e) Connect the rear trapezoidal arm to the steering knuckle with one bolt. Torque: 270-330N·m

![](images/c7ae6918c9e156de2176304b360afa617fe05bfdd5fdbaeb8a48e989a119790f.webp)

![](images/bb15888fe8571db77ce8ad49665008316dd15660525c3288d45ef310e56be3cf.webp)

(f) Connect the toe-in control arm assembly to the steering knuckle with one bolt. Torque: 100-170N·m

(g) Connect the rear shock absorber to the steering knuckle with one bolt. Torque: 150-205N·m

(h) Install the rear dust plate with 4 bolts. Torque: 14-18N·m

3. Install the rear body height sensor（AS-147）
4. Install the rear wheel speed sensor （ （BC-200）
5. Install the rear brake disc（ BR-23） ）
6. Install the rear brake caliper
assembly （BR-26） 1

7. Install the front drive shaft nut.

![](images/8ebfa03d2970aa173421c75ce7559c85799829c75376909b7fb4e6725df012b7.webp)

(a) The drive axle nut is disposable, please replace it with a new one for installation, and install the aluminum wheel trim cover assembly. Tip: Adjust the wheel to a proper angle, and depress the brake pedal to install the front drive axle nut. Torque: 145\~155 N·m, rotate for 45°±5° to the tightening direction.

8. Install the rear wheels of the vehicle （TW-6）
9. Connect the negative terminal of the battery CH-54）
10. Re-adjust the wheel toe-in

### Check
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_98d5d1b8` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The inspection sequence on the right is the same as that on the left.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Disassemble the rear wheels of the vehicle
2. Remove the rear brake caliper body assembly
3. Remove the rear brake disc
4. Check rear hub bearing unit assembly for radial
runout

![](images/e6d0b7733fac07f22d6f47d3558afc5211b1541c3dc7f2eb6c2c7a4dc8be5877.webp)

(a) Use a dial indicator to check the bearing surface of the rear hub bearing unit assembly for radial runout.

### Attention:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_98f7724e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Make sure that the dial indicator is perpendicular to the measuring surface. If the radial runout exceeds the standard value, replace the rear hub bearing unit assembly. Standard value: 0.05mm

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_2d96d0e6` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

### On-vehicle inspection TPMS
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_37d1a287` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Parts TW-3
Removal TW-3

Wheels and tires

Parts TW-5

Installation TW-6

### 1. Tire check
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_871a1522` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check whether the tire is worn and inflated with normal pressure.

![](images/756514f62f60a92e9bb2d9c8d670ba35a1139ce2b06b7923cd8ab443b40809ef.webp)

![](images/9a4873671c173e67a30f0b34dcfc67715ec23fbb8e8349c26f089d37cf34c1c0.webp)

(b) Measure the radial runout of the tire with a dial indicator. Tip: Tire radial runout: front wheel: 95 mm (up)/105 mm (down); rear wheel: 105 mm (up)/115 mm (down)

2. Tire rotation

![](images/e20a2348d9bd4ed3d36e86b4983bcad1ee340b2936d9eb5281fb19ad8239efdd.webp)

(a) Transpose the tires as shown in the figure.

3. Check the wheel balance (a) Wheel balancing requirements. Tip: The inside residual unbalance is ≤ 8 g; the outside residual imbalance is ≤ 8g Caution: Use detergent to remove dirt, oil and water from the adhesive surface of balance weight. Do not touch the adhesive surface ofthe tape. Paste the adhesive balance weight to the flat position shown in the figure. Push the balance weight hard with fingers to paste in place. Do not reuse the balance weight. Tip: The inside balance weight should be mounted on the rim with clips. If necessary, check and adjust the on-board balance of wheels.

![](images/f7a67e7560a80cd0001839ad322dfcf7fd8a7c90c0dbb56d8c13ef9e1e98c7ca.webp)

4 Check the radial runout of hub and bearing assembly.

as the left side.

### 2. Remove the rear charging port cover
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_fae30ab0` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Disengage the four locating points at the upper and lower parts of the rear charging port cover, and disconnect the rear charging port cover from the side wall outer panel. Tip: Do not completely remove the rear charging port cover.

(b) Disengage the sheath clamped on the outer plate of the right rear wheel housing, and disconnect the water pipe of the rear charging port cover from the opening position of the side wall outer panel.

(c) Disconnect 3 harness connectors and remove the rear charging port cover.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_b1297170` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the rear charging port cover (a) Install 3 harness connectors.

![](images/e2c9c94dc411d6f397be0041c066b944071be4ea4ea1b1ce47554f68b2807507.webp)

![](images/1713230911a2030398bc65967f124683d31657c9621518c08e8ca066d65c0f9f.webp)

(b) Pass the water pipe of the rear charging port cover through the opening position of the side wall outer plate out of the right rear wheel housing outer plate, and clamp the sheath on the right rear wheel housing outer plate.

![](images/d14c780a80a6a01c5ba411f6ab77d3e27c947c81a4590295dc2f1652f9f8cd38.webp)

(c) Place the electrical components at the rear charging port cover end between the side wall outer plate and the right rear wheel housing outer plate assembly, and then clamp the rear charging port cover assembly to the right side wall outer plate.
(d) Pull the water pipe outside the vehicle to ensure that the water pipe is not bent in the vehicle

2. Connect the negative terminal of thebattery CH-54）

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_03820282` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the sign plate “FAW”

![](images/011b8914f24183b1fe3f363bb40ddcb7b3df6ca482524e4a9dcbf9abca382119.webp)

(a) As shown in the figure, install the sign plate "FAW” to the outer panel of the back door with 3M tape. Tip: Heat the outer panel of back door and the sign plate to 20°C-30°C. Press with a roller (30 N). There should be no oil, dust, foreign matter, etc. on the surface of the back door outer panel, and the surface shall be cleaned up by ethanol. The 3M tape surface shall not be attached with dust, moisture, etc. The included angle and edge of the sign plate should ensure that the sign plate is well pasted.

### 1. Check the front door lock assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6a25445e` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The inspection sequence on the right is the same as that on the left.

(a) Check the operation of the left front door lock motor. (1) Apply the battery voltage to the door lock assembly to check the operation of the front door lock motor.

Normal:
![](images/0d18bf95b7e84d22471dcecfdb847d5f5cee9dcdcc38765cf4e974940debcb01.webp)

If the result is not acceptable, replace the front door lock assembly. (b) Check the operation of the mechanica key switch of left front door lock assembly.

![](images/6b8c4760500522f5ed9e047b2dcb47b0b4ad66efc48c61439220b2fab46f33a1.webp)

(a) Measure the resistance according to the values in the table below. Before measuring the following resistance, please disconnect the harness connector of the front door lock assembly, and use the mechanical key to operate the front door lock assembly to a locked state.

Normal:
![](images/97882e38134199f848f5e11525aa0a0c0aba8fe6f1b2bf08256c89c5f385fa95.webp)

If the result is not acceptable, replace the front door lock assembly.

2. Check the operation of the lock bolt switch of the front door lock assembly.

![](images/bbacdfe856702b6b00606f33d9d11acabf0f62caf1458a15646a3e6f204a5bb4.webp)

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_96edc87d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The installation sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

### 1. Install the front door lock assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_bd66ca7b` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Place the front door lock and the self-priming motor assembly into the door with a suitable angle.

![](images/2e9bcd7f55def64b5f34b5f6c697d3e590f0c1cad9903dd806d9b3528f6f7162.webp)

(b) Install the self-priming motor with 3 bolts. (Only applicable for the model with automatic door closing)

Torque: 4.2-6.2 N·m

![](images/66c3d48396ee377d855b00c49ea4711d07eb7b633d79c62f976c6bd41b2b131e.webp)

(c) Connect the self-priming motor harness connector. (Only applicable for the mode with automatic door closing)

![](images/89d73b63c1b46dade3d363d227852eec7ca345f74453b2f009988d8941944d46.webp)

(d) Install the front door lock assembly with 3 screws.

Torque: 4.2-6.2 N·m

![](images/b483ed9bca81cf49dbe4078fad1546e1264549e7b522bb3344c719ac47d82790.webp)

(e) Connect the front door lock outside release cable.

![](images/43af52e451dded2618af9e34dc47accc6f3e8ee8e51fe0c730edc820dbf2d0f9.webp)

(f) Fix the front door lock outside release cable to the fixing seat.

![](images/e91fcf9711dd84e82e92321a1236f089e3f76eb330f4cdc468d32ecc0c6ccef9.webp)

(g) Install the fixing clip of the the front door lock outside release cable.

![](images/caaa555289de1bcf4457520aa2923a3263cccd42917dc1a4c1dfef5234d9453a.webp)

(h) Connect the harness connector of the front door lock assembly. (Only applicable for the model with automatic door closing)

![](images/685b5f049b8464542fdc77e5a13972b0412f4debb6a3e978d20fa1d89bd75a4b.webp)

(i) Connect the harness connector of the front door lock assembly.

2. Install the front door guard （ IR-7） 3. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54） 4. Install the locking pin of left front door lock (a) Install the locking pin of left front door lock with 2 screws.

![](images/cb72261f887cba01ea2e2abdca8ef5a0bd94fa118e7533c612bd0104305171aa.webp)

(b) Install the left front door locking pin trim cover.

5. Install the lock cylinder assembly of the left front door

![](images/f5883b72d79374643e81dea13c61c2e48c51238d61da1ffc9fa86b4a266183cb.webp)

(a) Pull out the outer handle of the front door, and insert the lock cylinder assembly of the left front door.

(b) Install one fixing screw of the lock cylinder assembly of the left front door.

![](images/6d0c4221ac2c297b4520421dc1828f1f6ebc711d11f201ca4123db0e7837271e.webp)

(c) Install the blanking cover of the lock cylinder assembly of the left front door.

### Removal
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_502c9694` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Tip:
The remova sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

The sequence listed below applies to the left side.

1. Remove the locking pin of the left rear door lock

![](images/79cc91bfea8d8cf363e4fd4ce29d39535ae5578da2b6f14acb36b3e9282db9b5.webp)

(a) Remove the left rear door locking pin trim cover.

![](images/53ad60e9c3a8b960261d459504fe425760b2756c0147e5fc4b273d54e6037f67.webp)

(b) Remove 2 screws to detach the locking pin of the left rear door lock.

2. Disconnect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-52）

3. Disassemble the rear door guard plate.（IR-13）

4 Remove the rear door lock assembly

(a) Disconnect the harness connector of the rear door lock assembly.

L

![](images/f9b67747f77eb0e39079745a9be0930f343471bb5d2beb2ef1209581c31b6235.webp)

(b) Disconnect the harness connector of the rear door lock assembly. (Only applicable for the model with automatic door closing)

![](images/0d082e318c83344aa9ab63c528f7ae0654b4944e0659133d20d8d41fb30b1fb4.webp)

(c) Disengage the fixing clip of the rear door lock outside release cable.

![](images/f145cc0d55856bbef0cb0bb88bf5c296e810933b859399f29a65c4edb85d9e0d.webp)

(d) Disengage the fixing base of the rear door lock outside release cable.

![](images/c9b370a864f34d3a55d30b2c1f63a3caf94ca636b0b291f5cfc7c2e392f0bde6.webp)

(e) Disengage the rear door lock outside release cable.

![](images/9323dce26e8af8a209f5ec7ee7c56dc98c6eae2a922e9b37308aee2512ff011a.webp)

(f) Remove 3 screws to detach the rear door lock assembly.

![](images/484b08d9b11d1bbfbbb61dcc67879386bfeb41888680d09f4c1aab1b8dff6fb7.webp)

(g) Disconnect the self-priming motor harness connector. (Only applicable for the model with automatic door closing)

(h) Remove 3 bolts to detach the self-priming motor. (Only applicable for the model with automatic door closing)

(i) Remove the rear door lock and the self-priming motor assembly with a suitable angle.

### 1. Remove the RKE
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8de1293d` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/5059ba92b9714577cefc403dca22f8c01e464ce124da0bf399d79cbf8aea31bf.webp)

(a) Press the locking button to remove the upper cover of the RKE.

![](images/e6dca1d4f7a0d998d9eb87913fb21cff66e12cb7a7f5b24d53e0362214874629.webp)

(b) Pull out the mechanica key.
(c) Pull out the battery compartment forcibly.

(d) Gently detach the RKE battery. Danger:

Do not press the terminal with your fingers. Do not forcibly pry the RKE battery, otherwise the terminal may be damaged. Do not touch the RKE battery with wet hands as water may cause rust. Do not touch or move any parts in the RKE housing, otherwise it may interfere with normal operation. Prior to replacing the RKE battery, touch the vehicle to eliminate the static electricity on your body, so as to prevent the electronic transmitter housing against damage.

### 1. Check the RKE
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_6f449176` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

(a) Check the operation of the RKE housing.

(1) Detach the RKE battery from the RKE housing.
(2) Install a new or normally functioning RKE battery Danger: Prior to replacing the RKE battery, touch the vehicle to eliminate the static electricity on your body, so as to prevent the RKE housing against damage. Tip: If there is no new or normally functioning battery, connect 2 new 1.5 V batteries in series first. Then connect the lead to the

dry battery and apply a voltage of 3 V to the transmitter housing, as shown.

(3) Test the RKE housing by aligning the key plate with the vehicle and pressing the switch on the RKE assembly housing when you are standing about 1 m away from the driver door handle.

Normal: The door lock can be operated through the transmitter housing, and the LED can be illuminated more than once.

Tip:

The effective coverage varies with the user, the way of holding the RKE housing and its position. If there is strong radio wave or electrical noise interference in the surroundings, the weak radio wave of the RKE housing may be affected. The effective coverage of the RKE housing may be reduced or the RKE housing may be inoperative.

(b) Check the RKE battery capacity.

(1) Detach the RKE battery from the inoperative RKE housing.
(2) Connect a lead to the negative terminal with adhesive tape or equivalent product. Danger: Do not wrap the lead around the terminal, or wedge the lead between terminals or weld them. Otherwise, the terminal may be deformed or damaged, and the RKE battery cannot be installed correctly.
(3) Carefully pull the lead out of the position shown in the figure and install the previously detached RKE battery. Danger: Prior to replacing transmitter battery, touch the vehicle to eliminate the static electricity on your body, so as to prevent the RKE housing from damage.
(4) Check the RKE battery voltage. Tip: When measuring the battery voltage, operate the locking sensor of the door handle, and bring the RKE housing into

the on-board operating range for measurement.

Standard voltage:

![](images/28878ae9126277c8a24ec62abfcb4a3160f54daf204d481076684978d4f9e150.webp)

If the result is not acceptable, replace the RKE battery.

### 1. Install the RKE
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_a27406ef` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/9e08b57a1e52c4e18fdb584402986d127e522d8490618ddde8167a54ba30a3b1.webp)

(a) Make the positive (+) side upward to install a new RKE battery.

Battery type: CR 2032

### Danger:
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_76b8baa2` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Be careful not to bend the transmitter battery electrodes during insertion. Ensure that there is no dust or oil stain in the RKE housing. Prior to replacing the RKE battery, touch the vehicle to eliminate the static electricity on your body, so as to prevent the electronic transmitter housing against damage.

![](images/c2f0bb8fcb452c993691b0aa556b8d730cd388d369faf24c921b9d6f458cd18c.webp)

(b) Install the battery compartment.

(c) insert the mechanica key.

![](images/715ae7ab8334491f3e636adb4e77b0d85f2d7476cd8715218b8eefb746d7d8f6.webp)

(d) Install the upper cover of the RKE.

(e) Press one switch of the RKE to check that the LED is illuminated. Normal: When the switch is pressed, the transmitter LED is illuminated.

### Installation
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_8b881e25` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the left rear overflow pipe.

![](images/5b3aeeaae049c3bbcfbac1e6f1d81dcc4a8aaca23e916d0ddeb3e519916002e0.webp)

(a) Install the left rear overflow pipe, and ensure that the fixing clip of the left rear overflow pipe is properly installed.

(b) Ensure that the upper part of the left rear overflow pipe is properly connected and installed.

![](images/b25e5c366b07ba97fa73e126486d41dfcb661e6fc32767b5e0629415f07ad9a3.webp)

(c) Ensure that the lower part of the left rear overflow pipe is properly connected and installed.

2. Install the right rear overflow pipe. Tip: The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

3. Install the left front overflow pipe (a) Install the left front overflow pipe, and ensure that the fixing clip of the left front overflow pipe is properly installed.

![](images/ac712e260660b3277f2dd3bc628cc1c06820c92efcee78c1be6c11b42e112587.webp)

![](images/aa529fb57b7dee2b989b7e34d30a3018af61962bbc6d5de0dfecd04af34929e7.webp)

(b) Ensure that the lower part of the left front overflow pipe is properly connected and installed.

![](images/031f7bbab1f8647a7da3b36c65f3b5a9a7db08305a008742f28dba382a6280c7.webp)

(c) Ensure that the upper part of the left front overflow pipe is properly connected and installed.

4. Install the right front overflow pipe Tip: The removal sequence for the right side is the same as the left side.

5. Install the sunroof unit assembly (a) Install the sunroof unit assembly, and tighten 20 bolts. Torque: 8\~10N·m

![](images/8667346449b4b7119d7c3b6f2fd1a2bf524afc94625611dfa779616e840a9de7.webp)

![](images/c252f1d665fe6cdb1f6b46bc17699baf2e29c984da4dbe82010330ccb2daa835.webp)

(b) Ensure that 4 overflow pipes of the sunroof unit assembly are properly installed.

6. Install the roller shutter motor assembly.

![](images/505163e2a0f6496ca4faee28a245eb753ea89d2557833bdb6413933b6ecf449c.webp)

(a) Install the roller shutter motor assembly, and tighten 3 screws.

![](images/140949d7f57a441d37f168566b8f60c9b21db5a25fd5f6447b089cd26c0f13ab.webp)

(b) Connect the roller shutter motor assembly harness connector.

7. Install the ceiling （ IR-44）

`hongqi_e_hs9_en_fab1c19c` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When a scraper is used, keep the handle and the top of the glass at a right angle, make the scraper blade parallel to the glass surface and the top of the glass, and then move the scraper to cut the adhesive.

(d) Tie wooden blocks and similar items to both ends of the wire.
(e) Pull the wire along the front windshield assembly to cut the adhesive.
(f) When removing the front windshield assembly, put a plastic protective plate between the wire and the IP to prevent the IP from being scratched.

### 3. Install the front windshield assembly
`hongqi_e_hs9_en_3da28dc8` | e_hs9 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/3cac812983c82ffde7612695e15d3ce63c896adedfc236a7ff8327b62020d01c.webp)

(a) Install the front windshield assembly with adhesive.

(1) Apply primer on the application position (on body and glass) of adhesive.
(2) Apply the adhesive to the front windshield assembly in the triangular section △.

(b) Operations before installing glass:

(1) Use the suction cup to move the glass to the body, insert the locating pin of the front windshield assembly into the body hole at the front of the roof, and fix it to the position where the clearances from the upper and both sides of the glass are the same.
(2) Confirm that the installation of trim strips will not be hindered.
(3) Paste rubber tape on the glass and body, and make the assembly mark with a pen. (When installing new glass)
(4) When reusing the glass, confirm and correct the position of the assembly mark.
(c) Check the pin-buckle joint of the front windshield assembly from the inside of the car.
(d) After the assembly mark and the gap are aligned, tap the adhesive application position on the edge of the glass to ensure that the adhesive is firmly adhered. Tip: It takes 24 hours for the glass adhesive to fully cure.

4. Check for leakage and repair

(a) Perform leakage test after the adhesive has completely hardened.
(b) Seal any leaking locations with automatic glass sealant.

5. Install the sealing strip of the front windshield assembly. (a) Install the sealing strip.

(c) Check the pin-buckle joint of the windshield from the inside of the car.
(d) Connect the connector of the rear windshield assembly.
(e) After the assembly mark and the gap are aligned, tap the adhesive application position on the edge of the glass to ensure that the adhesive is firmly adhered. Attention: It takes 24 hours for the glass adhesive to fully cure.

![](images/e3bd0d56952b662bf77e58c7e7162e909a5182e2f75397d4105f01f8ea9735ca.webp)

![](images/783a3b7699f239967a9f9a00a47c7f5608791200e4bc24bec924e23879218776.webp)

(f) Install the trim strip of the rear windshield assembly.

(g) Pull the wire along the rear windshield assembly to cut the adhesive.

![](images/08cfc14812adcec0b4608d421051623f50f1245ee5835cdccaf5b4c0ec25d587.webp)

4. Install the lower trim strip assembly of the rear windshield.

(a) Install the lower trim strip assembly of the rear windshield, and ensure that 7 buckles are properly installed.

![](images/f7f64487a98fb0d8c0941752dd4f028484f4f3aa74bda8ed89850d974329f516.webp)

(b) Tighten 2 screws.

5. Install the spoiler assembly. （ ET-59）
6. =Install the rear wiper motor connecting rod assembly （ WW-31）
7. Install the back door body （ ED-212）
8. Install the back door upper guard （ IR-63）
9. Connect the negative terminal of the battery （ CH-54）
